Project Name:

One Data Alberta Program and Crosswalk

Scope:

The Data Centre of Excellence (DCoE) requires a Senior Data Architect to support the delivery of key roadmap items for the OneData Alberta and Crosswalk initiatives.

The Government of Alberta's approach to OneData Alberta and Crosswalk initiatives is enabled through a cloud-based and on-premise Data Fabric and/ Data Mesh framework for organizing, managing, and delivering enterprise data assets. The DCoE is responsible for delivering high-value data assets and services—such as analytical models, dashboards, and visualizations—to support critical analytical, policy, and legislative functions. This role is essential to ensuring these data assets are architected, governed, and delivered in a scalable, secure, and sustainable manner.

This position provides senior-level architectural leadership and strategic direction across the OneData Alberta and Crosswalk initiatives. It includes leading foundational activities for Data Access such as schema analysis, data profiling, and the development of enterprise data architecture, enterprise data models, data quality (DQ) frameworks, and metadata standards. The role also guides the design and implementation of data linkages and crosswalk frameworks, enabling integrated and interoperable data across a federated data ecosystem, and supporting the development of strategic data assets for OneData Alberta.

As a Data Architect, this role contributes deep expertise in modern data platforms, architectures, and data product development practices. It supports the evolution of a Data Centre of Excellence that delivers reusable, high-quality data products and services, enabling improved data access, advanced analytics, and data-informed decision-making across the organization.

The role works closely with leadership, architects, delivery teams, and external partners to enable a federated data ecosystem. It requires strong stakeholder engagement, including facilitating discussions, mediating complex data relationships, and building consensus among diverse technical and business groups.

This position plays a key role in advancing the cultural shift toward treating data as a strategic enterprise asset, fostering innovation, and ensuring alignment between business priorities and data technology solutions.

Duties:

Architecture & Strategy Leadership
Lead the design and delivery of enterprise and solution architecture for data platforms, AI-enabled data products, and data integration solutions across platforms such as Snowflake, Microsoft Azure, and Cloudera
Provide architectural guidance in cloud environments, including solution design for AI-enabled data products, agentic frameworks, secure data sharing frameworks, and data linkage capabilities
Define and govern enterprise data models, architecture standards, and best practices
Translate business strategies and priorities into scalable, secure, and high-performing data architecture solutions
Provide thought leadership in Data Management, Analytics, and AI-driven architecture
Data Platform & Product Enablement
Support the design, development, and delivery of data products within Data Fabric and/or Data Mesh frameworks across Snowflake, Microsoft Azure, and Cloudera environments
Guide the implementation of data linkages, crosswalk frameworks, integration patterns, and secure data sharing frameworks to enable consistent, governed, and reliable data exchange
Establish frameworks for data quality, metadata management, and AI-enabled data assets

Develop and validate proof-of-concept solutions, including data integration, orchestration, and AI-enabled and agentic use cases
Stakeholder Engagement & Advisory
Lead workshops, discovery sessions, and stakeholder engagements to define and validate requirements and business value
Provide architectural consultation and recommendations to leadership, project teams, and stakeholders
Prepare and deliver presentations to steering committees and senior stakeholders
Facilitate alignment and consensus on complex data, AI, and technology solutions across diverse stakeholder groups
Governance, Standards & Innovation
Define and promote best practices in data governance, data sharing, secure data exchange, data integration, and data quality
Support data modernization initiatives, including cloud adoption, platform transformation, and AI enablement across Snowflake, Microsoft Azure, and Cloudera
Evaluate and recommend emerging technologies, including AI and agentic frameworks, to optimize data product delivery, interoperability, and cost efficiency
Ensure alignment with enterprise priorities, including security, privacy, information management, data classification, and secure data sharing standards
Delivery Support & Collaboration
Collaborate with data architects, engineers, scientists, and product teams to ensure consistent architecture and design across initiatives

Manage tasks, track action items, and escalate risks or issues as required

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - Full Stack
jobs.excerpt: As a Principal Software Engineer focused on R&D within Resideo’s Innovation organization, you will help build the next generation of software platforms that enable intelligent, connected experiences across the home.
jobs.description:
As a Principal Software Engineer focused on R&D within Resideo’s Innovation organization, you will help build the next generation of software platforms that enable intelligent, connected experiences across the home.

This is a highly technical, hands-on role for an engineer with a strong software systems background who enjoys solving complex problems from the ground up. You will contribute to the architecture and development of an edge computing runtime and integration platform, helping create a software foundation that can understand connected devices and their data, build a richer model of the home, especially spatial and occupancy information, and make that information available to applications, edge workloads, and intelligent agents.

You’ll work in an R&D environment where the path isn’t always predefined. The role is focused around exploring new ideas, rapidly learning unfamiliar technologies, building prototypes and production-quality systems, and helping determine which concepts are worth taking further.

JOB DUTIES

  • Architect, design, and build core components of Resideo’s next-generation edge computing and spatial intelligence platforms.

  • Develop an edge runtime and integration platform capable of bringing together data and capabilities from connected devices across the home.

  • Help build software models and knowledge structures that make device and home information usable by other systems, including edge applications, mobile experiences, and intelligent agents.

  • Take complex technical problems from concept through prototype and implementation, helping the team quickly test, learn, and iterate.

  • Evaluate technologies and architectural approaches based on scalability, reliability, performance, portability, and long-term maintainability.

  • Serve as a technical leader within the team, providing architectural guidance, reviewing code and designs, and establishing strong software engineering practices.

  • Work closely with engineers across Innovation, IoT systems, mobile, embedded firmware, and other technical disciplines.

  • Contribute to R&D planning by identifying opportunities, shaping technical concepts, communicating recommendations, and helping turn promising ideas into new projects.

  • Mentor engineers and contribute to a collaborative engineering culture focused on thoughtful experimentation and high-quality execution.

YOU MUST HAVE

  • 10+ years of experience in technology environments, with hands-on software development experience in compiled programming languages (such as Rust, C/C++, or Go).

  • Software systems engineering experience (in areas such as databases, operating systems, compilers, networking, cybersecurity, virtualization) focused on building foundational technology.

  • Experience working in a R&D, advanced development, prototyping, or similarly exploratory technical environment.

WE VALUE

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to clearly explain technical needs, architectural decisions, tradeoffs, and recommendations.

  • Experience taking ideas from prototype to product.

  • Experience with Rust, or a strong interest in becoming highly proficient with Rust.

  • Experience designing or building foundational software systems such as databases, operating systems, compilers, runtimes, network stacks, protocols, or similar infrastructure.

  • Networking and network protocol development experience.

  • Cybersecurity or secure systems development experience.

  • Experience with edge computing, distributed systems, or resource-constrained computing environments.

  • Experience with knowledge graphs, ontologies, semantic technologies, or other approaches to representing relationships between systems and data.

  • Experience developing or integrating intelligent agents or agent-based systems.

  • Experience with Internet of Things (IoT) technologies and connected-device ecosystems.

  • Experience with embedded Linux, including technologies such as Yocto, or experience with embedded RTOS environments.

  • Experience with asynchronous programming.

  • Experience with containers, WebAssembly, virtualization, or application portability technologies.

  • End-to-end platform development experience.

  • Experience with robust software quality, testing, version control, and continuous integration practices.

  • Experience with a major cloud platform; Resideo uses Azure.

  • A track record of learning from previous architectural or technical approaches and applying those lessons to future system design.

  • Comfortably moving between exploration and execution, with the ability to pivot quickly as new information emerges, and are willing to challenge or adapt processes when doing so helps the team move forward.

  • Self-direction while still actively participating in team planning and technical discussions.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

  • Help create foundational technology for the next generation of connected-home experiences.

  • Work on technically challenging problems spanning edge computing, IoT, software systems, spatial intelligence, and emerging intelligent-agent technologies.

  • Join a small but high impact R&D environment where you can influence architecture and technical direction rather than simply execute against an established product roadmap.

  • Take ideas from early exploration through working systems and help determine how new technologies can create value across Resideo.

  • Collaborate with experienced engineers across software, IoT, mobile, embedded systems, and innovation teams.

  • Have significant technical ownership and the opportunity to shape software that can ultimately support products and experiences across Resideo’s connected-home ecosystem.

As a sales-focused recruiter, you will be responsible for recruiting Senior Loan Officers with a proven track record of self-sourcing leads. Senior Loan Officers are able to offer the full range of RenoFi’s loan product suite, including RenoFi’s exclusive home equity renovation loans.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:

  • Own the end-to-end recruiting process for Senior Loan Officer candidates - you’ll be their trusted contact and guide them from initial outreach and screening, to coordination of interviews with the team, and through the offer and reference check stages
  • Engage with Sales leadership team to understand priorities for each market and corresponding resourcing needs
  • Build trusted relationships with hiring managers and key stakeholders and coach them on hiring best practices
  • Own the job posting process for various roles, including the drafting of job specs and posting to relevant sites including LinkedIn
  • Manage and maintain the talent pipeline and leverage the data to inform hiring projections
  • Maintain the ATS and provide timely and thoughtful feedback to all candidates to maintain data integrity
  • Leverage all RenoFi recruiting platforms to actively engage and source candidates
  • Validate potential candidate’s mortgage production using data sources such as MMI
  • Provide weekly updates to key stakeholders on activities and pipeline
  • Champion RenoFi’s culture & vision

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

  • Preference will be given to candidates with significant experience in recruiting loan officers and sales roles
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with proven negotiation skills
  • Excellent time management and attention to detail
  • Flexible and responsive to feedback, comfortable navigating ambiguity
  • Committed to maintaining a high level of professionalism
  • Proficient with Google Suite & ATS platforms – Our team uses Lever
This role reports to our EVP of National Production and will work closely with our Retail Sales team.
We are committed to hiring and cultivating a diverse team. If you are uncertain about whether you meet our requirements, please apply anyway!

ABOUT US:

The demand for home renovations has never been stronger, yet, it's surprisingly difficult for a new homeowner to renovate. It can take a decade to build up enough home equity and savings to pay for a major renovation. As a result, recent homeowners do a lot of financially-suboptimal things to compensate like borrow from their 401k, rack up credit card debt, and use high-interest personal loans. Or they just live unhappily for years in a home that doesn't meet their family's needs.
But by completing a major renovation, homeowners are increasing the value of their home. Professional real estate investors leverage this After Renovation Value (ARV) to roll the increase in value into new properties all the time. But there hasn't been a great way for homeowners to take advantage of this. If homeowners had an ability to borrow against the ARV, they could increase their borrowing power up to 10x.
To meet this need, RenoFi created a platform that enables homeowners to borrow funds from RenoFi approved lenders in the form of the first home equity loan purpose-built for renovations! Unlike standard home equity loans, RenoFi Loans use the value of your home post-renovation which lets you borrow the most money at the best possible terms. RenoFi is creating a full suite of renovation loan products to better suit the needs of today’s homeowners!
For homeowners, RenoFi makes it possible to renovate years earlier than might be otherwise feasible. For contractors, we empower the financing of renovations at the point of sale, reducing instances of scope reduction, and ensuring prompt payment. Our lender partners, most often credit unions, rely on RenoFi's platform to generate loans, create efficiencies, and grow membership. The lenders pay RenoFi for the new loans, which allows us to offer our services to homeowners for free. RenoFi is truly a win-win-win for everyone involved.
RenoFi is backed by some of the best startup investors in the world, including First Round Capital, Comcast Ventures, and Canaan Partners.

WE ARE A GLOBALLY DISTRIBUTED TEAM

RenoFi has been built from the start as a fully distributed team with an intentional focus on growing a strong team and culture that spans timezones and nationalities. Here's one fun example!

Project Name:

JIMS 3.0 (Justice Information Management System)

Scope:

Justice Information Management System (JIMS) 3.0 is a data integration project aimed to amalgamate, re-design and implement several disjointed reporting data marts containing court data into an Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW) and a set of dependent data mart and views. This project will replace the existing six stand-alone IBM Cognos BI data marts JIMS, Crown File Ownership (CFO), Court Case Management (CCM), Courtroom Utilization, Courtroom Activity, and Case Adjournment) with a well-integrated data warehouse. The existing data marts extract, process, re-structure and aggregate data required for strategic, operational and ad hoc reporting of court data stored in the Justice Online Information Network (JOIN) database. The goal of the project is to evolve availability, governance and reporting of court data by implementing a more efficient, user-friendly, faster and cost-effective reporting architecture. The following benefits will be realized through the project:

Integrated and dynamic architecture
Interactive reporting
Reporting lag
Preservation of historical data
Improved data governance

This Senior Data Architect role will:
review existing data marts,
perform detailed data profiling,
analyze and create design and mapping specifications,
identify Dimensions required for Facts,
complete detailed data profiling of tables included in Facts,
develop and test Extract Transform Load (ETL) processes,
develop Power BI reports for testing for several Dimensions,
testing of Dimensions and Fact for quality assurance
update JOIN as-is data models for new Fact attributes,
stage the required data
address minor fixes in delivered data marts,
provide feedback and lessons learned at project close out.

Duties:
Facilitate the effective definition and management of the data architecture (e.g. principles, strategies, architectures, methods, design principles, models, standards, guidelines, plans, etc.);
Encourage data models and practices that reduce data redundancy by promoting reuse/sharing (in keeping with the IMT strategy);
Identify and document enterprise data requirements;
Encourage practices that improve data quality;
Develop and lead the transition plans that will guide current data to its ideal future state;
Lead or assist in communication activities surrounding the Sectors and Government of Alberta Enterprise Architecture (GAEA) data architecture;
Contribute to the definition and development of the enterprise architecture framework, and associated corporate solution design and delivery methods, thus improving the proactive alignment of data architecture;
Respond to requests for extensions to the scope of the data architecture;
Provide information, advice, guidance, and consultancy to initiatives/projects that are defining or aligning to the data architecture – thus promoting compliance to the data architecture and IMT strategies;
Establish and participate in design reviews, regular or ad-hoc architectural reviews – ensuring correct interpretation of the data architecture, and IMT strategies; and
Provide support to other members of the enterprise architecture team as required

The Team

Upstart’s Unsecured Lending organization is building the first-line risk and control infrastructure that will support the next stage of growth across products. The team helps ensure unsecured lending products operate with clear governance, durable controls, high-quality execution, and readiness for bank partner and regulatory review.

Asset Quality & Model Oversight monitors portfolio-wide trends across loan salability, asset quality, and model performance. The team tracks results against investor and bank partner thresholds, interprets model execution patterns across secured lending channels, and escalates systemic findings before they become repurchase events, partner concerns, or examination issues.

As an Portfolio Quality & Loan Salability Analyst at Upstart, you will support the day-to-day execution of this function by conducting loan-level reviews, organizing portfolio and model performance data, maintaining tracking tools, documenting findings, and preparing reporting and governance deliverables. You will report to the Senior Manager, Asset Quality & Model Oversight and work closely with Credit Risk, Capital Markets, Model Risk Management, Operations, and other secured lending partners.

How you'll make an impact

  • Execute loan-level quality reviews across unsecured lending originations, assessing documentation completeness, underwriting accuracy, eligibility adherence, collateral quality, and other salability criteria.
  • Pull, organize, and analyze portfolio performance data, including early payment defaults, delinquency trends, prepayment rates, loss severity, exception patterns, and other asset quality indicators.
  • Maintain recurring asset quality and salability risk reporting packages for bank partners, Capital Markets, and internal leaders, including data pulls, analysis, formatting, and quality checks.
  • Execute first-line model performance tracking — maintaining production model tracking tools, logging override and exception trends, tracking version changes, and independently flagging patterns that may indicate performance degradation or out-of-bounds behavior for escalation.
  • Maintain issue logs, defect trackers, remediation updates, and documentation libraries so records stay current, organized, and ready for bank partner or regulatory review.
  • Drive governance and exam readiness deliverables — independently assembling evidence packages, populating reporting templates, and coordinating materials for bank partner reviews, committee deliverables, and regulatory examinations.

Minimum Qualifications

jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Job Title : Assistant Manager - Regulatory Reporting

Department : CAD – Corporate Affairs

Direct Supervisor - Senior Manager Regulatory Reporting

Job Purpose

Own the accurate preparation, review and timely submission of assigned regulatory returns for Mashreq UAE, including Islamic banking and subsidiary reporting, in accordance with CBUAE, SCA and applicable internal requirements.

Calculate, validate and explain key prudential measures, including Basel' Capital & Liquidity Ratios and Pillar III disclosures, with clear reconciliation to underlying finance and risk data.

Operate as a first-line controller for assigned returns by maintaining strong checks, documentation, audit trails and issue-resolution discipline, while supporting regulatory queries and reporting change implementation.

Key Result Areas

Prepare, review and submit assigned regulatory returns across all prescribed frequencies, including portal upload, approvals and retention of submission evidence.

Calculate and validate prudential metrics through movement analysis, reasonability checks and reconciliation to the general ledger, source systems and management information.

Coordinate inputs across Finance, Risk, Treasury, Operations, Islamic Banking and subsidiaries; challenge anomalies and ensure timely resolution or escalation.

Execute maker-checker controls and maintain complete documentation for mappings, assumptions, adjustments, reconciliations and approvals.

Monitor CBUAE and SCA requirements and coordinate updates to templates, validations, mappings, SOPs, checklists and reporting calendars.

Support regulatory, management and audit queries; remediate data-quality issues and control gaps; and drive automation, UAT and process improvements with Technology and data teams.

Operating Environment, Framework and Boundaries, Working Relationships

Operate within approved policies, SOPs, data-governance standards, internal controls and delegated authorities while meeting strict regulatory deadlines.

Maintain effective relationships with key stakeholders and manage priorities through timely escalation, handover and business-continuity arrangements.

Coordinate internal, external and regulatory audit requirements, including evidence provision, query resolution and closure of observations.

Guide junior resources through work allocation, technical review and knowledge sharing, ensuring continuity of critical deliverables.

Problem Solving

Apply regulatory knowledge and professional judgement to investigate reporting anomalies, reconciliation breaks, data gaps and interpretation matters.

Determine root causes, recommend corrective actions and communicate complex issues clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Prioritize issues according to regulatory deadlines, materiality and risk, and escalate matters that may affect accuracy, completeness or timeliness.

Decision Making Authority & Responsibility

Accountable for the accurate preparation, first-level review and timely submission of assigned returns within the approved maker-checker and delegated-approval framework.

Recommend corrections and control enhancements within assigned authority, ensuring significant adjustments or interpretations receive management approval.

Coordinate stakeholders to resolve reporting issues and implement approved regulatory or process changes.

Manage concurrent deliverables with disciplined planning, prioritization and escalation.

Knowledge, Skills and Experience

CA, ACCA, CPA, CMA or equivalent is preferred, with typically 7+ years of relevant banking experience.

Working knowledge of CBUAE requirements, Basel capital concepts, IFRS, banking products, general-ledger structures and regulatory-reporting controls.

Advanced Excel capability for large-data analysis and reconciliations; exposure to regulatory-reporting, data-visualization or automation tools is advantageous.

jobs.description:
Project Name:

JIMS 3.0 (Justice Information Management System)

Scope:

Justice Information Management System (JIMS) 3.0 is a data integration project aimed to amalgamate, re-design and implement several disjointed reporting data marts containing court data into an Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW) and a set of dependent data mart and views. This project will replace the existing six stand-alone IBM Cognos BI data marts JIMS, Crown File Ownership (CFO), Court Case Management (CCM), Courtroom Utilization, Courtroom Activity, and Case Adjournment) with a well-integrated data warehouse. The existing data marts extract, process, re-structure and aggregate data required for strategic, operational and ad hoc reporting of court data stored in the Justice Online Information Network (JOIN) database. The goal of the project is to evolve availability, governance and reporting of court data by implementing a more efficient, user-friendly, faster and cost-effective reporting architecture. The following benefits will be realized through the project:

Integrated and dynamic architecture
Interactive reporting
Reporting lag
Preservation of historical data
Improved data governance

This Senior Data Architect role will:
review existing data marts,
perform detailed data profiling,
analyze and create design and mapping specifications,
identify Dimensions required for Facts,
complete detailed data profiling of tables included in Facts,
develop and test Extract Transform Load (ETL) processes,
develop Power BI reports for testing for several Dimensions,
testing of Dimensions and Fact for quality assurance
update JOIN as-is data models for new Fact attributes,
stage the required data
address minor fixes in delivered data marts,
provide feedback and lessons learned at project close out.

Duties:
Facilitate the effective definition and management of the data architecture (e.g. principles, strategies, architectures, methods, design principles, models, standards, guidelines, plans, etc.);
Encourage data models and practices that reduce data redundancy by promoting reuse/sharing (in keeping with the IMT strategy);
Identify and document enterprise data requirements;
Encourage practices that improve data quality;
Develop and lead the transition plans that will guide current data to its ideal future state;
Lead or assist in communication activities surrounding the Sectors and Government of Alberta Enterprise Architecture (GAEA) data architecture;
Contribute to the definition and development of the enterprise architecture framework, and associated corporate solution design and delivery methods, thus improving the proactive alignment of data architecture;
Respond to requests for extensions to the scope of the data architecture;
Provide information, advice, guidance, and consultancy to initiatives/projects that are defining or aligning to the data architecture – thus promoting compliance to the data architecture and IMT strategies;
Establish and participate in design reviews, regular or ad-hoc architectural reviews – ensuring correct interpretation of the data architecture, and IMT strategies; and
Provide support to other members of the enterprise architecture team as required

jobs.title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager /Associate Manager
jobs.excerpt: About Us VT Markets is an award-winning multi-asset brokerage trusted by over 3 million traders in over 160 countries with 500 employees—and growing.
jobs.description:
About Us
VT Markets is an award-winning multi-asset brokerage trusted by over 3 million traders in over 160 countries with 500 employees—and growing. Founded in 2015 with the mission to make trading accessible to everyone, VT Markets offers a robust trading environment, over 1000 tradeable instruments, ultra-low spreads, and lightning-fast execution. We are committed to providing excellent customer service and empowering modern traders to seize market opportunities. Our platform allows traders to trade anytime, anywhere, supporting them in their journey to build a safe financial future.

About the Role
We are looking for a hands-on and data-drivenLifecycle marketing or CRM Marketing Manager to be part of our Lifecycle marketing team.
This is a true builder's role — you will be the person analysing lifecycle journey performance, messaging channels, setting up messaging in automation journeys, and ensuring every journey is effective in driving conversion and marketing messages we send to users are timely, relevant, and measurably effective.
Across journeys and channels, you will be responsible for strategy, design planning, hands-on execution, segmentation, performance reporting, and continuous optimisation. This role reports into the Lifecycle team, then works closely with data, content and product teams to drive engagement, retention, and impacting revenue.

Responsibilities

Automation & Journey Design
  • Own lifecycle journey performance, from conversion rates to channel specific engagement rates, including acquisition nurture, cross-sell/upsell, churn prevention, reactivation and multiple engagement journeys.
  • Collaborate with the Lifecycle team to design and implement event-triggered and behaviour-based automation flows, via our CEP platform (e.g. Braze, or equivalent).
  • Define trigger logic, delay windows, frequency caps, and exit conditions to create coherent automations that effectively reach users to drive conversion outcomes.
  • Build, maintain, optimise channel-specific touchpoints in automation journeys for the full user lifecycle.
  • Set up, configure, and manage journeys/campaigns across Email, Whatsapp, App Pushes, In-app Pop ups, In-app Banners, and SMS — from journey automations to day-to-day operations.
  • Collaborate with Growth Analytics and Product to ensure the right behavioural events and user attributes are instrumented and available for targeting, or where new features need to be built for messaging channels to be fully effective.
  • Ensure channel hygiene: suppression lists, compliance with platform policies, messaging frequency, all to ensure engagement rates are optimised.
Segmentation & Personalisation
  • Build and manage audience segments based on behavioural signals, lifecycle stage, product usage, demographics, and engagement history.
  • Apply personalisation at a scale — dynamic content, variable substitution, and conditional logic — to ensure messages are relevant to each recipient.
  • Develop and maintain a segmentation framework that supports both always-on journeys and one-off campaigns.
  • Identify relevant cohorts and develop targeted communication strategies for each.
Performance Reporting & Analytics
  • Own journey performance reporting— tracking conversion rate, delivery rate, open/read rate, click-through rate, opt-out rate, and conversion attribution.
  • Leverage dashboards to give the team real-time visibility into journey/campaign performance and channel health.
  • Conduct weekly analysis and produce actionable insights for marketing activities & journeys — what worked, what didn't, and what to test next.Interpret channel-level trends and proactively address uplifts/deterioration.
Optimisation & Experimentation
  • Design and run structured A/B and multivariate tests across message copy, creative, timing, frequency, and targeting — with clear hypotheses and statistically valid conclusions.
  • Continuously optimise content, message cadence, and channel mix based on user behaviour and engagement data.
  • Identify funnel leaks in automation journeys and implement fixes to improve conversion at each stage.
  • Stay current with platform-specific best practices for Email, App Push, In-app pop up, in-app banners, WhatsApp, etc and apply them to improve engagement.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Partner with Global and Regional marketing teams to influence teams on lifecycle marketing impact, and provide subject matter expertise on how our journeys/activations are effectively reaching users, driving conversions and achieving campaign goals.
  • Work with the Content team to brief and deliver assets optimised for each channel's format and audience context.
  • Work with Growth Analytics to ensure accurate measurement, event tracking, audience segments and regular in-depth analysis.
  • Partner with Product teams if there are relevant features that need to be built to expand the effectiveness of channel.
​​​​​What Success Looks Like
  • The automation journeys you have built now cover every critical touchpoint across the full user lifecycle — channel reach is precise, experiences are consistent, and user engagement and retention metrics have improved measurably.
  • The A/B testing programme you lead has become a continuous optimisation flywheel — overall CTR, conversion rates, and revenue attribution are trending upward, and your test insights are widely adopted by the team as a decision-making foundation.
  • The real-time dashboards and channel health monitoring systems you established have made the team proactively sensitive to performance shifts — channel deterioration is identified and resolved early, and compliance operations remain impeccable.

Requirements

What Makes You a Great Fit
Job Experience & Education
  • 4–5 years of hands-on experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing, or mobile marketing in a consumer app environment — e-commerce, fintech, trading, super-app, gaming, or similar.
  • Proven experience setting up and managing App Push notifications and in-app banners, including rich push, deep links, and triggered automation flows.
  • Hands-on experience with WhatsApp Business API, including managing message templates.
  • Working knowledge of LINE Push Messaging and its campaign mechanics.
Technical and Functional Skills
  • Proficiency with at least one enterprise CEP platform: Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Emarsys, Klaviyo, Marketo, Iterable, or equivalent.
  • Strong understanding of user segmentation principles — behavioural, lifecycle-based, and attribute-based — and a demonstrated ability to apply them in practice.
  • Familiarity with platform compliance policies (WhatsApp Commerce Policy, LINE Messaging Policy, Apple/Android push guidelines) and experience running compliant channel operations.
Data Acumen
  • Data-literate: comfortable reading dashboards, interpreting funnel metrics, and drawing actionable conclusions from campaign data.
  • Experience running A/B tests and communicating results clearly and persuasively to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to identify data leakage points within automation journeys and use analysis to drive journey optimisation and conversion improvement.
Soft Skills
  • Strong executor with a structured mind — able to manage multiple channels and projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment without dropping the ball.
  • Excellent cross-functional communication and collaboration skills, able to connect effectively with data, content, product, and marketing teams.
  • High degree of user empathy — always placing user experience at the centre, seeking the optimal balance between performance-driven outcomes and non-intrusive communication.
Other Requirements
  • Due to the remote nature of the role, you will need to access your personal device & laptop for work.

Benefits

What We Offer
As official partners of Newcastle United F.C., VT Markets aspire to break the ancient boundaries of traditional personal finance. Through a culture of transparent and objective performance management, we are in constant pursuit of excellence, individually and collectively. Here, collaboration and intrapreneurship is incentivized and we aim to empower everyone to understand their contribution to strategic business outcomes through their individualized roles. You can expect personal growth as we aim to lead this fast-growing industry alongside a global team of diverse cultures across over 15 countries.

  3. Second interview with 2nd-level manager


关于我们
VT Markets 是一家屡获殊荣的多资产经纪商，受到全球160多个国家逾300万交易者的信赖，现有员工500人，并持续扩张中。公司于2015年成立，致力于让每个人都能轻松参与交易。VT Markets 提供强大的交易环境、超过1000种可交易品种、超低点差与极速执行。我们致力于提供卓越的客户服务，赋能现代交易者把握市场机遇。我们的平台支持随时随地交易，助力用户在财务自由的道路上稳步前行。

You'll work at the intersection of a world-class publishing business and the modern AI stack, and you'll own what you build all the way to production.

    • Background in media, publishing, or other content-rich domains

About this role:

Our Business Development teams play a critical role in expanding Gartner’s presence across the global market. Gartner Business Development Executives strategically acquire new clients by cultivating trust-based relationships with C-level executives to understand their mission critical priorities, then uncovering opportunities to deliver client-value through the lens of the industry in which they operate. Gartner Business Developers own and drive the full sales cycle, from identifying prospects to closure. They then transition new clients to the account management team for ongoing value delivery.

Our Business Development teams are relentless about building trust-based, value add relationships with clients, delivering long-term client value, and building their book of business over time. Business developers are results driven, client committed, and highly collaborative.

Business Developers will be given a territory of Large Enterprise prospects, which may be completely new prospects with no existing spend or could be clients within other Gartner areas. In our GBS Large Enterprise segment, Business Developers work with prospects with +$1bil in annual revenue.

What you will do:

  • Seek out and drive new business opportunities with new-to-Gartner organizations across your territory, from initial client outreach to close, targeting Large Enterprise organizations.

  • Convert viable prospects into active Gartner clients, owning the full sales conversation and negotiation, through to the transition of new clients to the account management team.

  • Continually build a pipeline of high-quality opportunities to deliver against your sales metrics ensuring KPI’s are met.

  • Align the right combination of insight, guidance, and practical tools to bring value to the partnership.

  • Quota responsibility for your assigned territory.

  • Manage complex high-revenue sales across matrix and diverse business environments.

  • Own forecasting and account planning on a monthly/quarterly/annual basis.

What you will need:

  • 5+ years’ B2B sales experience, preferably within complex, intangible sales environments.

  • Business development or new-client acquisition experience in a selling role highly desired.

  • Experience selling to and/or influencing C-Level Executives.

  • Proven track record meeting and exceeding sales targets.

  • Proven ability to precisely manage and forecast a complex sale process.

  • Willingness to conduct travel as needed.

  • Bachelor's degree desired

Progression within Business Development Executive Roles:

Gartner offers a lifetime of opportunities driven by our growth. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

Gartner has a promote from within culture and limitless opportunities for progression. Gartner leaders embrace this culture and are focused on helping associates achieve success in current role, as well as coaching associates to the next role or path, whether it be more senior BD levels, account management paths, or sales leadership.

Typical internal promotions include:

  • Business Development Director

  • Team Lead

  • Sales Manager

Most of our Sales Managers and Team Leads are hired internally as part of our progression path.

What you will get:

  • Competitive salary, generous paid time off policy, charity match program, and more!

  • Uncapped commission structure

  • World-class sales training programs and skill development programs

  • Annual "Winners Circle" event attendance at exclusive destinations for top performers

  • Collaborative, team-oriented culture that embraces inclusion

  • Professional development and career growth opportunities

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 21,000 associates globally who support ~14,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

Gartner believes in fair and equitable pay. A reasonable estimate of the base salary range for this role is 102,000 USD - 147,000 USD. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range, or be above or below the range, based on factors including, but not limited to, education, training, experience, professional achievement, business need, and location. We have a flexible work environment, and fluid career paths. We not only encourage but celebrate internal mobility. We also recognize the importance of purpose, well-being, and work-life balance. Within Empower and our communities, we work hard to create a welcoming and inclusive environment, and our associates dedicate thousands of hours to volunteering for causes that matter most to them.

Chart your own path and grow your career while helping more customers achieve financial freedom. Empower Yourself.

The Empower Sr Relationship Manager Mid-Market serves as a strategic partner to our clients, delivering solutions that drive business goals related to retention, growth, and retirement readiness. This role specializes in managing relationships with plan sponsors, advisors, and third-party administrators within either the Mid-Market, Tax Exempt or Taft-Hartley market segments. Focus is typically on managing 20 to 30 plans, each with assets between $50 million and $200 million. Individuals with a reactive/virtual book of business are usually assigned more plans.

As the primary point of contact for assigned client relationships, the Sr Relationship Manager Mid-Market is responsible for ensuring seamless service delivery, enhancing client satisfaction, mitigating risk, and driving client retention. This role may also collaborate with plan intermediaries and third-party advisors (TPAs) to support plan sponsors in achieving their objectives.

Essential Functions

  • Manage a portfolio of mid-size complex retirement plans, typically 20 to 30 plans, ensuring long-term retention and profitability. The number of plans may be higher for roles designated as a Virtual Mid-Market Relationship Manager, depending on the structure of the client book of business.
  • Cultivate and deepen relationships with plan sponsors, advisors, and internal stakeholders to drive business growth.
  • Act as a trusted advisor by delivering strategic insights on plan design, investments, retirement readiness, and industry trends.
  • Lead periodic plan reviews, including participant education planning and regulatory updates.
  • Represent the participant communications strategy, integrating it into annual client plans.
  • Partner with sales teams to expand advisor relationships, develop new business, and grow existing accounts.
  • Work with client service teams to design and implement business planning deliverables.
  • Participate in new business finals presentations and site visits, building rapport and managing client expectations.
  • Identify and implement solutions that enhance overall satisfaction while maintaining the financial viability of client relationships.
  • Serve as the primary escalation point for complex client issues, ensuring swift and effective resolution.
  • Collaborate across internal teams to provide tailored, high-value solutions for clients.
  • Navigate organizational governance structures to advocate for client needs and business objectives.
  • Stay informed on market trends, competitive landscape, and regulatory changes.
  • Deliver client presentations on industry insights, plan performance, and legislative updates.
  • Manage client P&L, balancing revenue growth and operational efficiency.
  • Lead contract renewals, negotiations, and pricing strategies.
  • Identify opportunities to optimize plan efficiency and maximize revenue potential.

Additional Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in business or related discipline or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years financial services including building strategic relationships.
  • FINRA 6 and 63 registration required within corporate-established timelines.
  • FINRA fingerprinting required.
  • Life Insurance License required
  • Proven experience managing client relationships in financial services, retirement plans, or a related industry.
  • Strong understanding of plan design, investment management, and fiduciary governance.
  • Excellent negotiation, presentation, and communication skills.
  • Ability to navigate organizational structures and influence decision-making.
  • Strong business acumen, including financial and risk management expertise.
  • Ability to travel 5-20% as needed based on territory and client book of business being proactive/in person vs reactive/virtual which requires minimal travel.


This job description outlines the key responsibilities and qualifications for this role but is not exhaustive. Empower reserves the right to revise the description as necessary. Performance evaluations will be based in part on the fulfillment of these responsibilities. Employment is at-will, and either the employer or employee may terminate employment at any time for any reason.


This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications of the job. The employer has the right to revise this job description at any time. You will be evaluated in part based on your performance of the responsibilities and/or tasks listed in this job description. You may be required perform other duties that are not included on this job description. The job description is not a contract for employment, and either you or the employer may terminate employment at any time, for any reason.

What we offer you

We offer an array of diverse and inclusive benefits regardless of where you are in your career. We believe that providing our employees with the means to lead healthy balanced lives results in the best possible work performance.

  • Medical, dental, vision and life insurance
  • Retirement savings – 401(k) plan with generous company matching contributions (up to 6%), financial advisory services, potential company discretionary contribution, and a broad investment lineup
  • Tuition reimbursement up to $5,250/year
  • Business-casual environment that includes the option to wear jeans
  • Generous paid time off upon hire – including a paid time off program plus ten paid company holidays and three floating holidays each calendar year
  • Paid volunteer time — 16 hours per calendar year
  • Leave of absence programs – including paid parental leave, paid short- and long-term disability, and Family and Medical Leave (FMLA)
  • Business Resource Groups (BRGs) – BRGs facilitate inclusion and collaboration across our business internally and throughout the communities where we live, work and play. BRGs are open to all.

Base Salary Range

$116,300.00 - $164,225.00

The salary range above shows the typical minimum to maximum base salary range for this position in the location listed. Non-sales positions have the opportunity to participate in a bonus program. Sales positions are eligible for sales incentives, and in some instances a bonus plan, whereby total compensation may far exceed base salary depending on individual performance. Actual compensation offered may vary from posted hiring range based upon geographic location, work experience, education, licensure requirements and/or skill level and will be finalized at the time of offer.

Equal opportunity employer • Drug-free workplace

We are an equal opportunity employer with a commitment to diversity. All individuals, regardless of personal characteristics, are encouraged to apply. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age (40 and over), race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, pregnancy, religion, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable state or local law.

You must have reliable connectivity from an internet service provider that is fiber, cable or DSL internet. Other necessary computer equipment, will be provided. You may be required to work in the office if you do not have an adequate home work environment and the required internet connection.***

jobs.description:
Job Title – Advanced Specialist, Government Relations

Description – Support state-level policy and legislative strategy, delivering insight and analysis that shapes government engagement and informs business decisions across a complex, regulated environment.

About the role

The Advanced Specialist, Government Relations supports Pearson’s US Government Relations (USGR) function by tracking, analysing, and interpreting state-level legislative and policy developments that impact the business and its strategic priorities.

Working closely with senior colleagues, this role plays a key part in delivering clear, timely, and well-structured policy materials that inform internal decision-making and external engagement. The position partners with internal stakeholders across business units to ensure that policy analysis reflects operational realities and supports effective advocacy strategies.

This is a highly analytical and detail-oriented role, combining legislative tracking, policy research, and stakeholder coordination within a fast-paced and evolving regulatory environment.

What you’ll do

  • Monitor and track state legislative and regulatory activity across assigned policy areas, identifying and escalating relevant developments to senior Government Relations colleagues
  • Support assigned business units by developing and maintaining policy scorecards and tracking progress against key business and Government Relations objectives
  • Review introduced legislation and regulatory proposals, summarising key provisions, status, and potential business implications
  • Produce and maintain recurring updates including legislative trackers, policy digests, alerts, and concise summaries to support internal planning and responsiveness
  • Support the development of internal briefings by organising research, synthesising inputs, and preparing clear written materials for use by the USGR team
  • Partner with internal stakeholders to validate business context, gather relevant data, and ensure policy materials accurately reflect operational considerations
  • Provide timely and accurate support to state Government Relations leads by responding to requests for background research, bill comparisons, and impact analysis (including financial, operational, compliance, and customer considerations)
  • Draft and support the development of policy-facing materials such as:
    • One-pagers
    • Talking points
    • Issue summaries
    • Q&A documents
    • Comment letters
    • Testimony support materials
    • Background memos
      Ensuring alignment with established USGR positioning
  • Support preparation for meetings with policymakers and external stakeholders by assembling briefing packs, agendas, and detailed notes
  • Track key legislative deadlines, hearings, and engagement milestones, maintaining well-organised records and documentation
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of internal tracking and documentation processes, including template development, version control, and document management
  • Utilise legislative tracking and monitoring tools to ensure consistent, high-quality policy reporting and analysis

What we’re looking for

  • Bachelor’s degree in Public Policy, Political Science, Law, Economics, Education Policy, or a related field
  • 2–5 years of experience in government relations, public policy, legislative affairs, or policy analysis (or closely related environments)
  • Hands-on experience with legislative tracking, bill analysis, and policy research within a government relations or public affairs function
  • Strong writing and editing skills, with the ability to produce clear, concise, and well-structured policy materials for internal stakeholders
  • Good understanding of state legislative processes and how policy decisions are shaped and influenced
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, work to deadlines, and maintain a high level of accuracy and attention to detail
  • Strong collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with internal stakeholders and respond to feedback and shifting priorities
  • Exposure to education policy or another regulated industry is desirable
  • Experience drafting or supporting policy or regulatory content, such as summaries, comparison tables, or suggested amendments
  • Familiarity with policy areas such as education funding, assessments, procurement, accountability, data privacy, accessibility, or emerging technology policy is advantageous
  • Experience using legislative tracking or monitoring tools such as FiscalNote, Quorum, State Net, or similar platforms

Location & working pattern

This is a remote role based in the United States, working as part of a distributed Government Relations team. The position requires regular collaboration with internal stakeholders and responsiveness to legislative timelines across multiple states.

Compensation at Pearson is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and specific location. As required by the California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York State, New York City, Vermont, Washington State, and Washington DC laws, the pay range for this position is as follows:

The minimum full-time salary range is between $80,000 - $100,000.

This position is eligible to participate in an annual incentive program, and information on benefits offered is here.

Applications will be accepted through October 12th 2026. This window may be extended depending on business needs.

About the company

Our client is a deep-tech AI hardware startup, founded in 2019 in Israel, building next-generation AI infrastructure.

We are looking for a Senior Networking Software Engineer to take a key role in designing and developing networking software for a complex AI SoC.

This is a system-level, low-level role - focused on C, Linux networking, embedded systems, and HW–SW interfaces, not IT or enterprise networking.

You will work closely with hardware, firmware, and architecture teams and be involved across the full product lifecycle.

  • Support pre-silicon validation, bring-up, and post-silicon development

  • Collaborate with firmware, hardware, and system architects

Requirements (must-have)

  • BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Electrical Engineering

  • Strong hands-on experience in C

  • Solid experience with Linux networking and networking protocols

  • Experience with embedded systems and HW–SW integration

  • 5+ years of relevant software / system-level engineering experience

Nice to have

  • Experience with RDMA / RNIC

  • Experience with bare metal or firmware

  • Experience with PCIe, DMA, or device-level communication

  • Background in SoC, semiconductor, AI hardware, or networking silicon

Location & work format

  • Kraków: hybrid or remote (local hub currently forming)

  • Poland: remote

  • Close collaboration with Israel-based core R&D team

Why this role

  • Work on state-of-the-art AI hardware and networking technology

  • Very senior, low-ego engineering team

  • High impact on architecture and product decisions

  • Rare opportunity to work end-to-end: architecture → silicon → product

jobs.description:
The Lead Recruitment Consultant will drive our recruitment strategy, leveraging extensive experience to bring as many good people into good companies as possible. You'll be a key player in building high-performing teams and shaping the future of our organization.

How you will succeed:

  • Develop and implement recruitment strategies: Align strategies with business objectives to maximize placements.
  • Lead and mentor: Guide the recruitment team, providing support and training to ensure success.
  • Build relationships: Network with industry professionals and potential candidates to maintain a robust talent pool.
  • Collaboration: Skilled in collaborating with and influencing stakeholders across various teams and functions to champion talent development, improve efficiency, and boost productivity.
  • Stakeholder Management: Proficient in establishing, nurturing, and mobilizing long-term relationships with both internal and external stakeholders.
  • Talent Sourcing: Source potential candidates via social and professional networks (e.g., LinkedIn, career forums, academic institutions). Identify gaps and opportunities in new talent pools to support inclusion and enhance diversity within TeamFirst.
  • Analyze and improve: Use data to enhance recruitment processes and track key metrics for success. Design and implement results-driven labor market research and analysis to identify the best candidate and company matches.
  • Onboarding: Create an efficient and memorable onboarding process for incoming candidates. Schedule candidate interviews with TeamFirst and suitable companies. Design and manage interviewer training paths and the interview funnel/process.
  • Admin and Reporting: Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual reports for all relevant financials and KPIs. Provide updates and reporting for stakeholders and talent matching. Administrate and coordinate internal recruitment activities in accordance with Japanese regulations.
  • Support HR Initiatives: Foster Diversity and Inclusion, reinforce agile leadership, assist in HR operations when necessary.

You are best for this role because:

  • You have 8+ years of experience in recruitment with a focus on high-volume placements.
  • You excel in strategic planning and leadership.
  • You're a strong communicator and negotiator.
  • You have a data-driven approach to decision-making.
  • You thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
  • Business Level English
  • Business Level Japanese preferred
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

Why you should join TeamFirst:

  • Support in building a leading community platform that is planning to change the future development of Japan.
  • Turn Japans biggest problems in career growth into lucrative opportunities that will impact all of us.
  • Work with a passionate and driven team in an impactful work environment that will boost your personal growth.
  • Meet and strategize with key stakeholders in top-class firms in Japan from innovative start-ups to globally leading brands to policy makers and many others.
  • Receive direct insights from and collaborate with the most impactful talents and companies both domestically and globally.
  • Co-organize unique and exclusive company tours and events.

About TeamFirst

The majority of employees in Japan are not satisfied with their work. In order to understand why and overcome challenges such as gender and age inequality as well as a lack of diversity, new opportunities must be built for the young people who will become our future. Currently, none of these issues are being actively addressed and we are here to change that.

Our vision is to become the most prominent and impactful organization of change makers in Japan, creating a future where 100% of talents find purpose and are satisfied in what they do. We are on a mission to bridge top talents and current leaders from various industries who want to change the future of Japan by increasing transparency, collaboration and open communication.

Utilizing both technology and experience, we carefully select our members to create a community of forward-thinking young professionals. Together, we aim to make a lasting impact in Japan for generations to come.

Ready to make a change?

By building a community of top talents and company executives, we will create a future that values open communication and collaboration through all teams, companies, and industries. Join us as we pave the way for Japans future.

If you want to become a part of this highly-motivated, diverse team, please send us your CV! We are looking forward to hearing from you!

This role combines people leadership, senior consulting, employee relations expertise, and strategic program ownership, with strong influence across HR Business Partners, Engineering and Gaming business leaders, Centers of Excellence, CELA, and global HR stakeholders.

As a people manager and senior leader, this role enables the business to navigate change, strengthen manager capability, and deliver a simpler, more consistent, and more human employee experience across Microsoft.

People Leadership & Talent Stewardship

Sets clear expectations and accountability for consulting quality, judgment, and impact, while providing broad oversight and direction across the team’s work.

Models Microsoft’s culture and leadership principles by leading with integrity, inclusion, accountability, and care — attracting, retaining, and developing top talent while supporting individual growth, aspirations, and career progression.

Integrated Teams Supervisor - ACAT


At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.


We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.


The Impact You’ll Make in this Role
As an Integrated Teams Supervisor in Advanced Customer Aligned Teams, you will lead a cross-functional team responsible for order management, documentation collection and billing verification. You will drive operational excellence, ensure compliance with healthcare regulations, and foster a culture of continuous improvement and collaboration.


You will make an impact by:

  • Boosting team morale by being a thoughtful and engaging leader focused on the well being of the team and each individual’s contribution.
  • Utilizing effective communication skills to convey clear and concise messages to various levels of leadership and staff.
  • Persistently striving to resolve obstacles for staff, co-workers and patients, putting people first in your decision-making process.
  • Building strong relationships founded on trust, fostering an open and supportive environment in a winning culture.
  • Guiding a staff of 10-16 employees aligning the team to achieve service level agreements (SLAs) and departmental goals through performance evaluations and professional development.
  • Deploying a high touch coaching model to monitoring productivity, quality, and performance metrics in alignment with our sales and service partners.
  • Developing strong relationships and collaborating with sales and field service to improve the customer experience and drive accretive order growth.
  • Driving process improvements using lean and change management principles to improve operational efficiency while improving morale and increasing job satisfaction through change management.
  • Supporting strategic initiatives to reduce unbilled accounts and improve revenue cycle efficiency.
  • Ensuring compliance with HIPAA, DME, ACHC, and other healthcare billing standards.

Your Skills and Expertise

To set you up for success in this role from day one, Solventum requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:



  • High School Diploma
  • Bachelor’s Degree or higher from an accredited institution AND 2+ years of people leadership experience in a healthcare, insurance, government, or military environment
    OR
  • 4+ years of people leadership experience in similar environments

In addition to the above requirements, the following are also required:

  • 2+ years in healthcare or insurance operations
  • 1+ year in wound management principles
  • Experience with medical record interpretation and claim submission
  • Familiarity with Medicare, Managed Care, and post-acute care settings

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:


  • Experience in data analysis, Lean principles, and project management
  • Strong communication, problem-solving, and time management skills
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, Teams, PowerPoint)

Work location:

  • Remote with onsite requirement as needed (minimum of quarterly)

Travel: May include up to 10% domestically

Relocation Assistance: Not authorized


Must be legally authorized to work in country of employment without sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H1B status).


Supporting Your Well-being

Solventum offers many programs to help you live your best life – both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, Solventum regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope.

About Upstart

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

The Team:

Upstart’s Customer Experience team helps borrowers navigate the lending experience while maintaining a high bar for compliance, operational performance, and customer experience. The team supports multi-channel workflows and partners closely with Product, Engineering, Analytics, and Compliance to improve borrower support programs, scalability, and operational outcomes.

As the Head of Borrower Success, you will lead and evolve Upstart’s Borrower Success operations, including internal leaders and external vendor partners. You will improve the borrower experience by scaling effective operating systems, strengthening performance and controls, and developing teams that deliver consistent results in a complex, evolving environment.

How you’ll make an impact

  • Lead Borrower Success leaders and international vendor partners supporting borrowers across chat, phone, and email, with accountability for service levels, quality, productivity, compliance, staffing, and cost efficiency.
  • Establish consistent performance management, coaching, and quality frameworks that improve borrower outcomes and operational performance across teams and vendor sites.
  • Use operational data and reporting to identify trends, diagnose root causes, and prioritize opportunities to improve service quality, efficiency, and scalability.
  • Strengthen operational controls and quality programs to reduce errors, improve compliance performance, and support sustainable growth.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to reduce avoidable borrower contacts, simplify customer journeys, expand effective self-service, and improve support tooling and automation.
  • Collaborate with Analytics, Compliance, and other cross-functional partners to improve workflows, operating programs, and the end-to-end borrower experience.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 4+ years of experience leading customer support, customer experience, servicing, or related operations.
  • Experience managing managers and leading scaled customer operations across multiple channels.
  • Experience managing outsourced vendor operations, including accountability for service levels, quality, staffing, compliance, or cost performance.
  • Experience owning operational performance and quality or control programs in a regulated or similarly complex environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of regulatory and compliance requirements within consumer lending, servicing, collections, banking, or another regulated financial services environment.
  • Experience using automation or generative AI to improve customer support workflows, reporting, efficiency, or customer experience.
  • Experience building or scaling quality assurance frameworks, operational systems, or workflow automation.
  • Ability to use operational data to identify root causes and translate findings into measurable improvements.
  • Experience partnering with Product, Engineering, Analytics, and Compliance teams to improve customer-facing tools and workflows.

Position location This role is available in the following locations: Remote

Travel requirements As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in-person sessions’ cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2-4 consecutive days at a time.

At Upstart, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package. The anticipated base salary for this position is expected to be within the below range. Your actual base pay will depend on your geographic location–with our “digital first” philosophy, Upstart uses compensation regions that vary depending on location. Individual pay is also determined by job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

In addition, Upstart provides employees with target bonuses, equity compensation, and generous benefits packages (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k).

United States | Remote - Anticipated Base Salary Range
$128,100—$177,300 USD

What you'll love

At Upstart, our benefits are designed to support your health, financial well-being, family, and personal growth. Here’s what you can expect:

  • Competitive compensation, including base pay, bonus opportunities, and annual equity grants that vest quarterly
  • Retirement benefits to help you plan for the future, including a 401(k) or Group Retirement Savings Plan with a company match of $2 for every $1 contributed, up to $15,000 annually (USD in the US, CAD in Canada)
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) with discounted stock purchase options for eligible employees (US only)

This role ensures that the enterprise technology landscape is modern, scalable, secure, cloud‑ready, and optimized to enable data‑driven decision-making, intelligent automation, and digital transformation. The Enterprise Architect partners with technology teams, including data & AI teams, infrastructure, application development, security, integration and business domain architects to design an integrated technology ecosystem that accelerates value creation and supports enterprise strategic priorities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and maintain the enterprise target architecture across infrastructure, platform, integration, data and AI, including principles, standards, patterns, and reference architectures.

  • Establish architecture guardrails that promote standardization, data quality, AI readiness, platform automation, integration, and security by design.

  • Provide enterprise‑level architectural direction for platforms and advanced capabilities, by defining principles, standards, and target‑state guidance to ensure consistency and reuse across infrastructure, cloud, integration, and platform services.

  • Drive modernization initiatives across cloud, hybrid, and on‑prem environments to support advanced analytics, AI workloads, and scalable digital platforms.

  • Collaborate with data architects and engineers to ensure data platforms are highly available, resilient, governed, and optimized for performance and cost.

  • Ensure technology decisions support regulatory compliance for data governance, security, privacy, and data residency.

  • Lead the evolution of enterprise infrastructure to ensure it meets requirements for scalability, performance, AI compute, storage modernization, network reliability, and cybersecurity.

  • Oversee the lifecycle of key platforms including virtualization, container platforms (e.g., OpenShift/Kubernetes), cloud services, storage, and enterprise databases.

  • Guide the selection and implementation of infrastructure and cloud technologies that support AI acceleration, distributed computing, and modern data workloads.

  • Develop strategies for capacity planning, business continuity, and disaster recovery for critical platforms.

  • Partner with business and technology stakeholders to translate business outcomes into capable, scalable, and future-proof technology architectures.

  • Lead cross-functional architecture reviews and ensure alignment with enterprise architecture roadmaps.

  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to architects, engineers, and project teams.

  • Maintain comprehensive documentation including roadmaps, reference architecture, standards, and guidelines.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (or equivalent experience).

  • 15+ years in infrastructure, data, or platform engineering/operations, with 5–7 years in architecture leadership roles.

  • Demonstrated experience defining enterprise-wide infrastructure, platform, data and AI architectures in complex hybrid environments.

  • Expertise in at least 2 domains from:

    • Enterprise data platforms, data engineering, analytics platforms.

    • AI/ML platforms, model lifecycle technologies, MLOps.

    • Integration platform (API Gateway, Enterprise Message Bus, Event Driven Architecture)

    • Security, identity, zero trust architecture, cryptography, perimeter defense, DevSecOps, Container security

    • Cloud architecture (Azure, OCI, AWS).

    • Container platforms (Kubernetes, OpenShift).

    • Compute, storage, networking, security, and virtualization technologies.

  • Familiarity with infrastructure and platform solutions such as AIX, RHEL, Oracle Database, Dell EMC Storage, Pure Storage, Data Domain, Cisco, Palo Alto, Checkpoint.

  • Experience with DevOps, Platform Engineering, and observability tools.

  • Hands-on experience with Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and automation tools (Terraform, Ansible, Jenkins, etc.).

  • Strong understanding of security architecture, cloud governance, and regulatory requirements.

  • Proven ability to lead large-scale platform, data, or infrastructure transformation initiatives.

  • Excellent communication, analytical thinking, and cross-functional leadership skills.

  • Certifications in cloud, networking, infrastructure, or architecture frameworks (AWS, Azure, TOGAF) are a plus.

  • Experience with ITIL, Agile, and modern delivery methodologies.

Required Qualifications and Skills
