Make a Difference in Behavioral Health - Right from Home!

Are you a compassionate, experienced therapist looking to make a meaningful impact from the comfort of your home? Iris Telehealth is dedicated to expanding access to high-quality mental health care while supporting our clinicians with the tools, community, and work-life balance they need to thrive.

We’re currently hiring a full-time Licensed Specialist Clinical Social Worker (LSCSW) to provide virtual outpatient therapy for adult patients through one of our trusted Kansas-based partners. This role requires candidates to either hold an active Licensed Clinical Addiction Counselor (LCAC) license in Kansas or be eligible and willing to obtain LCAC licensure with support from Iris Telehealth.

What You'll Do
As part of a collaborative, well-supported care team, you'll:

  • Conduct comprehensive initial evaluations and establish initial treatment plans.

  • Provide both individual and family therapy to patients (primarily ages 18+, but includes lifespan), with diagnoses including general mental health SMI

  • Collaborate with a wide network of support, including psychiatry, crisis services, peer support, case managers, and more.

More About the Role

  • Setting:100% Remote | outpatient clinic based out of Kansas

  • Schedule:Monday–Friday, 40 hrs/wk, with 3 days being after 5pm CST required

  • Appointments:60-90 minutes for initial evaluations, 30-60 minutes for follow-up appointments

  • Administrative time:1-2 hours per week

  • Caseload:6-8 clients scheduled per day

Why Iris Telehealth?

  • Mission-Driven Work: At Iris Telehealth, our mission is at the heart of everything we do: increasing access to high-quality mental health care. As a Joint Commission Accredited organization, we’re proud to partner with clinicians to deliver care to the communities that need it most.

  • Comprehensive Clinician Support:From licensing and credentialing to IT, onboarding, and administrative support we’ve got you covered so you can focus on what matters most: providing excellent patient care.

  • Work-Life Balance:We know how important it is to feel balanced and supported. Our roles offer the flexibility of remote work, helping you maintain a healthy balance between your professional and personal life.

At Iris Telehealth, you’ll have the chance to deliver impactful care to underserved communities and work with a multidisciplinary team to enhance access to high-quality behavioral health care. Apply today to be part of our mission-driven team, transforming mental health care - one patient at a time - all from the comfort of your home!

Qualifications: 

  • Proven experience in providing therapy services as an independently licensed Licensed Specialist Clinical Social Worker(LSCSW)
  • Active Kansa LSCSW license required
  • Active Kansas Licensed Clinical Addiction Counselor (LCAC) license OR eligibility and willingness to obtain LCAC licensure required
  • Experience working with patients with substance use disorders and/or co-occurring mental health and substance use needs preferred
  • Full-time availability (40 hours per week) during CST hours
  • Experience and comfort treating patients across varying acuity levels
  • Telehealth experience preferred (familiarity with SmartCare is a plus!)
  • Reside in the U.S. or a U.S. territory

  

Our Benefits:

At Iris Telehealth, we believe great care starts with caring for our clinicians. We’re proud to offer benefits that support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance — so you can focus on doing what you do best: providing exceptional care.

All Iris clinicians receive:

  • Competitive compensation — your expertise deserves to be recognized and rewarded

  • Work-from-home flexibility — skip the commute & enjoy greater flexibility

  • Comprehensive malpractice coverage — full protection, zero hassle

  • Licensing & credentialing support — we handle the logistics so you can focus on care

  • Upfront payment of all state licensing fees — no delays, no out-of-pocket costs

  • Home office setup & 24/7 IT support — everything you need to succeed virtually

Full-time Iris clinicians also enjoy:

  • 4 weeks of PTO + 8 flexible paid holidays — time to recharge, your way

  • Annual CME budget & starting office upgrade stipend — invest in your growth and set up your perfect space

  • Comprehensive health coverage — access to a large national network for medical, dental, and vision care

  • 100% employer-paid life insurance — financial security for you and your loved ones

  • 401(k) with employer match — plan confidently for your future

  • Optional short- & long-term disability coverage — added protection when you need it

About Us:

At Iris Telehealth, we empower our clinicians to provide high-quality virtual behavioral health care to patients across the U.S. We believe in supporting our clinicians with comprehensive resources, allowing them to focus on patient care and make a genuine difference. Partnering with healthcare facilities nationwide, we handle the administrative tasks so our clinicians can focus on what they do best—providing top-quality care. With strong support for licensing and credentialing, we ensure our providers are equipped to serve patients in underserved areas.

Our commitment to work-life balance and respect for our clinicians' expertise sets us apart as a leading behavioral healthcare organization. At Iris, you're more than just a number; you're a valued member of a mission-driven team dedicated to expanding access to mental health care. Experience the difference we bring to behavioral healthcare!

If you are a current Iris provider, thank you for your dedication and service! If you're interested in this opportunity, please contact your Practice Manager for more information about eligibility requirements and how this role compares to your current position.

Iris Telehealth is an Equal Opportunity Employer and complies with all state and federal laws regarding EEOC.

Role Title: Linguistics Specialists

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote (US and Western Europe)

We are engaging Linguistics Specialists to contribute to a specialized AI quality and evaluation project.   • written communication

  • attention to detail

  • Provide clear, constructive written feedback regarding the quality and effectiveness of written responses.

  • Identify subtle errors and inconsistencies in grammar, usage, context, and meaning, ensuring linguistic precision.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to identify subtle issues, inconsistencies, and errors in written material.

  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to objectively assess information and provide concise, constructive feedback.

  • Comfortable following detailed guidelines and applying evaluation criteria consistently across a high volume of work.

  • Immediate availability and ability to commit at least 20 hours per week while maintaining consistently high-quality outputs.

Whether moving people or freight, future rail and transit solutions will be determined by energy prices, a shift toward urban living and growing environmental concerns. Michael Baker helps freight, authority and state Department of Transportation clients meet these modern challenges by providing services that address key industry issues such as state of good repair, capacity, safety, community livability, asset management and maintenance, planning and development for new projects, and the promotion of environmental stewardship and sustainability.

Make an Impact Where It Matters Most
At Michael Baker International, we’re shaping the future of rail and transit infrastructure. We’re looking for a Project Manager with expertise in rail bridge design to lead transformative projects that keep America moving. If you thrive on solving complex engineering challenges and want to work with a team that values innovation, collaboration, and career growth, this is your opportunity.

Why Join Us?

  • Flexibility: Work remotely from anywhere in the U.S. with occasional travel for client and project needs.
  • Influence: Lead high-profile rail bridge projects for Class I railroads and transit agencies.
  • Growth: Access mentorship, leadership development, and cutting-edge tools to advance your career.
  • Impact: Your work will directly improve safety, efficiency, and sustainability in rail transportation.

How You’ll Make a Difference

  • Drive end-to-end project delivery—planning, staffing, budgeting, and execution across multi-disciplinary teams.
  • Manage schedules, resources, and deliverables to ensure on-time, on-budget success.
  • Collaborate with clients, agencies, and internal teams to build strong partnerships.
  • Oversee technical designs, ensuring compliance with AREMA and client standards.
  • Prepare reports, cost estimates, and documentation that tell the story of project success.
  • Train and mentor junior engineers in rail bridge design, rehabilitation, retaining wall design, culvert design and construction staging.
  • Champion safety and quality at every stage.

What You Bring

  • Education: Bachelor’s in Civil Engineering (Master’s in Structural Engineering preferred).
  • Experience: 7–10 years in bridge design, rehabilitation, and construction with a railroad focus. Previous project management experience is required.
  • Professional Engineer Licensure (Structural Engineer License preferred).
  • Proven track record with Class I Railroads, Passenger Rail and/or transit agencies.
  • Expertise in AREMA standards and rail structure design.
  • Railroad bridge inspection experience with construction inspection or construction management as an added benefit
  • Strong leadership, client management, communication and multitasking skills.

Ready to Build the Future?

Join a team that values your expertise and gives you the tools to succeed. Apply today and help us deliver the next generation of rail infrastructure.

COMPENSATION

The approximate compensation range for this position is $110,000- $175,000 per year. This compensation range is a good faith estimate for the position at the time of posting. Actual compensation is dependent upon factors such as education, qualifications, experience, skillset, and physical work location.

jobs.excerpt: We are looking for a CS Transformation & Implementation Specialist to join our team and help us shape the next generation of internal platforms supporting the traveller’s journey.
jobs.description:
We are looking for a CS Transformation & Implementation Specialist to join our team and help us shape the next generation of internal platforms supporting the traveller’s journey.

If you are passionate about turning complexity into scalable solutions, leveraging AI to improve operational workflows, and thriving at the intersection of CS Operations, Product, and Technology, keep on reading, you might be the perfect fit for this role.

The job in brief:

  • Job Title - CS Transformation & Implementation Specialist
  • Working model - Remote from Spain, Portugal or Romania
  • Team - You will join the Product Customer Service team within the Product department
  • Level - Professional
  • Location - Spain
  • Contract - Full time (36 h/week)
  • Travel time required - Only a few times a year

What your impact will be:

You will play a central, key role in a major Customer Service transformation: renewing our omnichannel platform, redesigning operational workflows, and scaling AI and automation across the department.

You will sit between the technical teams and the Customer Service population, translating in both directions. Covering the full arc of a change, from understanding how the operation works today, designing target workflows inside a new system, to building, launching, and proving real business impact, you will ensure our internal tools simplify daily work, improve efficiency, and contribute to a smoother experience for our travellers.

What You Will Need to Solve:

Shape and deliver a new customer operations platform:

  • Take end-to-end ownership of key areas of a new AI-ready back-office and customer operations platform, including cloud omnichannel migrations (with direct Zendesk implementation involvement).
  • Lead discovery activities to analyze current operational workflows, triaging, routing, escalations, and pain points across all contact channels.
  • Help define the future operational model, solution design, workflow logic, service-level rules, taxonomy, and data structures in collaboration with business and technology stakeholders.
  • Challenge legacy processes and support the transition towards a modern, scalable platform, defining structured requirements and realistic roadmaps.

Drive AI and automation initiatives:

  • Identify manual, repetitive, and low-value activities across the operation and design solutions that remove them.
  • Scope and deliver AI-enabled solutions (such as conversational AI, intelligent triage and routing, agent assist/copilot tools, generative replies, automated summarization, or quality monitoring).
  • Structure operational knowledge and content so that it is reliably usable by both agents and AI systems.
  • Critically evaluate where AI and automation genuinely add value versus where they risk degrading the user experience or simply shifting complexity elsewhere.

Shape product delivery and roadmap execution:

  • Lead implementation from discovery through configuration, migration, testing, cutover, and post go-live stabilization.
  • Translate operational needs into clear specifications, BPMN process models, user stories, and iterative releases.
  • Balance strategic thinking with execution rigor, prioritizing backlog items based on value, feasibility, and operational impact.
  • Continuously adapt priorities based on business needs, operational feedback, and product insights while taking accountability for outcomes.

Enhance the customer operations ecosystem:

  • Design the operational reporting framework in new systems and ensure continuity with existing performance baselines.
  • Leverage workflow orchestration tools, low-code/no-code platforms, RPA, and system integrations via APIs/connectors to streamline processes across the traveller journey.
  • Model complex end-to-end flows, understanding how a change in one step affects the rest of the chain to maintain a simple, reliable platform.

Collaborate with stakeholders and teams:

  • Act as the key connector between CS Operations, Product, IT, Data, and Machine Learning teams.
  • Align cross-functional stakeholders with different priorities on scope, risks, timelines, and trade-offs, influencing without formal authority.
  • Drive platform adoption through structured enablement, training, and change management engagement.
  • Monitor performance after launch, measuring real impact against established operational KPIs to prove the change delivered what it promised.

Your expertise:

  • Around 5 years of experience in transformation delivery, product ownership, business analysis, or systems implementation in medium to large organisations.
  • Direct hands-on experience implementing, configuring, or operating leading cloud customer service platforms; direct Zendesk implementation experience is required (in an implementation, business analysis, or operations capacity).
  • Strong discovery and solution design skills, including BPMN workflow modeling, requirement gathering, and data classification/taxonomy design.
  • Proven experience delivering automation and AI initiatives in customer service or operations (e.g., GenAI, LLMs, conversational AI, intelligent routing, or agent assist tools).
  • Advanced proficiency in operational data analysis (Excel, Google Sheets, BI tools) with a focus on baselining, KPI tracking, and impact measurement.
  • Proven track record managing cross-functional stakeholders, navigating complexity, and leading end-to-end delivery from cutover to post-launch optimization.
  • Strong user-centric mindset with deep empathy for internal operational teams and travellers.
  • Fluency in English, both spoken and written (mandatory).

Desirable:

  • Zendesk certification (e.g., Zendesk Support Administrator Expert, Zendesk Administrator).
  • Experience in the travel or travel-tech/tourism industry.
  • Background in large-scale customer service, back-office platforms, CRM systems, or complex process transformation initiatives.
  • Practical experience with workflow automation tools, RPA, or API integrations.
  • Working knowledge of Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban) or Agile certifications (e.g., PMI-ACP, Scrum Master).
  • Familiarity with structured Change Management approaches (such as ADKAR or Prosci certification).
  • Multi-brand and multi-language platform setup experience.
  • Italian and/or Spanish language proficiency.

What Success Looks Like

First twelve months:

  • The new platform is designed and delivered to plan across the agreed scope, with a controlled cutover and no material disruption to service levels.
  • Target ways of working are defined, agreed upon, and actually running in the new system rather than documented and ignored.
  • Reporting continuity is maintained across the transition, with a reliable baseline to measure performance against.
  • A clear, prioritized automation and AI roadmap is established, with initial high-impact initiatives delivered and measured.
  • Strong adoption across the operation, evidenced by actual usage and quality measures.

Beyond year one:

  • Sustained improvement in efficiency and consistency, measured against the initial baseline.
  • Automation and AI capabilities are expanded and adopted with quantified business impact.
  • A coherent, up-to-date design model of operational workflows is maintained as the department continues to evolve.

Perks of working with us:

How we work together:

jobs.description:
Job Title - Lead, Client Partner

DESCRIPTION

Shape Pearson's global Account Management capability, defining the frameworks, standards and operating model that help institutions successfully adopt, realise value from and renew Pearson's digital learning solutions. Comparable market titles for this opportunity may include Global Head of Account Management, Head of Customer Success, Director of Customer Success, Strategic Accounts Director, Senior Director of Account Management, Director of Strategic Accounts, Global Customer Success Leader, Head of Client Success, Customer Experience Director, Post-Sales Transformation Lead, Director of Customer Retention & Growth, or Enterprise Account Management Director.

LOCATION & WORKING PATTERN

  • Remote role based in the UK or another approved EMEA location.
  • No regular office requirement. UK-based colleagues may utilise Pearson offices where practical.
  • Customer travel is expected and will form a regular part of the role.
  • Working patterns may vary depending on customer and business requirements, with a combination of virtual engagement and face-to-face meetings.
  • Exact location eligibility and expected travel requirements will be confirmed during the recruitment process.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Pearson is building a consistent global Account Management capability for International Higher Education.

As Lead, Client Partner, you will own the frameworks, standards, operating model and ways of working that turn signed contracts into strong onboarding, adoption, measurable value, renewal readiness and sustainable expansion.

This is a senior leadership role combining capability building, customer strategy and people leadership. You will directly lead Customer Delivery Managers while providing functional leadership across Strategic Account Managers embedded within regional sales teams.

Your impact will come through creating clarity, driving consistency and implementing practical operating models that work across a diverse international business. You will help establish a repeatable, scalable customer experience that strengthens customer outcomes, improves retention and creates opportunities for long-term growth.

Joining at a formative stage of Pearson's evolution, you will have the opportunity to build processes, establish governance disciplines and shape a global capability that supports institutions throughout their partnership with Pearson.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Lead the Global Account Management Capability

  • Define and scale global Account Management role expectations, competency frameworks and operating standards.
  • Create playbooks, governance models and best-practice frameworks that drive consistency across regions.
  • Develop team operating rhythms, customer engagement standards and success measures.
  • Build scalable models that support onboarding, adoption, value realisation and renewal readiness.

Lead & Develop High-Performing Teams

  • Lead, coach and develop Customer Delivery Managers.
  • Set clear objectives, expectations and performance standards.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration and customer focus.
  • Support Strategic Account Managers through functional leadership and capability development.

Drive Customer Outcomes & Renewals

  • Own the post-contract customer lifecycle from sales handover through onboarding, adoption, engagement, value realisation and renewal.
  • Establish and maintain a comprehensive account-health framework.
  • Strengthen customer governance, success planning and executive engagement approaches.
  • Improve renewal readiness through customer evidence packs, value narratives and success metrics.
  • Identify and support appropriate within-contract growth opportunities.

Partner Across Pearson

  • Collaborate closely with Sales, Product, Marketing, Customer Success, Implementation Delivery, RevOps and Enablement teams.
  • Ensure alignment across the customer lifecycle.
  • Act as an escalation point for complex customer situations, renewal risks and competitive threats.
  • Share customer insight to inform product, commercial and strategic decision-making.

Influence Strategic Direction

  • Represent Account Management within central leadership forums.
  • Provide executive insight into customer outcomes, engagement trends, renewal health and portfolio performance.
  • Help shape Pearson's approach to customer success and long-term customer value creation.

WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

This role enables acquisition-focused sales teams to continue growing new business while dedicated account teams nurture strategic institutional relationships after contract signature.

The successful candidate will play a critical role in creating a consistent customer experience, improving retention, driving adoption and ensuring customers realise measurable value from their investment in Pearson solutions.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Essential Experience

  • Significant leadership experience across Account Management, Customer Success, Strategic Accounts, Post-Sales or Customer Delivery functions.
  • Experience leading multi-regional or international teams.
  • Proven success designing and embedding customer-facing operating models, standards and playbooks at scale.
  • Strong track record of leading through influence within matrix organisations.
  • Experience developing customer lifecycle strategies that improve adoption, retention and renewal outcomes.

Knowledge & Skills

  • Deep understanding of customer adoption, value realisation, retention, renewal readiness and account growth.
  • Experience building Account Management systems, frameworks and governance disciplines.
  • Strong commercial acumen and confidence using CRM platforms, customer analytics and forecasting tools.
  • Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to influence senior leaders and align diverse teams around common goals.
  • Structured, pragmatic and solution-oriented approach to complex business challenges.
  • Strong planning, organisation and prioritisation capabilities.
  • Comfortable working within global, matrixed environments.
  • Digital confidence across technology products and customer success platforms without needing to be a technical specialist.
  • The judgement to challenge constructively, make decisions and bring recommendations rather than waiting for detailed direction.

Desirable

  • Experience within Higher Education, Education Technology, SaaS or digital learning environments.
  • Knowledge of customer success technologies and account-health methodologies.
  • Experience leading transformation or capability-building initiatives.
  • Familiarity with strategic account planning and enterprise customer engagement models.

WHY JOIN PEARSON?

At Pearson, we're committed to helping learners realise the life they imagine through learning.

This is a unique opportunity to build and lead a global post-sales capability, shape the future of Account Management within International Higher Education and create lasting impact for institutions, educators and learners around the world.

You'll have the opportunity to influence strategy on a global scale, develop high-performing teams, strengthen customer partnerships and help shape how Pearson delivers long-term value for customers across the higher education sector.

Viva.com’s offering spans across omnichannel payment acceptance, deposit accounts, card issuing, and a broad suite of financing solutions - including working capital and advance booking financing - alongside fiscalisation services, giving businesses across all verticals access to the tools they need to run their operations efficiently, on a single integrated platform.

Reflect Health is the evolution of S&S Health, a trusted independent third-party administrator founded in 1994 to meet the growing need for access, simplified connectivity, and benefits administration. Headquartered in Mason, OH, we have built a national presence serving employers, TPAs, health systems, and benefit consultants across all 50 states, with proprietary claims technology and level-funded and fully funded program offerings.

We are seeking a Director, Revenue Operations to lead the systems, data, and processes that power Reflect Health's revenue engine. This role owns HubSpot as the platform of record for pipeline management, quoting and pricing, partner visibility, and marketing execution. This is a hands-on, build-and-own role for someone who wants to architect revenue operations infrastructure from the ground up and set the foundation for a future team.

Systems

HubSpot (Sales, Marketing, Service Hubs), Quotivity, Jira, Data Rails, Sage Intacct, Power BI

Responsibilities

  • HubSpot Platform Ownership:Certified HubSpot administrator across Sales, Marketing, and Service Hubs; audit existing configuration (pipeline stages, dashboards, Pricebook) and build a scalable system of record
  • Quoting & Pricebook Integration:Own and extend quoting/pricebook through Quotivity, building on Pricebook to support multiple revenue types (PEPM, PMPM, savings-based, hybrid) and bundled TPA solutions
  • Book of Business & Client Health:Load and integrate inforce book-of-business data from internal and partner sources into HubSpot to establish whitespace analysis and client health scoring for growth and retention
  • Pipeline Reporting:Standardize reporting across multiple pipelines (new business, renewals/expansion, partner-sourced), including quote-to-close ratios, win/loss insights, and executive dashboards
  • Partner & Expansion Pipeline Visibility:Build dedicated partner-sourced pipelines segmented by relationship type (broker, consultant, TPA, program manager, captive) and an expansion group pipeline with workload/capacity visibility
  • Intake & Lifecycle Workflow Design:Design structured HubSpot intake forms to replace email-based requests; build HubSpot-to-Jira connectivity for implementation, renewal, amendment, and termination workflows
  • Marketing Operations:Manage marketing campaigns within HubSpot, including workflow automation, segmentation, lead routing, and performance reporting
  • RFP, RFI & Questionnaire Management:Own the end-to-end process for RFPs, RFIs, and due diligence questionnaires across sales, compliance, and operations
  • Data Governance:Enforce required-field standards, naming conventions, and validation rules (deal type, product, funding type, revenue type, pricing structure) for data integrity and audit-readiness
  • System Governance, Training & Hygiene:Establish ongoing governance policies, user training, and ongoing data hygiene/maintenance routines to sustain HubSpot adoption, accuracy, and performance over time
  • Cross-Functional Partnership:Align systems and reporting with sales, marketing, finance, implementation, compliance, and the Transformation Office; manage outsourced HubSpot development partners where used
  • Data Privacy & Compliance:Handle book-of-business, client, and pipeline data per HIPAA and Reflect Health data privacy standards; partner with Compliance on access controls for PHI referenced in reporting
  • Other Duties:Perform other duties as assigned

Qualifications

  • HubSpot Certification:Required (e.g., Sales, Marketing, or RevOps certification); hands-on platform depth prioritized over years of experience
  • Revenue Operations Expertise:Proven experience building revenue/sales/marketing operations infrastructure, ideally with a multi-product or complex pricing model
  • Quoting & Pricing Systems:Experience with quoting/CPQ tools (Quotivity a strong plus) and integrating pricing data with a CRM across varied revenue models
  • Integration & Workflow Experience:Experience connecting HubSpot with systems like Jira and designing intake-to-lifecycle automation; Power BI or Sage Intacct familiarity a plus
  • Reporting & Analytics:Track record building multi-pipeline reporting, dashboards, and forecasting models for executive decision-making
  • RFP/RFI Process Management:Experience managing RFP, RFI, or questionnaire response processes across multiple stakeholders
  • Industry Knowledge:Familiarity with the TPA or self-funded health benefits industry is a plus, not required
  • Communication & Leadership:Excellent communication skills; able to work cross-functionally and manage external partners; future potential to build a team as the function scales
  • Adaptability:Comfortable in a fast-paced, evolving, transformation-stage environment

Logistics

The Legal Specialist supports the Legal Department in providing efficient, accurate, and timely legal and administrative assistance related to the Company’s clinical research operations.   • Support legal compliance activities related to clinical trials, including documentation required for audits, inspections, and due diligence processes.
  • Conduct legal and regulatory research related to healthcare, clinical research, data protection, and corporate law as required.
  • Privacy compliance support, completing and tracking privacy assessments, DPIAs, and other required documentation.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • High level of discretion and professionalism when handling confidential information.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and contract/document management systems.

Our company

The Work Environment

At Indero, you will work with brilliant and driven colleagues. Our values are collaboration, innovation, reliability, and responsiveness. We offer a stimulating work environment and attractive opportunities for advancement.

In this position, you will be eligible for the following perks:

  • Flexible work schedule
  • Permanent full-time position
  • Comprehensive benefits (medical, dental, vision, RRSP, vacation, personal days, virtual medical clinic, public transportation rebates, social activities)
  • Ongoing learning and development opportunities

Work Location

Occasional visits to our Montreal office may be required or encouraged.

﻿About Indero

Indero is a contract research organization (CRO) specialized in clinical trials. Based in Montreal, we have built a strong reputation for the quality of our research and services that exceed client expectations. Indero continues to grow and expand across North America and Europe.

Indero is committed to providing equitable treatment and equal opportunity to all individuals. Accommodations are available throughout the recruitment and selection process for applicants with disabilities, upon request.

Please note that Indero only accepts applicants who are legally authorized to work in Canada.

Description de poste

Le ou la spécialiste juridique soutient le Service juridique en fournissant un soutien juridique et administratif efficace, précis et en temps opportun relativement aux activités de recherche clinique de l’entreprise. La personne titulaire du poste contribue notamment à la gestion des contrats, à la gouvernance d’entreprise, au soutien en matière de conformité réglementaire ainsi qu’à la gestion de la documentation juridique, conformément aux lois et règlements applicables ainsi qu’aux politiques internes encadrant les activités de recherche clinique.

Plus précisément, le ou la spécialiste juridique doit :

  • Participer à la préparation, à la révision, à la coordination et à l’administration des contrats liés aux activités de recherche clinique, notamment :les ententes relatives aux essais cliniques (Clinical Trial Agreements, CTA); les ententes de confidentialité (Confidential Disclosure Agreements, CDA); les ententes avec les fournisseurs et les consultants; les modifications et avenants contractuels.
  • Coordonner les processus d’exécution des contrats, notamment le suivi des signatures, des versions et des approbations.
  • Tenir à jour les bases de données contractuelles, les outils de suivi et les systèmes de gestion documentaire.

jobs.title: Senior Research Scientist, AI & Workforce Intelligence
jobs.excerpt: About UsWork a four-day week from anywhere for a company where people genuinely believe in what they do.
jobs.description:
About Us

Work a four-day week from anywhere for a company where people genuinely believe in what they do. Wonderlic leads the way in fair, predictive science to create a world where everyone finds and thrives in their best job—and that starts with you. We expertly combine our science-based assessment expertise with I-O psychology, machine learning, and artificial intelligence to deliver evidence-based insights that empower smarter employment decisions. Our simple, intuitive assessment tools help sophisticated HR teams identify top applicants, predict on-the-job performance, and ensure our own team is engaged and equipped to do their best work.

Wonderlic has always championed progressive, sustainable approaches that allow people to excel professionally while living balanced, fulfilling lives.Here are some of the ways we do that: 

  • Work from anywhere in the United States 
  • Four-day work week
  • Generous PTO plus a paid company shutdown from 12/24 to 1/1
  • Benefits include medical, dental, vision, 401k with matching, paid new parent leave

What Sets Us Apart:

  • Scientific Precision: We apply rigorous scientific methodologies to develop assessments that accurately gauge individuals' potential and fit within various organizational contexts.
  • Innovation: Our dedication to continuous improvement drives us to explore cutting-edge techniques and technologies, ensuring our assessments remain at the forefront of talent assessment.
  • Impactful Solutions: By integrating I-O Psychology principles into our processes, we deliver solutions that not only meet the immediate hiring needs of organizations but also contribute to long-term success and retention.

Overview:

Wonderlic is seeking a Senior Research Scientist to sit at the precise intersection of I-O psychology and machine learning - someone who has spent time building real systems with real data who cares deeply about what those systems are predicting. This is not a role for an ML engineer who finds people data interesting as a side project, or for an I-O psychologist who has learned to code. We’re looking for someone who has genuinely lived in both worlds and is ready to own the problems that live between them.

Wonderlic built its applied AI/ML team from scratch, developed the Jobs Engine, a first-of-its-kind machine learning system for job analysis at scale, and won the 2025 SIOP Machine Learning Competition. We’re now refining and expanding that work to deliver sharper, richer job analysis insights across thousands of roles. You will own the continued improvement of our jobs engine, the system that ingests labor market data and produces job analysis at scale across thousands of roles, and serve as one of the organization’s experts on how AI should be applied to both employee selection and development.

Your Impact:

As Senior Research Scientist, you will set the scientific and technical direction for how Wonderlic understands work at scale and translates assessment science into AI-powered insight. Your work will directly determine the quality, defensibility, and reach of the inferences our platform makes about jobs and people - inferences that drive hiring decisions, development plans, and coaching conversations for millions of users. You will be the person in the organization who can hold both the I-O science question and the production ML question in the same breath, and answer both.

What You’ll Do

Lead the Continued Development of the Jobs Engine: Own the architecture, integrity, and continuous expansion of Wonderlic’s AI job analysis system, which ingests labor market data from O*NET, LinkedIn, Indeed, and other sources to extrapolate cognitive complexity ratings, norm groups, and occupational interest profiles for thousands of jobs. Build and refine the models that make inferences about work content from unstructured text. Leverage existing occupational taxonomies (e.g., O*NET, ESCO) where appropriate but also expand beyond them. Ensure all outputs are scientifically defensible and scalable as the nature of work evolves.

Act as an Expert on AI Implementation Across the Organization: Partner with product managers, engineers, and I-O psychologists to translate scientific requirements into AI-powered systems and ensure those systems meet the standards the work demands. Advise on which approaches are best suited to specific implementation challenges - assessment interpretation, manager and teams reporting, coaching content - and help teams understand what good looks like before they build and after they ship. Serve as an internal resource on what ML and AI can and cannot do in assessment and organizational contexts, and contribute to Wonderlic’s external scientific credibility.

Drive Scientific Rigor: Apply I-O psychology principles - adverse impact consideration, norm group construction, and evidence-based evaluation standards - to every system you build. Ensure that Wonderlic’s AI products meet professional and legal standards for selection and development tools. Push back when speed is being prioritized at the expense of defensibility, and find pragmatic paths forward when theoretical purity would prevent shipping.

What Success Looks Like: In your first six months, you will have a deep understanding of the jobs engine architecture and shipped at least one meaningful improvement to its coverage, accuracy, or scientific defensibility. You will have established working
relationships with the I-O and Product teams and have a clear roadmap for the continued integration of AI into the platform.

Within a year, you will have materially expanded the jobs engine’s reach and accuracy with demonstrable improvements to its coverage and the quality of inferences it produces. You will have contributed to the continued integration of AI across the platform, and be the person your colleagues go to with the hardest ML-meets-IO-science problems - not because you have every answer, but because you know how to find them.

The long-term marker of success is a jobs engine that provides defensible, scaled job analysis inference across millions of roles using a wide variety of inputs, AI capabilities integrated into the platform in ways that hold up to scientific and professional scrutiny, and a track record of using these technologies to improve people’s understanding of themselves, their work, and their teams. You will also have helped to develop new assessments that leverage emerging technologies which allow for richer and more secure evaluation of individuals.

What We’re Looking For:

Skills & Capabilities:

  • Applied NLP and ML engineering skills: embeddings, semantic search, clustering, text classification, transformer architectures, model tuning and evaluation, all on potentially messy, unstructured data
  • Occupational data modeling: job titles, task statements, skills, competencies, credentials, job families, seniority levels, title normalization, job similarity, role differentiation, and occupational frameworks such as O*NET and ESCO
  • Responsible AI judgment in employment contexts: fairness, explainability, auditability, bias mitigation, human review, and legal and ethical considerations in AI-supported selection and employee development systems
  • Generative AI evaluation skills: rubric-based review, groundedness checks, error analysis, regression testing, and evaluation of LLM-generated job descriptions, work-context summaries, and assessment result contextualization.
  • Product judgment for applied ML systems: balancing accuracy, explainability, automation, expert review, user input, maintainability, uncertainty, and job-specific nuance.
  • Working fluency with assessment and I/O concepts: job relatedness, criterion relationships, adverse impact, norm groups, assessment profiles, and score interpretation.
  • Ability to own ambiguous, high-complexity problems: framing underspecified problems, challenging weak assumptions, learning domain constraints quickly, and driving durable solutions in a small-company environment.

Mindset:

  • You came to I-O psychology because you care about work - what makes it meaningful, who thrives in it, how to measure fit. That hasn’t changed.
  • You have a healthy relationship with “good enough”: you know that perfect is the enemy of shipped, and you have the judgment to know where the line is.
  • You can hold both worlds simultaneously: what does this score mean for a real person, and how do I build the system that generates it.
  • You are genuinely curious about the problems that exist for both employee selection and development, not just tolerant of them.
  • You thrive in an environment that requires creativity and scrappiness: you can work comfortably in a situation where the problems are hard, the team is small, the constraints are many, and the ownership is real.

Qualifications

  • Graduate degree in I-O Psychology, Organizational Psychology, Organizational Development, or closely related field (quantitative focus strongly preferred); doctoral degree a plus
  • Demonstrated ML engineering experience with shipped, production-grade systems - not just research or coursework
  • Experience applying modern NLP methods to behavioral, assessment-based, or labor market data
  • Track record of work that had to be both technically sound and legally/professionally defensible
  • Minimum 3 years of applied industry experience; 5+ years preferred
  • Experience at the intersection of I-O science and algorithmic fairness strongly preferred
  • Familiarity with occupational taxonomies, vocational interests, or cognitive ability frameworks a significant plus

Compensation:

  • $130,000 to $150,000 based on experience and expertise.

Our Policy

jobs.description:
About ABC Legal

ABC Legal Services is the national leader in filing service of legal documents — the physical delivery of court paperwork required by law. We're a team of 1,100+ with offices in New York, Los Angeles, Dallas, Tampa, Chicago, Washington DC, and more. Seattle is our headquarters. We've led this industry for over 40 years and continue investing in technology and process to stay ahead of the competition.

What This Role Actually Is

Process servers are the independent contractors who physically deliver legal documents (like lawsuits and subpoenas) to the people named in them — a legally regulated, time-sensitive service. ABC coordinates a network of these contractors nationwide.

This role owns that network end-to-end in our two highest-priority markets: Arizona and Texas. You're responsible for making sure there are enough servers in the right places, that the highest-volume ones stay engaged and paid fairly, and that when something breaks, like a coverage gap, a slow region, a compliance issue, you catch it before a dashboard does and fix it.

This is a marketplace operations role, similar to what a strong regional lead at a gig, delivery, or field-service company does, which is balancing local supply and demand using data you go get yourself, not data someone hands you.

While this is a remote position, frequent travel to AZ or TX is expected.

What You'll Own

  • Supply and demand balance across AZ and TX — identifying coverage gaps, recruiting new process servers, setting dispatch strategy, and growing server capacity in your priority markets
  • Early problem detection — spotting where performance is slipping and diagnosing the root cause before it appears on a formal scorecard
  • Relationships with the region's highest-volume servers — you're the face of ABC in-market, not a name on an email chain
  • Root cause analysis — when something's off, you define the actual problem and bring a recommended fix, not just a flag
  • Incident response for your region — app outages, dispatch bottlenecks, weather disruptions — you're the real-time point of contact for the network and leadership
  • Marketplace pilots — running in-market tests, tracking real results, and reporting back fast and honestly, in partnership with project managers
  • Regional incentive budget, within limits set with your Sr. Director — you flag overspend before finance does
  • Regional performance reporting — coverage gap closure, service-level attainment by tier, and overall market health
  • Direct management of W2 (full-time employee) staff on your team, including approving timecards and running performance reviews
  • Feeding what you learn back incentive design, dispatch rules, and pay structures improve across ABC's other markets

What We're Looking For

You've owned a local market, territory, or region for a gig, delivery, or field-service business — ideally one that was underperforming when you took it on. What matters most:

  • You've balanced supply and demand yourself, combining what you see in-market with data you collected
  • You've coached someone in a frontline or contract role to a real improvement in performance, and can talk specifically about how
  • You've managed full-time (W2) employees through the formal parts of the job: timecards, performance reviews
  • You want to run experiments, iterate fast, and scale what works
  • You want to be on the ground in the market — this is not a remote strategy seat, even though the role is remote-eligible
  • Experience owning a local market, territory, or region in a marketplace, gig, or field-operations environment
  • A self-starting data habit: you pull your own numbers rather than wait for a report, and you know what to ask next when you look at a dispatch or service-level dashboard
  • Comfortable partnering with project managers to scope and execute in-market initiatives
  • At least one direct report you can speak to specifically — not just headcount, but how you coached them
  • Strong written communication — leadership shouldn't have to chase you for a market-health update

Preferred Qualifications

  • Has run structured pilots with clear hypotheses and turned the results into something that scaled elsewhere
  • SQL or dashboard fluency (Metabase, Looker, or similar) you want the underlying data, not a summary of it
  • Comfortable in Jira (or similar) for scoping/tracking pilots, and in a tool like Intercom for network-facing communication
  • Experience building in ambiguous environments where the playbook didn't already exist
  • Has coached someone in a contract or hourly role and understands how that differs from managing an employee

Benefits

  • Health, Dental, Vision insurance
  • 401(k) with company matching
  • Paid time off, 7 paid company holidays, 4 floating holidays/year
  • Life Insurance and AD&D Insurance
  • Long Term Disability
  • Health Care and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Pet Insurance



Pay: $70,000–$85,000, (depending on experience)
Schedule: Full-time, Monday–Friday
Travel: ~20% Location: Remote, but must reside in Arizona or Texas

- Working knowledge of cloud-native environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and how controls apply in practice
- Familiarity with legal or regulated-industry data requirements is a plus

Skills
- Clear written communication — you'll be writing policies, audit responses, and customer facing materials
- Technically fluent enough to engage in and evaluate critically architecture reviews and engineering threads, evaluate proposed control fixes, and identify gaps that a purely compliance-focused lens would miss
- Organization under pressure — audit cycles don't move, and you'll manage multiple workstreams simultaneously
- Collaborative — compliance happens through engineering, legal, and operations, not around them Credentials (one or more preferred)

  • Ability to embrace change and adapt to ensure excellent student outcomes
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Outlook, Word; PowerPoint
  • Ability to rapidly learn and adapt to new technologies and teaching platforms
  • Strong written/verbal communication skills

This is a full-time role based in Philippines

Staff Expense & Claims Management

Corporate Credit Card Reconciliation

  • Perform monthly reconciliation of corporate credit card statements for both billable and non-billable expenses.
  • Ensure all credit card transactions are accurately mapped to the correct job code, GL code, and cost center.
  • Partner with cardholders to obtain supporting documentation and ensure timely submission of expense reports.
  • Support ongoing enhancements to credit card workflows and controls within Navan.

Navan System Ownership & Support

  • Act as a key operational contact for Navan, supporting the Accounting Supervisor day-to-day administration and user support.
  • Assist with Navan configuration updates, policy enforcement, and system enhancements as required.
  • Support testing, rollouts, and documentation of new Navan features, workflows, or policy changes.
  • Serve as a liaison between Finance, People, and Systems teams to ensure Navan aligns with accounting and compliance requirements.

Process & Compliance

  • Maintain high standards of data integrity across all expense and credit card records.
  • Act as a gatekeeper for expense policy compliance and provide guidance and reminders to employees as needed.
  • Support audit requests related to expenses, credit cards, and internal controls.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and improve expense and AP-related processes.

REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

We value both experience and mindset — these qualifications help set you up for success:

  • 2–3 years of experience in Accounts Payable, Expense Management, or General Accounting (advertising/media agency experience is a plus).

  • Comfortable with job code and GL coding logic in a project-based environment.

  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams and regions.
  • Clear, approachable communicator who is proactive and solution-oriented.
  • Curious mindset with a strong interest in process improvement and automation.

Bonus Points If You…

  • Have experience supporting US finance operations in a global or multi-entity environment.
  • Understand billable vs non-billable expense treatment in a project-based or agency setting.
  • Have worked with other expense platforms such as Expensify, Concur, or similar tools.
  • Have supported system rollouts, policy updates, or finance process documentation.

Think “lab” and not “agency”. We get excited about solving business problems, not creating advertising for the sake of making advertising. Our entrepreneurship DNA runs deep. We’re willing to break rules, try new things, and test hypotheses if it means better understanding our craft. It’s fun!

jobs.title: Major Gifts & Development Associate
jobs.excerpt: Since our founding, Parity Homes has raised over $15 million — driven almost entirely by our CEO, who has built relationships with major donors, foundations, and community investors from the ground up.
jobs.description:
Since our founding, Parity Homes has raised over $15 million — driven almost entirely by our CEO, who has built relationships with major donors, foundations, and community investors from the ground up. We are looking for someone to professionalize and systematize what we’ve built so we can grow in scale without that growth depending on one person.

We are looking for a Major Gifts & Development Associate who brings ambition, drive, and genuine relationship instincts to this work. Someone who is energized by the pursuit — identifying prospects, opening doors, building authentic relationships, and seeing major commitments through to close. Writing is a key part of this role, but it is a means to an end. The end is securing transformational funding from donors giving at the $2M–$5M level.

You will work closely with our CEO to drive major donor cultivation from research through close. You will think strategically, act proactively, and take ownership of the pipeline. You write because it moves people to invest in communities — not because you love formatting reports.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Research and profile major donors, foundations, and conference attendees in advance of CEO engagements — so every meeting is maximized.
  • Own the follow-up. Draft outreach emails, thank-you notes, and cultivation communications as the CEO, ensuring the right tone, timing, and next step.
  • Move donors through the cultivation pipeline — from initial contact to scheduled meeting to funded commitment.
  • Identify and track grant opportunities aligned with Parity’s mission and manage submission calendars end-to-end.
  • Write compelling grant proposals, letters of inquiry, donor reports, and major gift case statements.
  • Prepare the CEO for speaking engagements and conferences by building briefing materials that surface funding opportunities.
  • Maintain and update the donor CRM, ensuring the pipeline is always current and actionable.
  • Proactively surface new funding strategies and prospect ideas — you don’t wait to be told where to look.

Requirements

  • Experience in business development, nonprofit development, major gifts, or a donor-facing fundraising role — we care more about your track record than your title.
  • Demonstrated success writing grant proposals or major donor communications that resulted in funding.
  • Familiarity with donor cultivation strategy and the major gifts cycle.
  • Comfort operating as an extension of a CEO or senior leader — drafting in their voice, representing their brand, and owning the follow-through.
  • Experience working in a startup, early-stage organization, or resource-constrained environment is a genuine plus.
  • CRM experience (any platform) is helpful but not required.

Who You Are

  • You are scrappy and resourceful. You figure things out. You don’t wait for a system to exist, you build one.
  • You are relationship-oriented. You understand that major donors are people, not line items, and you know how to cultivate trust over time.
  • You are a strategic thinker. You don’t just execute tasks — you see the board and know which moves matter.
  • You are an excellent writer. Your words are clear, compelling, and calibrated to the reader — whether that’s a foundation program officer or a high-net-worth individual.
  • You are driven by outcomes. You want to land big asks and you measure your own success by impact, not activity.
  • You are mission-aligned. You care about equitable development, community ownership, and the kind of work Parity is doing — and that comes through in how you represent the organization.
  • You are comfortable working independently in a remote, startup environment with limited hand-holding and high expectations.
  • You are energized by building something — you don’t need a fully developed infrastructure around you to do your best work.
  • You are drawn to organizations doing real, ground-level work and you want to be close to the mission, not at a remove from it.
  • You see writing as one of many tools in your repertoire — and the goal is always to move people toward meaningful investment.

Benefits

  • Fully remote, global
  • $1,500 - $1,800 monthly commensurate with experience
  • Generous PTO

jobs.description:
Job Title: Information Systems Security Engineer (ISSE)Job Category: Information TechnologyTime Type: Full timeMinimum Clearance Required to Start: Top SecretEmployee Type: RegularPercentage of Travel Required: Up to 10%Type of Travel: Continental US* * *

The Opportunity:


CACI is seeking an experienced Cybersecurity / Information Assurance (IA) professional to support Navy Medicine Online (NMO) and its mission-critical information systems.


Working collaboratively with the NMO Information System Security Manager (ISSM), Information System Security Officer (ISSO), and government cybersecurity stakeholders, you will help assess, strengthen, and maintain the security posture of multiple computing environments. This position will conduct and review technical security assessments, identify vulnerabilities, threat vectors, potential threat actors, and areas of non-compliance with established cybersecurity and Information Assurance requirements, and recommend appropriate mitigation strategies.


You will support the development, implementation, and documentation of formal cybersecurity programs, policies, procedures, and controls while monitoring ongoing compliance. The role will actively support the Risk Management Framework (RMF) process in accordance with Defense Health Agency (DHA) requirements, including Annual Security Reviews (ASRs), Authority to Operate (ATO) activities, and Independent Verification and Validation (IV&V) reviews.


Artificial Intelligence (AI) is also an important component of this environment. You will leverage approved AI capabilities to enhance cybersecurity activities, automation, analysis, and operational efficiency while partnering with the ISSM and ISSO teams to help maintain the security posture of AI-assisted development across NMO.


Responsibilities:


  • Conduct and review technical security assessments across multiple computing environments to identify vulnerabilities, threat vectors, security risks, and non-compliance with applicable cybersecurity standards and requirements.
  • Support the implementation and ongoing execution of the Risk Management Framework (RMF), including security control assessments, documentation, remediation activities, and continuous monitoring.
  • Support Annual Security Reviews (ASRs), Authority to Operate (ATO) activities, and IV&V assessments in accordance with DHA, NIST, and applicable Department of Defense cybersecurity requirements.
  • Develop, implement, maintain, and document cybersecurity policies, procedures, controls, and formal security programs.
  • Evaluate identified vulnerabilities and security risks and recommend practical mitigation and remediation strategies.
  • Support vulnerability management, penetration testing, security assessments, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), incident response, and Zero Trust security initiatives.
  • Evaluate network architectures, protocols, firewalls, IDS/IPS technologies, encryption solutions, cloud environments, and associated security vulnerabilities.
  • Partner with ISSMs, ISSOs, system administrators, developers, engineers, and government stakeholders to maintain and continuously improve system security.
  • Leverage approved AI platforms, models, programming, and scripting capabilities to support cybersecurity analysis, automation, documentation, and operational activities.
  • Assess cybersecurity considerations associated with AI-assisted software development and help ensure AI-enabled solutions are implemented in accordance with established security requirements.
  • Participate in cybersecurity incident response activities, including analysis, documentation, remediation, and recommendations for preventing recurrence.
  • Prepare and maintain security documentation, assessment results, findings, remediation plans, and other cybersecurity artifacts required to support compliance and authorization activities.
  • Communicate cybersecurity risks, findings, recommendations, and remediation requirements clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Qualifications:

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline.
  • Professional cybersecurity certification such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, CEH, or a comparable industry-recognized certification.
  • Experience conducting Annual Security Reviews (ASRs), IV&V activities, or comparable security assessments using NIST frameworks and cybersecurity standards.
  • Experience supporting Risk Management Framework (RMF), security authorization, assessment, compliance, or continuous monitoring activities.
  • Experience with vulnerability management, security assessments, penetration testing, Data Loss Prevention (DLP) best practices, and Zero Trust principles.
  • Strong knowledge of network architectures and protocols, firewalls, IDS/IPS technologies, encryption, and associated vulnerabilities.
  • Familiarity with cloud security concepts, controls, and best practices.
  • Experience assessing cybersecurity risks and developing or implementing appropriate mitigation strategies.
  • Proficiency with AI platforms and models, including experience applying AI and programming or scripting capabilities to automation, analysis, or technical workflows.
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity incident response methodologies and practices.
  • Demonstrated analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate cybersecurity concepts and risks to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively within multidisciplinary teams while also working independently with minimal supervision.
  • Active Top Secret security clearance required.

Desired

  • Familiarity with Search Processing Language (SPL), Microsoft Visio, eMASS, ALM, and Confluence.
  • Prior experience supporting the U.S. Navy, Defense Health Agency (DHA), Bureau of Medicine and Surgery (BUMED), Department of Defense, or other military organizations.
  • Experience supporting Navy Medicine operations and mission environments.
  • Knowledge or experience related to Individual and Unit Readiness, medical waiver processing, and Global Health Engagements.
  • Experience securing or assessing AI-enabled applications, AI-assisted development environments, or emerging technologies within regulated or government environments.
-

What You Can Expect:

A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

Pay Range:

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.

Since this position can be worked in more than one location, the range shown is the national average for the position.

The proposed salary range for this position is:

$75,200-$158,100

Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. You'll work on systems at the heart of Upstart's lending marketplace. The software your team builds determines how borrowers are matched with capital, how offers are constructed, and how marketplace decisions are executed in real time. It's an opportunity to solve challenging distributed systems problems while building software with direct, measurable impact on borrowers, investors, and the business.

  • Experience with event-driven architectures, Kafka, workflow orchestration, or real-time data processing
  • Experience partnering with Machine Learning or Data Science teams
  • Experience improving platform scalability and evolving distributed system architecture

jobs.excerpt: About Keyfactor Our mission is to securely connect the world: humans, machines, and AI.
jobs.description:
About Keyfactor

Our mission is to securely connect the world: humans, machines, and AI. Keyfactor is the leader in trust infrastructure for AI and machines, helping the world's largest enterprises and government agencies take control of the cryptographic identities that safeguard every digital interaction. Behind the platform is a global team of people who care deeply about the work and each other. We move fast, think big, and show up for one another every day. If you're looking for work that matters and a team that brings out your best, we hope you'll trust your future with Keyfactor!

Title: Sr. Federal Channel Account Manager

Location: United States, DC, VA, MD (Remote)

Experience: Senior Level

Job Function: Channel

Employment Type: Full-Time

Travel: 40-60%

Industry: Computer and Network Security

About the position

Keyfactor is seeking an experienced, high-performing Federal Channel Manager to lead, develop, and scale our indirect sales ecosystem within the U.S. Federal Government sector. Keyfactor is the market leader in PKI, CLM, and Quantum Readiness — securing connection keys, certificates, and cryptographic assets for the world's most demanding organizations.
This role exists to own and grow Keyfactor's relationships with the Value-Added Resellers (VARs) and Federal Systems Integrators (FSIs) that federal agencies already buy through. You will sit at the intersection of cutting-edge enterprise cybersecurity and complex public-sector procurement, managing the two-tier distribution relationships — VAR, FSI, and specialized federal distributor. Your primary objective is to deepen those partner relationships to the point where Keyfactor is the default PKI/CLM/PQC answer inside every major government modernization initiative they touch.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

Responsibilities

• VAR & FSI Relationship Management (Primary Focus): Serve as Keyfactor's senior relationship owner for our federal VAR and FSI network. Build multi-threaded relationships across capture, contracts, sales, and technical teams at major FSIs (e.g., IBM, Booz Allen Hamilton) and premier public-sector VARs/distributors (e.g., Carahsoft, Norseman, Merlin, WWT and several others). Run a disciplined cadence of QBRs, joint planning sessions, and executive check-ins to keep Keyfactor top-of-mind as these partners shape agency solutions.
• Partner Strategy & Business Planning: Build, maintain, and execute joint business plans with each strategic VAR and FSI, with clear shared targets for pipeline, bookings, and named-account coverage.
• Revenue & Pipeline Generation: Drive predictable SaaS and on-premises software revenue growth through the VAR/FSI channel to meet or exceed quarterly and annual sales quotas, with VAR/FSI-sourced and influenced pipeline tracked as a distinct, reportable category.
• Contract Vehicle Alignment: Ensure Keyfactor solutions are easily accessible by federal agencies by aligning VAR and FSI sales activity with primary contract vehicles (e.g., GSA Schedules, SEWP), and by making sure the right partner is positioned on the right vehicle for each opportunity.
• Partner Enablement & Co-Selling: Deliver product positioning, market strategy, and compliance training to VAR and FSI sales and technical teams. Work directly with partner reps day-to-day to co-sell and position Keyfactor within active government deals — this is a hands-on, in-the-deal relationship, not a periodic check-in.
• Deal Capture & RFP Management: Collaborate closely with VAR/FSI capture teams, internal federal field sales directors, and sales engineers to identify, qualify, and win federal RFPs and bids, including shaping requirements language with FSI partners ahead of formal solicitation where appropriate.
• Channel Conflict & Governance: Manage deal registration, partner-of-record decisions, and channel conflict across a multi-VAR, multi-FSI environment so partners trust Keyfactor as a fair and predictable channel partner.
• Sales Forecasting: Maintain accurate and timely VAR/FSI partner pipeline data within CRM systems, leveraging structured sales qualification methodologies.

Minimum Experience

• Experience: 5+ years of proven software channel management or indirect sales experience specifically focused on the U.S. Federal Government ecosystem (DoD, Intelligence, and Civilian agencies), with demonstrated success building and scaling relationships with federal VARs/distributors and FSIs/prime contractors specifically — not generalist channel experience.
• Two-Tier Distribution Fluency: Deep, practical knowledge of the federal two-tier distribution model and how VARs, aggregators, and FSIs each make money, make decisions, and choose which vendors to champion.
• Cyber Security Expertise: Strong foundation in IT security infrastructure, Identity and Access Management (IAM), Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), cryptography, or cloudnative security.
• Procurement Acumen: In-depth knowledge of the Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR) and the federal capture process.
• Sales Methodology: Fluency in enterprise sales execution frameworks such as MEDDPICC or MEDDIC.
• Communication: Exceptional communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, with the ability to influence executive-level stakeholders inside partner organizations, not just within Keyfactor.

Preferred
• Location: Based in the Washington, D.C., Northern Virginia, or Maryland (DMV) metro area to facilitate regular on-site VAR and FSI partner collaboration.
• Education: Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Information Technology, Cyber Security, or a related field.

Compensation

Salary will be commensurate with experience. 

Culture, Career Opportunities and Benefits

We build teams that continually strive to get better than the day before. You will be challenged daily and given opportunities to grow personally and professionally. We balance autonomy and structure to create an entrepreneurial environment to spur creativity and new ideas. 

Here are just some of the initiatives that make our culture special:  

  • Second Fridays (a company-wide day off on the second Friday of every month minus November and December due to the Holiday schedule). Please note that this benefit is subject to change.
  • Comprehensive benefit coverage globally.
  • Paid Parental Leave is available to new parents. Structure varies based on regional/government requirements. In regions where government-paid leave doesn’t exist, like in the U.S., the company offers generous paid parental leave, along with comprehensive adoption and fertility support.
  • Competitive time off globally.
  • Dedicated employee-focused ambassadors via Key Contributors & Culture Committees.
  • DIVERSE Commitment, a call to action for a more inclusive and diverse future in business, society, and technology.
  • The Keyfactor Alliance Program to support DEIB efforts.
  • Wellbeing resources, wellness allowance, mindfulness app free membership, Wellness Wednesdays.
  • Global Volunteer Day, company non-profit matching, and 3 volunteer days off.
  • Monthly Talent development and Cross Functional meetings to support professional development.
  • Regular All Hands meetings – followed by group gatherings.

Our Core Values

Our core values are extremely important to how we run our business and what we look for in every team member:  

Trust is paramount.  

We deliver security software and solutions where trust and openness are of the highest importance for our customers. We are honest and a trusted partner in every aspect of business.  

Customers are core.  

We strategize, operate, and execute through a customer-centric view. We prioritize the security interests of our customers, and we act as if their data were our own.  

Innovation never stops, it only accelerates.  

The speed of change is accelerating. We are committed, through investment and focus, to stay ahead of the innovation curve.  

We deliver with agility.   

We thrive in high-paced and continually changing environments. We navigate through newly added variables, adjust accordingly, while driving towards our strategic goals.  

United by respect.   

Respect for all is what unites us. We promote diversity, inclusivity, equity, and acting with empathy and openness, both in our business and in our communities.  

Teams make “it” happen.  

Vision and goals are not individually achievable – they require teamwork. We pride ourselves in operating as a cohesive team, creating promoters and partners, and winning as one.  

Keyfactor is a proud equal opportunity employer including but not limited to veterans and individuals with disabilities. 

REASONABLE ACCOMMODATION: Applicants with disabilities may contact a member of Keyfactor’s People team via and/or telephone at 1.216.785.2990 to request and arrange for accommodations at any time.

Keyfactor Privacy Notice
