About Ethos

Ethos is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten.

About the roleEthos is hiring a Director, Marketing Process & Technology to join our Compliance department as a senior leader. This person will own marketing compliance review at Ethos end to end: the process, the technology, and the majority of the reviews themselves. You will be both a hands-on senior reviewer and the owner of the system that performs the review, and you will be charged with a clear mandate: move marketing review toward automation through AI as far as it can defensibly go, without loosening the standard.

You will serve as business owner of the AI tool Ethos uses for marketing review, and you will be measured, in part, on how much of the review volume that tool can absorb and how reliably it performs. At the same time, you will personally handle the judgment calls, escalations, and novel questions that automation should not decide. Beyond the tool, you own the marketing review process itself: intake, prioritization, review standards, approved language, recordkeeping, and the working relationship with Marketing/Brand/business teams. This is a player-coach role. You will carry a real review load from day one and will eventually hire and oversee a compliance analyst to support you, which means building the standards, playbooks, and training that make the work delegable. You will be expected to drive thought leadership on marketing compliance matters across Ethos. Importantly, the candidate must be risk-minded, be a team player, confident in determining acceptable risk, think creatively to always find solutions, and be technology forward.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Own the AI marketing review tool and drive the shift toward automated, AI review, including:

    • Act as business owner and administrator of the tool, including configuration, rule and prompt tuning, testing, and release management
    • Define the automation tiers : what AI approves outright, what AI reviews subject to human confirmation, and what always requires human review
    • Continuously improve automated review quality by measuring the tool’s output against human review, tuning to reduce missed issues, and expanding the categories of content it can handle
    • Establish human-in-the-loop thresholds, sampling, and ongoing QA to validate that the tool remains reliable as content, products, and regulations change
    • Own the auditability of AI-assisted decisions so that any approval can be reconstructed and defended to an examiner, auditor, or carrier
    • Partner with vendors and with internal engineering and data teams on integration, evaluation, and roadmap
    • Grow the share of reviews completed through automation as a primary, measured objective

Own the marketing compliance review process, including:

    • Design and run intake for all marketing review requests, with clear SLAs, routing, and prioritization
    • Maintain the review standards of record , including: review criteria, required disclosures, and the library of pre-approved claims and language
    • Personally perform the majority of reviews and serve as decision-maker on close calls, documenting rationale so decisions accumulate into usable precedent
    • Maintain the recordkeeping and audit trail of submissions, versions, approvals, and conditions of approval
    • Measure and improve throughput, cycle time, and review quality

Cover the full range of marketing content subject to review, including:

    • Consumer-facing marketing across paid media, lifecycle and email, web, brand, and social
    • Agent and producer-facing materials, including recruiting, training, and sales support content
    • Partner, carrier, and co-branded campaign materials
    • Product and disclosure content embedded in online flows, including rate and quote presentation and required disclosures

Keep standards evergreen, including:

    • Translate insurance advertising and marketing regulatory change into concrete review criteria, tool rules, and updated approved language
    • Refresh disclosure and claim libraries as products, state approvals, and carrier requirements change

Partner across the business, including:

    • Embed compliance early in the marketing lifecycle, at brief and concept stage rather than at launch
    • Act as trusted advisor and thought leader to Marketing, Brand, Growth, Product, and Legal
    • Partner with the Compliance Risk Management team so that marketing review controls are documented and independently tested
    • Support advertising filings where required, along with market conduct exams, regulatory requests, carrier requests, and data calls
  • Build and lead the function. You will operate as a hands-on player-coach, then hire, onboard, develop, and manage a compliance analyst as volume and automation maturity allow
  • Own marketing compliance reporting and governance, including review volume, cycle time, automation rate, quality and error rates, and KRIs
  • Assist in drafting and updating marketing compliance policies and procedures
  • Provide general compliance support, as needed, across the team and company, including research and provisioning of compliance guidance across Ethos

Qualifications and Skills:

  • 12+ years of relevant Compliance work experience in the insurance industry, including significant hands-on marketing and advertising review experience
  • Deep expertise in insurance regulatory marketing compliance, including advertising requirements, required disclosures, and advertising filing obligations across states
  • Demonstrated ownership of a high-volume marketing or advertising review function, including the standards and the workflow behind it
  • Hands-on experience putting AI or automation to work inside a compliance review workflow - configuring it, measuring it, and improving it, rather than simply using it
  • Ability to define and defend where automation is appropriate and where human judgment is required, and to evidence that distinction to auditors, examiners, and carriers
  • Strong process design instincts, including: intake, SLAs, prioritization, throughput, and cycle time
  • Comfort working with data to measure review quality and automation performance, and to report both to senior leadership
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
  • Persuasive communicator and thought leader who can hold a firm line with Marketing without becoming a bottleneck
  • Be highly responsive and service-oriented, with a demonstrated ability to maintain strong working relationships with demanding internal clients
  • Experience hiring, developing, and managing an analyst, or clear readiness to do so
  • Possess sound and practical business judgment, and confidence in determining acceptable risk
  • Ability to multi-task and work independently or with cross-functional teams, while adapting quickly to ambiguous and rapidly changing environments
  • Attention to detail
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple deadlines

The DevOps Team Lead owns the delivery, reliability, and day-to-day operation of our AWS cloud platform, an extensive multi-account cloud environment managed as code and expanding toward globally distributed, multi-region workloads.

This is a highly hands-on technical leadership role. You'll be one of the strongest technical contributors on the team while also helping shape and prioritize the work. You'll translate product and engineering needs into infrastructure requirements, guide the team's delivery, and ensure what we build is automated, secure, documented, cost-conscious, and operationally reliable.

The role is approximately 60% hands-on engineering and 40% technical leadership, including requirements, planning, review, coordination, and coaching.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, review, and operate our Infrastructure-as-Code estate across a multi-account AWS environment, including reusable modules, environment configurations, state management, and account provisioning.

  • Own and improve CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure changes, including automated validation, security and compliance controls, and keyless cloud authentication.

  • Build and maintain the core AWS services supporting our products, including networking, containers, databases, storage, messaging, systems management, backup, monitoring, and cost controls.

  • Establish and reinforce practical engineering standards around IaC, IAM, resource tagging, state management, versioning, security, documentation, and operational readiness.

  • Translate ambiguous requests from product, engineering, security, and data teams into clear requirements, milestones, estimates, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.

  • Own and refine the DevOps backlog and facilitate the team's Scrum cadence, including planning, stand-ups, refinement, reviews, and retrospectives.

  • Strengthen platform reliability through observability, SLOs, actionable alerting, runbooks, disaster recovery, backup and restore practices, and continuous reduction of operational toil.

  • Participate in a rotating night and weekend on-call schedule and provide technical leadership during platform incidents, including incident coordination and post-incident follow-through. Rotation frequency will depend on team size and coverage needs but is shared equitably across the team.

  • Partner with security to embed identity, least-privilege access, network segmentation, encryption, secrets management, audit logging, and compliance requirements into the platform.

  • Lead cloud cost visibility and optimization, including tagging, right-sizing, commitment planning, anomaly response, and the cost implications of multi-region architecture.

  • Help evolve the platform toward globally distributed workloads, including regional rollout, data residency and replication, latency-aware routing, cross-region failover, and associated operational tradeoffs.

  • Use AI tools effectively in engineering workflows and help design and operate the cloud infrastructure needed to support emerging AI capabilities.

  • Set technical direction in partnership with architecture and coach engineers through code review, pairing, design discussions, documentation, and shared platform ownership.

What You'll Bring

  • Extensive experience in software engineering, infrastructure, or DevOps, with demonstrated experience operating at a senior or technical lead level in complex cloud environments.

  • Expert-level, current hands-on experience with Terraform or equivalent Infrastructure as Code, including managing large-scale cloud environments through IaC.

  • Experience with IaC at scale, including reusable module design and versioning, state architecture, safe refactoring, upgrades, drift detection and remediation, and bringing legacy infrastructure under IaC management.

  • Deep hands-on AWS experience across compute, storage, networking, IAM, and security, ideally within a multi-account AWS Organization.

  • Proven ownership of infrastructure CI/CD pipelines, including automated policy, validation, and security controls.

  • Experience designing and operating containerized or distributed production workloads with appropriate networking, security, and observability.

  • Scripting proficiency and a track record of automating operational work.

  • Demonstrated ownership of production operations, including on-call, incident response, runbook development, and the ability to independently troubleshoot and resolve platform issues.

  • Experience leading Agile/Scrum practices, including backlog ownership, refinement, estimation, planning, and stakeholder negotiation.

  • Strong ability to turn ambiguous needs into thorough, actionable technical plans that account for requirements, dependencies, risks, milestones, and estimates.

  • Strong understanding of cloud security, compliance, and risk management, including least privilege, zero trust, encryption, and appropriate exception management.

  • Excellent written communication, documentation, and stakeholder engagement skills.

  • A self-directed, collaborative approach with a focus on improving systems rather than repeatedly working around problems.

  • Willingness and ability to participate in a rotating night and weekend on-call schedule and independently manage production incidents while on call.

Preferred Experience

  • Microsoft Azure experience, particularly Azure Cloud Adoption Framework concepts, landing zones, governance, policy, cost management, and IaC tooling.

  • Experience operating globally distributed or multi-region applications, including data replication, global routing, failover, data residency, and regional compliance considerations.

  • Experience with monorepo IaC environments, policy-as-code, IaC security tooling, or automated code-quality platforms.

  • FinOps experience, including tagging-based cost allocation, commitment planning, anomaly detection, and multi-region cost analysis.

  • SRE practices, including SLOs, error budgets, observability, and structured incident management.

  • Experience supporting analytics, data engineering, database, or integration workloads as a platform provider.

  • AWS certification such as Solutions Architect Professional, DevOps Engineer Professional, or Security Specialty.

  • Experience with hybrid connectivity to on-premises environments or improving software development lifecycle practices.

  • Experience provisioning or operating infrastructure for AI/ML platforms, including model serving, vector stores, accelerated compute, or supporting data pipelines.

jobs.excerpt: About UpstartAt Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans.
jobs.description:
About Upstart

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

The Team

Upstart’s Secured Lending organization is building the first-line risk and control infrastructure that will support the next stage of growth across home equity line of credit, auto direct, and auto indirect dealer products. The team helps ensure secured lending products operate with clear governance, durable controls, high-quality execution, and readiness for bank partner and regulatory review.

Loan Salability & First-Line Model Governance is responsible for monitoring portfolio-wide trends across loan salability, asset quality, and model performance. This function looks across the portfolio over time — tracking performance against investor and bank partner thresholds, interpreting model execution patterns, identifying systemic risk, and escalating findings before they become repurchase events, partner concerns, or examination issues.

As the Senior Manager, Loan Salability & First-Line Model Governance at Upstart, you will own this function end-to-end, reporting directly to the Head of Secured Lending. You will lead a small team of analysts and partner closely with Credit Risk, Capital Markets, Model Risk Management, Product, Engineering, Compliance, Legal, Operations, and bank partners to establish the methodology, monitoring cadence, governance materials, and reporting routines that keep Upstart’s secured lending portfolio within risk appetite and exam-ready.

How you'll make an impact

  • Lead the secured lending asset quality and loan salability function across home equity line of credit, auto direct, and auto indirect dealer channels, setting the review methodology, operating cadence, reporting standards, and escalation routines for a small team of asset quality analysts.
  • Monitor portfolio-level salability risk across secured lending channels — tracking eligibility adherence trends, defect patterns, collateral documentation quality, and exception concentrations; escalate repurchase and put-back risk to Capital Markets and bank partners before they affect loan sale execution or partner commitments.
  • Monitor asset quality and portfolio performance indicators tied to salability, including early payment defaults, delinquency, loss severity, prepayment, non-performing loan trends, exception patterns, and threshold breaches.
  • Evaluate origination and channel quality across secured lending programs, including collateral documentation completeness, lien perfection, override trends, pricing consistency, dealer or partner performance, concentration risk, and potential fair lending exposure.
  • Own first-line model implementation and performance oversight for secured lending models, including production model monitoring, threshold tracking, version control, use-case boundaries, model inventory updates, change impact assessment, and escalation of performance degradation or out-of-bounds behavior.
  • Translate loan review findings, portfolio trends, and model performance signals into action by identifying root causes, defining remediation plans, tracking issue closure, and escalating risks before they affect loan sale execution, partner commitments, or regulatory readiness..

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in business-line credit risk, loan quality, asset-backed or secured lending operations, or first-line model governance supporting secured or asset-backed consumer lending products.
  • Experience with loan-level quality review, loan salability oversight, Capital Markets or investor delivery, repurchase or put-back risk, bank partner audits, collateral documentation review, or pre-sale quality control in a regulated lending environment.
  • Experience monitoring portfolio performance and asset quality indicators across multiple origination channels, including early payment default, delinquency, prepayment, loss severity, non-performing loan trends, credit policy exceptions, threshold breaches, or channel-level pricing and fair lending patterns.
  • Experience with first-line model oversight, production model monitoring, model implementation governance, model inventory documentation, or model performance escalation processes.
  • Experience partnering with Capital Markets, investors, bank partners, or funding teams to evaluate loan eligibility, resolve delivery exceptions, interpret investor requirements, and mitigate repurchase, put-back, or make-whole exposure.
  • Experience leading analysts, managing a review function, or owning cross-functional loan salability, asset quality, credit, or first-line model governance programs.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with auto indirect or dealer channel lending dynamics, including pricing discretion, dealer markup, and fair lending considerations relevant to indirect origination channels; ability to partner with fair lending oversight functions to interpret and escalate channel-level findings.
  • Knowledge of secured lending and secondary-market quality expectations, including exposure to first mortgage or asset-backed lending frameworks such as investor eligibility standards, collateral documentation, lien perfection, representations and warranties, defect remediation, trailing performance thresholds, and repurchase or make-whole risk.
  • Knowledge of consumer lending and fair lending requirements relevant to secured products, including Equal Credit Opportunity Act/Regulation B, Unfair, Deceptive, or Abusive Acts or Practices, Fair Credit Reporting Act, TILA/Regulation Z, dealer markup oversight, adverse action, or credit decisioning controls.
  • Ability to evaluate production model execution, validation outputs, fair lending review outputs, underwriting accuracy, pricing consistency, and performance trends against approved thresholds.
  • Skilled in producing exam-ready policy documents, governance materials, issue tracking, executive summaries, and bank partner reporting.
  • Risk or compliance certification, such as Certified Regulatory Compliance Manager, Financial Risk Manager, or equivalent credential.

Position location This role is available in the following locations: Remote

Travel requirements As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in-person sessions’ cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2-4 consecutive days at a time.

At Upstart, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package. The anticipated base salary for this position is expected to be within the below range. Your actual base pay will depend on your geographic location–with our “digital first” philosophy, Upstart uses compensation regions that vary depending on location. Individual pay is also determined by job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

In addition, Upstart provides employees with target bonuses, equity compensation, and generous benefits packages (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k).

United States | Remote - Anticipated Base Salary Range
$172,100—$238,300 USD

What you'll love

At Upstart, our benefits are designed to support your health, financial well-being, family, and personal growth. Here’s what you can expect:

  • Competitive compensation, including base pay, bonus opportunities, and annual equity grants that vest quarterly
  • Retirement benefits to help you plan for the future, including a 401(k) or Group Retirement Savings Plan with a company match of $2 for every $1 contributed, up to $15,000 annually (USD in the US, CAD in Canada)
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) with discounted stock purchase options for eligible employees (US only)
  • Comprehensive health coverage designed to support you and your family, including medical, dental, vision, and wellness resources for US and supplemental health coverage for Canada.
  • Health Savings Account contributions from Upstart for eligible plans (US only)
  • Income protection benefits, including life insurance and disability coverage for added financial security
  • Paid time off, sick leave, and company holidays, in line with local requirements
  • Paid family and parental leave to support caregiving and major life moments (duration varies by country)
  • Family-centered benefits to support fertility, parenthood, and caregiving needs
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) offering mental health support and life-centered resources
  • Financial wellness resources, including access to financial planning tools and a financial concierge service (US Only)
  • Annual wellness allowance to support your physical and emotional well-being and personal development, based on what matters most to you
  • Annual productivity allowance to invest in relevant tools and resources you need to do your best work, no matter where you work from
  • Connection and community through team events, all-company updates, and employee resource groups (ERGs)
  • Onsite perks, including catered lunches and fully stocked micro-kitchens when working from one of our offices in the Bay Area, Austin, Columbus, and New York City

For roles based in Canada, please note that we are not currently able to hire in Quebec.

Upstart is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer. Just as we are dedicated to improving access to affordable credit for all, we are committed to inclusive and fair hiring practices.

Project Services requires a Project Coordinator to manage a churning portfolio of Request for Service (RFS) and Government Reorganization (GR) projects for Government of Alberta (GoA)

This position will:

Scope:

Project Overview

The Project Coordinator will be leading a team in the implementation and execution of information technology projects or are responsible for a complex specialized area within IT. Communication with stakeholders and co-workers will be essential in ensuring that project deliverables meet client expectations. The position will use diverse IT expertise to operate independently on assigned work or provide guidance to others.

This role is responsible for the coordination and completion of IT projects and oversees all aspects of projects. It builds and maintains working relationships with team members, vendors, and other departments involved in the projects while preparing project status reports for upper management.

The Project Coordinator is responsible for the planning, managing, and reporting on projects that range from internal branch or divisional based projects to ones that are single ministry or multi-ministry initiated and vary in scope and size. The Project Coordinator will be responsible for a portfolio of projects and will be responsible for ensuring stakeholder governance is effective, efficient, and constructively moving towards the direction of demonstrating value and benefits.

Examples ofTypes of Projects:

Request for Service (RFS)

  • RFS INFRASTRUCTURE Ministry PM Led Projects
    • New build (New Office/Meeting room, New Floor, New building)
    • Restack/Revamp/Revitalization, Building/Floor Decommission (Decant)
    • Staff Moves (>10 Staff),
  • RFS Technology Hosting / Refresh

Government Reorganization (GR)

  • GR cabinet and ministry changes, name changes
  • GR movement of programs, services and personnel

IT teamsthat might be involved: End User Computing (EUC),Cloud, Servers, Storage, Network, SuperNet, Printer, Video Conferencing, Active Directory, Security Admin, Cybersecurity, etc.

Duties:

  • Follow provided processes for both RFS and GR projects to speed delivery and ensure consistency and efficiency, but welcome to suggest improvements for the team's review.
  • Coordinate the implementation of IT infrastructure.
  • Investigate, analyze, and coordinate the IT changes needed to facilitate a change to department name and/or movement of programs, services and personnel. GR projects involve Microsoft Active Directory and Microsoft file system security in the GoA environment

  • Confirm and/or create business requirements, functional specifications and technical requirements

  • Communicate operation guidelines and policies to the clients.

jobs.description:
Vice President, Compensation Strategy, Design, and Architecture

Let’s be unstoppable together!

Circana is a leading provider of technology, AI, and data solutions for consumer packaged goods companies, manufacturers, and retailers. Our predictive analytics and Liquid Data® platform help clients measure market share, uncover consumer behavior, and drive growth—powered by six decades of expertise and an expansive, high-quality data set.

At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives.  We’re a global company dedicated to fostering inclusivity and belonging. We value and celebrate the unique experiences, cultures, and viewpoints that each individual brings. By embracing a wide range of backgrounds, skills, expertise, and beyond, we create a stronger, more innovative environment for our employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work.  Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana. Learn more at

Role Overview

The VP, Compensation Strategy, Design, and Architecture is responsible for establishing, governing, and evolving Circana's enterprise-wide job architecture and broad-based compensation framework. This role owns the foundational structures that define how work is organized, evaluated, leveled, and compensated globally, ensuring consistency, scalability, and alignment with business and talent strategies.

The VP leads the design and ongoing stewardship of Circana's job architecture, including job families, career streams, level definitions, job evaluation methodologies, leveling criteria, and related governance processes. The role also owns the design of market-aligned compensation structures and frameworks that support equitable, competitive, and consistent pay practices across the organization.

Working closely with Compensation Administration, Total Rewards, Talent Management, HR Business Partners, and business leaders, this role will lead the transformation of Circana's current-state framework into a modern global architecture that supports organizational growth, workforce planning, career development, and compensation decision-making. In partnership with external subject matter experts, the VP will establish sustainable governance practices for maintaining and evolving the architecture over time, including processes for creating, modifying, evaluating, and retiring jobs as business needs evolve.

In addition to designing the future-state framework, this role will play a critical leadership role in driving organizational adoption, stakeholder alignment, and change management to ensure successful implementation of large-scale compensation and workforce architecture transformation initiatives.

Job Responsibilities

Job Architecture Design & Framework Development

  • Own the design and evolution of Circana's global job architecture, including job families, career streams, level definitions, job evaluation methodologies, and leveling criteria.
  • Establish and maintain a consistent enterprise framework for organizing, evaluating, and leveling work across functions, geographies, and business units.
  • Design scalable architecture frameworks that support workforce planning, organizational design, talent mobility, career progression, and compensation decision-making.
  • Develop architecture standards and principles that enable consistency and scalability across the enterprise.
  • Ensure alignment between job architecture, career frameworks, evaluation methodologies, and compensation structures.
  • Partner with Compensation Administration to ensure architecture frameworks can be effectively operationalized, administered, and sustained over time.

Global Pay Structure & Salary Range Design

  • Own the design and evolution of Circana's global salary structure framework, ensuring alignment with the company's job architecture, compensation philosophy, and market position.
  • Develop market-informed salary structures and range methodologies through analysis of external benchmark data, competitive market practices, and internal workforce considerations.
  • Design geographic pay frameworks and market differentiation approaches appropriate to Circana's global operating model.
  • Lead financial modeling and impact assessments for proposed compensation structures in partnership with Finance, Legal, Compensation Strategy, and other key stakeholders.
  • Establish scalable compensation design principles, methodologies, and governance standards that support consistent and equitable pay decisions across the enterprise.
  • Partner with Compensation Administration to operationalize compensation structures and support ongoing administration, market updates, and annual range review processes.
  • Ensure alignment between job architecture, grade structures, salary ranges, and market pricing methodologies to create an integrated and scalable compensation framework.

External Job Evaluation & Architecture Partnership

  • Lead architecture, job evaluation, and workforce design initiatives conducted with external advisors and subject matter experts.
  • Assess and adapt external methodologies and recommendations to align with Circana's business, talent, and compensation objectives.
  • Partner closely with external advisors and consulting firms to guide methodology implementation, translate recommendations into practical business solutions, and ensure successful organizational adoption.
  • Ensure sustainable internal ownership of architecture frameworks, evaluation methodologies, and governance standards.

Job Evaluation Methodology

  • Own and maintain Circana's enterprise job evaluation methodology, including the frameworks, criteria, and standards used to assess, compare, and level work across the organization.
  • Establish consistent evaluation principles and decision-making guidelines to support equitable, transparent, and scalable leveling outcomes globally.
  • Ensure alignment between job evaluation, job architecture, career frameworks, and compensation structures to create an integrated workforce architecture.
  • Design evaluation methodologies that support sustainable pay equity, regulatory compliance, and defensible compensation practices across geographies.
  • Define evaluation standards and documentation requirements to support consistent application of the methodology across the enterprise.
  • Partner with Compensation Administration to operationalize evaluation standards and maintain consistent application of the methodology.

Architecture Governance & Evolution

  • Own the governance and stewardship of Circana's global job architecture, ensuring continued alignment with business strategy, organizational design, and evolving workforce needs.
  • Establish and lead periodic reviews of job families, career streams, level definitions, evaluation methodologies, and architecture standards to maintain the relevance and integrity of the framework.
  • Define and oversee architecture decision rights, governance processes, and approval mechanisms for creating, modifying, consolidating, and retiring jobs and job families.
  • Lead enterprise-wide architecture reviews associated with reorganizations, acquisitions, new business models, emerging skills, and significant workforce changes.
  • Monitor architecture health, consistency, and adoption across functions and geographies, addressing exceptions and governance issues as needed.
  • Partner with Compensation Administration, Talent Management, HR Business Partners, and business leaders to ensure consistent application of architecture standards and decision-making frameworks.
  • Lead change management, stakeholder engagement, and organizational readiness activities associated with compensation, job architecture, and workforce framework transformation initiatives.

Career Frameworks & Talent Alignment

  • Partner with Talent Management, HR Business Partners, and business leaders to align job architecture with career development, workforce planning, organizational design, and talent management strategies.
  • Ensure job families, career streams, and level definitions support clear and consistent career progression opportunities across the enterprise.
  • Establish architecture standards that enable talent mobility, career growth, succession planning, and workforce planning across functions and geographies.
  • Collaborate with Talent Management to align career frameworks, competency models, and development pathways with the broader job architecture.
  • Provide thought leadership on the intersection of workforce architecture, career progression, and organizational effectiveness to support evolving business and talent needs.
  • Serve as a strategic advisor to business leaders and HR stakeholders, translating compensation and workforce architecture principles into practical solutions that support organizational effectiveness and evolving business needs.

Compensation Framework Governance

  • Own the governance framework for Circana's global salary structures, including range design methodologies, market positioning approaches, geographic pay strategies, and compensation design principles.
  • Lead periodic strategic reviews of compensation frameworks to ensure continued alignment with market conditions, business strategy, workforce needs, and compensation philosophy.
  • Evaluate emerging compensation trends, labor market developments, regulatory changes, and organizational shifts to inform future compensation framework enhancements.
  • Assess the effectiveness of salary structures, geographic pay approaches, and market positioning strategies, recommending changes as business and talent needs evolve.
  • Partner with Compensation Administration to ensure compensation frameworks are effectively operationalized, maintained, and monitored across the enterprise.

Requirements

  • 12+ years of progressive compensation experience, including significant responsibility for job architecture, job evaluation, leveling frameworks, compensation design, and workforce architecture strategy within complex global organizations.
  • Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, and governing enterprise-wide job architecture frameworks across multiple functions, business units, countries, and regions.
  • Deep expertise in job evaluation methodologies and market-leading grading frameworks, including direct experience with Willis Towers Watson, Korn Ferry, Mercer, Aon, or comparable methodologies. Experience implementing, administering, or operating within Willis Towers Watson Global Grading frameworks is strongly preferred.
  • Experience in compensation consulting, workforce architecture consulting, or similar advisory environments is strongly preferred.
  • Strong compensation design expertise, including salary structure development, market pricing methodologies, geographic pay strategies, compensation governance, and broad-based compensation program design.
  • Proven experience leading large-scale job architecture, workforce design, job leveling, or compensation transformation initiatives from strategy and design through implementation, organizational adoption, and long-term governance.
  • Demonstrated experience leading organizational change and global rollouts, including stakeholder alignment, communication, and adoption strategies associated with compensation, workforce architecture, or organizational transformation initiatives.
  • Experience translating external methodologies, market practices, and business requirements into practical enterprise frameworks that support workforce planning, career progression, talent mobility, and compensation decision-making.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and apply governance frameworks, decision-making standards, and operating models that ensure consistency, scalability, and long-term sustainability.
  • Strong financial and analytical capabilities, including workforce modeling, scenario analysis, compensation cost modeling, and assessment of organizational and compensation design alternatives.
  • Experience partnering effectively with Finance, Legal, Employee Relations, Talent Management, HR Business Partners, and business leaders to implement enterprise-wide workforce and compensation initiatives.
  • Demonstrated understanding of global regulatory considerations and pay transparency requirements, including experience supporting EU pay transparency initiatives, works council environments, and country-specific employment practices impacting job architecture and compensation design.
  • Exceptional judgment, influence, consultative leadership, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, challenge assumptions, drive alignment across diverse stakeholder groups, and lead through significant organizational change.
  • Ability to operate as a hands-on individual contributor while leading complex enterprise initiatives, balancing strategic design work with detailed analytical, implementation, and change management responsibilities.

Circana Behaviors

Beyond technical skills, experience, and role-specific attributes, these shared behaviors are fundamental to our culture and success. We seek individuals who consistently demonstrate and champion these behaviors in their daily work:

  • Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions.
  • Seek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action.
  • Own the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices.
  • Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers.
  • Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement.
  • Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity.
  • Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone.

Location: Remote, USA.This position is remote and can be based anywhere in the United States. Given the global scope of the role, candidates should be comfortable working across time zones and partnering with stakeholders in multiple regions.

The below range reflects the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, shift, travel requirements, sales or revenue-based metrics, any collective bargaining agreements, and business or organizational needs. The salary range for this position begins at $200,000 USD and will be determined based on experience, skills, qualifications, and overall alignment with the role. This position is also eligible for an annual bonus.

We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.

An offer of employment may be conditional upon successful completion of a background check in accordance with local legislation and our candidate privacy notice. Your current employer will not be contacted without your permission.

jobs.excerpt: At Qualia, we've built the leading B2B real estate technology that transforms the home buying and selling experience into a simple, secure, and enjoyable process.
jobs.description:
At Qualia, we've built the leading B2B real estate technology that transforms the home buying and selling experience into a simple, secure, and enjoyable process. Our SMB and Enterprise products bring together users from across the real estate ecosystem—homebuyers and sellers, lenders, title and escrow agents, and real estate agents—onto a single shared digital closing platform, providing greater clarity and transparency to real estate transactions. Today, through our business customers across the country, millions of consumers use Qualia to close on homes every year.

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

Within Qualia, you'll join the Payments team. Every real estate closing ends with money changing hands: earnest money deposits, loan funding, mortgage payoffs, seller proceeds, and commissions. Qualia powers a substantial portion of U.S. residential home sales every year, totaling billions of dollars in transaction volume. The Payments team builds the systems that move those funds safely, accurately, and on time.

The stakes are high. A single closing often moves hundreds of thousands of dollars between multiple parties on a tight deadline, and real estate wires are a prime target for fraud. Our mission is to make money movement the most trustworthy part of the closing, so title and escrow teams, and the homebuyers they serve, never have to wonder where their funds are.

HOW WE WORK

Our engineers are entrepreneurial, pragmatic builders who move quickly without cutting corners, and who are as comfortable owning a project end to end as they are collaborating with a team. We ship frequently, as often as multiple times a day, and work directly with design, compliance, and customer-facing teams to build payment experiences our customers depend on.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design, build, and maintain systems that process ACH and wire transfers at scale (billions of dollars annually), including origination, settlement, reconciliation, and exception handling
  • Build and harden payment-processing pipelines that integrate with banking partners, payment rails, and third-party financial APIs
  • Implement controls for wire fraud prevention, transaction verification, and anomaly detection alongside our security and compliance teams
  • Improve and extend core web applications (frontend and backend) that support escrow accounting and closing-day money movement
  • Own architectural decisions for payments infrastructure, including data integrity, idempotency, retry/failure handling, and audit logging
  • Partner with Compliance, Risk, and Accounting stakeholders to ensure systems meet regulatory and audit requirements (e.g., NACHA rules, wire fraud regulations, SOC 2 controls)
  • Participate in on-call rotation for payment-critical systems

YOUR BACKGROUND THAT LIKELY MAKES YOU A MATCH

  • You've taken full ownership of complex, high-liability systems in production, and you know how to respond calmly and methodically when funds are on the line
  • 5+ years of experience as a strong full-stack web developer is required
  • Direct experience building or maintaining other money-movement systems (banking, fintech, payments processors, or similar regulated environments strongly preferred)
  • Strong understanding of transactional integrity, idempotency, and failure-mode design in financial systems
  • Familiarity with payment rails, banking APIs, or financial compliance standards (NACHA, OFAC screening, PCI, SOC 2) is a strong plus
  • You have made key architectural decisions for large, high-stakes projects
  • You have mentored junior developers
  • You have worked on multiple engineering teams, both small and large
  • Good product sense, strong attention to detail, and a passion for building systems people can trust with their money

THE TECH STACK YOU'LL USE

  • JavaScript / TypeScript / NodeJS
  • SPA Frontend libraries like React and MeteorJS
  • MongoDB
  • Microservice architecture / Kubernetes
  • AWS

We are a remote-first development organization that values flexibility in how our teams work. Because of that, while the role is based in Austin, TX, we are open to remote candidates for this position. We have other physical office locations in San Francisco, California, and Concord, New Hampshire.

WHY QUALIA

Qualia is made up of incredibly bright, mission-driven coworkers who are passionate about using technology to solve real-world problems-and we're growing quickly. In order to continue building an engaging and dynamic organization, we're committed to giving everyone the support they need to do great work.

Our benefits package is designed to allow our team members to be their best selves, both in and out of the workplace. In addition to comprehensive health plans, a 401k program, and commuter benefits, we prioritize family and personal well-being through professional development, parental leave, and a flexible time off policy. Qualia offers a robust online onboarding program to train new hires, biweekly all hands meetings, and a variety of internal virtual events to keep employees connected.

We believe diverse perspectives and backgrounds are critical to building great technology, and our goal is to cultivate an environment where people feel equally valued and respected. Qualia is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, age, citizenship, socioeconomic status, disability, or veteran status.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree to the collection, processing, and use of your personal information as described in our Employee Data Privacy Notice.

Named a Top Workplace in the USA and Top Remote Workplace, Kobie is where the best minds in loyalty come together, driven by passion and innovation. We’re always looking for talented individuals who are ready to join a collaborative, growth-focused culture. As a partner to some of the world’s most recognized brands, we are leaders in loyalty, helping brands build lasting emotional connections with their consumers.

Join Us from Anywhere

While our headquarters are nestled in sunny St. Petersburg, Florida, Kobie embraces a flexible work environment, offering teammates the freedom to work remotely. We understand the importance of work-life balance and support our team with:
·Flexible Time Off to recharge when needed
·Nine Company-Wide Holidays
·A diverse suite of benefits prioritizing your growth, development, and personal well-being
Discover more about our perks and benefits here.
Kobie is a values-led organization where we believe that everyone is a leader, regardless of their position or role.
Travel Requirements:
As a remote-first organization headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, Kobie values meaningful in-person connection and collaboration that strengthens our teams, supports our clients, and enhances our culture. While travel requirements vary by role, periodic travel may be required to support business objectives, team collaboration, customer engagements, training, and company events. Candidates should be able and willing to travel as needed to fulfill the responsibilities of the role.

About the team and what we'll build together

    Kobie is a values-led organization where we believe that everyone is a leader, regardless of their position or role. The SA (Solutions Architect) acts as a Kobie SME, investigating client needs through a loyalty lens. They can visualize and articulate client needs, at the intersection of client desired outcomes and Kobie capabilities. They communicate desired client outcomes clearly across workstreams to ensure project success as the enterprise-wide "connective tissue" for a project. During a project, they set the tone for, and manage direction of, the client business solution as they align the team to the associated project scope.

    This role partners closely with Sales, Product, and Delivery, and is remote/hybrid with travel expected up to once per quarter. While it has no direct reports, it owns end-to-end solution scope and cost alignment for standard engagements, setting the bar for solution rigor that other teams rely on.

How you will make an impact

  • Owns Discovery to Define the Right Solution: Elicits and validates business requirements that align client objectives with platform capabilities.
  • Delivers Solution Documentation: Creates and maintains BRDs, SCDs, and Epic/Feature briefs that keep solutions traceable end-to-end.
  • Manages Feasibility and Cost Alignment: Scopes standard engagements independently, coordinating COGS validation across delivery, data, software, CS, and strategy.
  • Aligns Understanding Across Teams: Acts as the connective tissue between business, product, and technical teams throughout each project.
  • Serves as Product and Platform SME: Represents solution expertise in RFPs, RFIs, and upsell conversations.
  • Translates Feedback into Product Direction: Channels client and market insight to shape platform roadmap decisions.
  • Optimizes Sales Enablement: Builds demos, proposals, and pitch materials that establish technical credibility with clients.
  • Owns Solution Acceptance: Maintains design integrity from planning through launch, flagging delivery risks early.
  • Presents Options and Guides Tradeoffs: Helps clients and internal teams weigh scope, cost, and feasibility tradeoffs.
  • Coordinates Pre-Sales to Delivery Handoff: Translates solution intent and decisions so delivery teams avoid rework.
  • Escalates Risk Early: Recognizes when a decision exceeds standard scope and raises it before it becomes a delivery issue.
  • At the End of the First Year, Success Means: Owning solutioning end-to-end, earning trust across Sales, Delivery, and Product, and shaping at least one roadmap decision.

What you need to be successful

    Required

  • 3-5 years of experience in solutions architecture, business requirements analysis, or technical pre-sales within a technology environment.
  • Documents business requirements into BRDs, SCDs, and Epic/Feature briefs that keep solutions traceable from discovery through delivery.
  • Validates delivery cost estimates (COGS) across data/analytics, software, CS, and strategy workstreams to confirm feasibility.
  • Applies Agile/Scrum, waterfall, and iterative delivery methodologies to structure solution plans that fit each client's approach.
  • Builds solution demos, proposals, and pitch materials that establish technical credibility in RFP, RFI, and upsell settings.
  • Coordinates dependencies across marketing, data/analytics, and partner integration workstreams to keep multi-team solutions aligned.
  • Identifies scope drift and delivery risk, translating findings into corrective action plans for delivery and client teams.

    • Strongly Preferred

  • Working knowledge of loyalty marketing programs and mechanics.
  • Delivery experience in retail, financial services, or travel & hospitality.
  • Familiarity with MarTech platforms (e.g., campaign management, CDP, personalization tools) to align solutions with a client's tech stack.
Who we are As a trusted partner, Kobie delivers market-leading, end-to-end loyalty solutions designed to enable customer experiences for the world's most successful brands. We do this with a strategy-led technology approach that uncovers the truth behind what drives consumers on an emotional level. We believe that our team's passion and expertise are the driving forces behind our success and are proud to be named a Top Workplaces in the USA, where the best and brightest in loyalty drive our mission of growing enterprise value through loyalty.
A place for all We celebrate and embrace diversity at Kobie!
Employment at Kobie is based solely on an individual's merit and qualifications, which are directly related to professional competence. We do not discriminate against any teammate or applicant because of race,color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
We are fiercely committed to fostering a workplace where teammates can bring their authentic selves to work every day. Our DEI initiatives, including various committees, ensure that principles of equity, diversity, and inclusion are deeply ingrained throughout Kobie. While our leadership team fully supports our policy of nondiscrimination and equal opportunity, it is the responsibility of all teammates to uphold these values.
Ready to join us? If you’re ready to make an impact and grow in a supportive, innovative environment, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and join the best and brightest in loyalty!

jobs.description:
Vice President, Global Benefits

Let’s be unstoppable together!

Circana is a leading provider of technology, AI, and data solutions for consumer packaged goods companies, manufacturers, and retailers. Our predictive analytics and Liquid Data® platform help clients measure market share, uncover consumer behavior, and drive growth—powered by six decades of expertise and an expansive, high-quality data set.

At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives.  We’re a global company dedicated to fostering inclusivity and belonging. We value and celebrate the unique experiences, cultures, and viewpoints that each individual brings. By embracing a wide range of backgrounds, skills, expertise, and beyond, we create a stronger, more innovative environment for our employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work.  Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana. Learn more at

The VP, Global Benefits partners with the Head of Total Rewards to execute Circana’s global benefits strategy, and is the primary owner of benefits governance, budget, vendor and broker management, regulatory compliance, and operational delivery. This role is accountable for centralizing benefits delivery currently dispersed across regional HR Business Partner teams into a consistent, governed, enterprise capability, in service of Circana’s HR vision of a simple, proactive, and scalable employee experience.

Working closely with Compensation, Total Rewards leadership, HR Technology, Legal, Payroll, Finance, Procurement, HR Business Partners, and business leaders, this role ensures benefits programs are designed and administered consistently, equitably, competitively, and in compliance with local regulatory requirements across all countries in which Circana operates.

The role provides strategic and operational leadership over the global benefits portfolio, builds the governance model, operating model, and data foundation needed for scalable delivery, and leads a growing team of benefits professionals as the function centralizes. This is a unique opportunity to help build and modernize Circana's global benefits capability at a pivotal stage of growth. This role is best suited for a leader who has successfully built, transformed, or centralized benefits capabilities and can quickly establish credibility, influence, and results in a complex global environment.

This is an evolving role, built for how work should be organized in an AI-enabled function. The leader will architect a global team, including virtual and flexible team members, anchored on the organization's most important priorities (determined through our Business Strategy, HR Mission and Vision, and People Strategy), deliberately elevating team members to complex, judgment-driven, and people-centric work while putting automation and AI to work on repetitive, transactional tasks.

Job Responsibilities

Global Benefits Strategy Partnership

  • Partner with the Head of Total Rewards to shape and execute the global benefits strategy, ensuring programs remain market-competitive, cost-effective, and aligned to Circana’s Total Rewards philosophy and talent priorities.
  • Oversee execution of global benefit design, partnering with the Director, Benefit Design, who owns day-to-day design decisions across health & welfare, retirement/pension, wellbeing, and voluntary benefits.
  • Partner with Compensation on the broader Total Rewards Framework to ensure benefits are positioned consistently with pay philosophy and market positioning.

Transformation & M&A Integration

  • Oversee harmonization of benefits plan design led by the Director, Benefit Design, ensuring outcomes align to enterprise strategy and budget.
  • Provide executive sponsorship for benefits due diligence and integration planning for future M&A activity, partnering with the Director, Benefit Design on design execution.
  • Approve new-country benefit program design led by the Director, Benefit Design, ensuring alignment to global strategy and budget.

Governance & Centralization

  • Build and lead the governance model, standards, decision rights, and operating framework needed to centralize benefits administration currently managed by regional HR Business Partners.
  • Establish and lead the transition plan, timeline, and change management approach for migrating benefits from HRBP teams to a centralized Benefit function.
  • Set the standards for global benefits policies, procedures, and documentation, and govern their consistent application across regions.

Vendor, Broker & Financial Management

  • Own broker, carrier, and third-party administrator relationships and contracts globally for material renewals, partnering with Procurement on RFP mechanics and formal vendor process, and using AI-assisted analysis for renewal-package review and first-pass prep.
  • Lead negotiation and final decisions on broker/carrier renewals and RFP outcomes for material renewals, ensuring service quality and cost discipline; routine renewal documentation and coordination is supported by the Benefits Vendor & Systems Coordinator.
  • Own the global benefits budget; monitor spending, forecast costs, and identify efficiency opportunities in partnership with Finance.

Compliance & Regulatory Governance

  • Ensure compliance with applicable benefits regulations across all countries of operation, including ERISA, ACA, and country-specific statutory requirements.
  • Partner with Legal and Total Rewards on regulatory readiness for initiatives such as the EU Pay Transparency Directive and country-specific benefits mandates (e.g., India).
  • Maintain audit readiness, required filings, and documentation for all benefits programs.

Administration, Systems & Data

  • Ensure end-to-end benefits administration — including enrollment, life events, leave of absence coordination, and escalations — is delivered effectively by the Manager, Benefits – Administration & Delivery, determining outsourcing/co-sourcing opportunities as needed.
  • Partner with HR Technology/EE&T on benefits system configuration, data integrity, and integration with the broader HR technology ecosystem, including the Job Architecture data foundation.
  • Establish benefits reporting and analytics that support decision-making — cost, utilization, and compliance data framed to inform plan renewal, vendor negotiation, and design choices, not just tracked for visibility.
  • Leverage AI and automation to redesign repetitive, transactional benefits processes — enrollment, eligibility, compliance monitoring, and reporting — freeing the team’s capacity for higher-judgment, people-centric work.

Employee Experience & Communication

  • Ensure employee sentiment on benefits satisfaction is monitored and incorporated into program design, led by the Director, Benefit Design.
  • Partner with the Director, Benefit Design, who owns the benefits journey map and end-to-end employee experience strategy, ensuring alignment with Circana’s talent strategy and HR Mission and Vision.
  • Provide executive sponsorship for employee communication, education, and enrollment campaigns led by the Director, Benefit Design, in partnership with HR Business Partners and Talent Management.
  • Serve as an escalation point for complex benefits matters, partnering with HR Business Partners during the centralization transition.

Cross-Functional Partnership & Team Leadership

  • Partner with Compensation, Talent Management, Payroll, Legal, Finance, and HR Business Partners to ensure benefits programs support broader Total Rewards and talent strategy.
  • Build and evolve a global team, including virtual and flexible team members, structured around the organization’s most important priorities; deliberately allocating complex, people-centric work to team members and repetitive work to automation and AI as capabilities are built.
  • Partner with Procurement on vendor sourcing, contracting, and cost management strategy for benefits vendors, brokers, and carriers.
  • Leverage partners across the HR organization — including HR Business Partners, Talent Management, and HR Technology — to bring broader expertise and reach global benefits initiatives.
  • Represent Global Benefits in Total Rewards leadership discussions and HRLT initiatives as needed.

Requirements

  • 8+ years of progressive benefits experience, including demonstrated expertise in global benefits design, governance, vendor management, and regulatory compliance.
  • Strong global benefits and regulatory acumen, including deep knowledge of U.S. requirements (ERISA, ACA) and experience navigating multi-country frameworks such as the EU Pay Transparency Directive. Demonstrated experience leading benefits strategy, administration, or governance across multiple countries and regions is required.
  • Fluency in applying AI and automation to redesign operational and administrative processes, with a track record of shifting team capacity from transactional work toward higher-judgment, strategic, and people-centric priorities.
  • Demonstrated experience building, centralizing, harmonizing, or transforming benefits operations, ideally in a multi-country, multi-entity, or post-merger environment.
  • Proven vendor and broker management skills, including RFPs, contract negotiation, and performance governance.
  • Strong financial acumen, with experience owning and managing a global benefits budget.

jobs.description:
Grove Collaborative is a sustainability-focused consumer products company creating household and personal care essentials that are effective, beautifully designed, and healthier for people and the planet. We are a certified B Corp, plastic-neutral, and on a mission to transform the CPG industry for good.

Grove Collaborative is a sustainability-focused consumer products company creating household and personal care essentials that are effective, beautifully designed, and healthier for people and the planet. We are a certified B Corp, plastic-neutral, and on a mission to transform the CPG industry for good.

About the Opportunity

This isn't a role for someone waiting to be told what to build. We want a true self-starter: endlessly curious, genuinely ambitious, and humble enough to be trusted with real influence.

This person will own our internal systems integrations and the delivery of our MCP layer. You'll keep the lights on while identifying incremental improvements, and build the layer that enables the business to become builders and lets agents do real work safely. You'll spend time in both worlds, often in the same week, sometimes in the same day.

You're an enabler with a high level of ownership, ready to flex whatever muscle the day calls for. An integration breaks — you fix it. The business needs new functionality — you build it. Our MCP layer needs a new connection — you stand it up.

You think beyond the fix. We don't just want someone who keeps integrations running — we want someone who's constantly looking for the opportunity to simplify and consolidate them. You know the difference between patching something and rebuilding it onto better infrastructure, and you have a bias toward leaving every system you touch better than you found it, not just functional.

AI isn't an add-on here — it's how the work gets done. This is an AI-enabled role in an AI-enabled organization. You'll use AI tooling to write code, maintain the environment, and move faster across a wider surface area than one engineer could otherwise cover. It's not a tool you reach for occasionally; it's part of your everyday process.

We're just getting started building the infrastructure that lets everyone in the business become a builder. There's no finished playbook. Our MCP layer doesn't have an established pattern for security, access control, or agent tooling yet — you'll help write it, in partnership with the people who own the roadmap.

What You’ll Own

  • Back-office integrations — Maintain and enhance the integrations connecting NetSuite, HighJump, our data warehouse, and adjacent systems. Rebuild individual flows onto better infrastructure when it makes sense to, and know the difference between a fix and a rebuild. Go beyond maintenance to actively look for ways to simplify and consolidate our integration landscape — fewer moving parts, less duplicated logic, systems that are easier for the next person to reason about.
  • Grove Brain / internal MCP layer — Build Grove Brain out from its current early stage into a durable platform other teams build on. Design and implement the connectors and tools that let agents act on real Grove systems.
  • Security, access, and governance for agents — Help define and build how agents authenticate, what they're allowed to touch, and how that's audited, in partnership with the teams who own security and infrastructure rather than setting policy solo.
  • Hands-on enablement — Be the person a team calls when they're stuck mid-build on an integration or an agent problem, whether that's a connector, a permissions question, or a "we don't know what's possible yet" question.
  • Judgment calls — Decide when a systems problem is yours to solve and when it's actually a process problem that belongs to the business.
  • AI-assisted development — Use AI tooling aggressively as a force multiplier, and hold the line on quality while you do it. You should be moving noticeably faster than an engineer working without these tools, without your standards slipping. More on this below.
  • Craft, performance, and quality — Own performance, stability and maintainability in the code you ship, at the scale Grove actually runs at.

About You

  • 5+ years building and operating building and maintaining production system integrations — the kind that move data between platforms like NetSuite, HighJump, or similar ERP/WMS systems.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals: you can design a pipeline, debug it under pressure, and know the difference between a quick fix and a real one.
  • Genuine hands-on experience with AI tools and, ideally, agent frameworks or MCP — not just familiarity, but a track record of building with them.
  • Comfortable operating with a rough direction instead of a finished spec, and you make real progress anyway.
  • A builder's mindset — you'd rather stand something up yourself than write a design doc for someone else to build.
  • Enough security instinct to ask the right questions about what an agent should and shouldn't be able to touch, even when you're not the final decision-maker on policy.
  • You're honest about what you don't know. You can say "I haven't worked with that" without flinching, and you don't paper over the gap with a confident guess.
  • Background with Airflow, Airbyte, or similar data-pipeline infrastructure
  • New technology doesn’t scare you. You’ve been dropped into an unfamiliar framework, language, or platform and gotten productive fast, and you can point to a time you did it. You evaluate new tools on the merits instead of defaulting to what you already know or chasing whatever is new.
  • You’re honest about what you don’t know. You can say “I haven’t worked with that” without flinching, and you don’t paper over the gap with a confident guess.
  • You’ve taken something vague, made it concrete, brought other people along, and shipped it.
  • You work well with others. You give direct feedback kindly, you take it well, and people want you on their project.
  • A real sense of ownership and pride in the experiences you ship and the code you leave behind.
  • You write things down, and people understand them. You can a non-technical person through a technical tradeoff without hiding behind jargon.
  • Genuine enthusiasm for Grove’s mission and sustainability values, not just the tech stack.

How We Work Together

  • This is a high trust environment. You’ll get real scope and real decisions early, and nobody is going to look over your shoulder while you do the work. Trust runs both directions: we’ll be straight with you about the business, the tradeoffs, and the parts of the codebase we aren’t proud of, and we expect that same candor back.
  • We value psychological safety first and foremost. It’s the precondition for everything else on this list. The teams that solve genuinely hard problems are the ones where people feel safe saying “I don’t understand this yet.”
  • “I haven’t worked with that” is a complete answer here. We have deep respect for an engineer who names the edge of their own knowledge instead of bluffing past it. We don’t need you to know everything. We need you to be honest about where your expertise begins and ends — and that honesty is worth more to us than a confident guess, in an interview and on the job.

How We think About AI

We’re serious about this, so we’d rather be direct than let you find out later.

  • AI tooling is part of how this team works every day, not an experiment on the side. We want someone who genuinely enjoys these tools and keeps getting better with them.
  • Nobody here has AI figured out, and we’re skeptical of anyone who says they do. The tooling changes month to month. We are all working it out together, in the open. We’d rather hire someone actively learning than someone with a methodology to evangelize.
  • We’re looking for someone whose judgment stays their own. You should be able to read what a model produced, disagree with it, and explain why — about architecture, about correctness, about whether the thing should be built at all.
  • The version of this we don’t want: code that ships because a model was confident. If you can’t explain why your code looks the way it does, “the model wrote it” isn’t an answer.
  • The version we do want: someone who moves twice as fast with these tools and whose standards didn’t move at all.
  • This is where honesty about the edges of your knowledge matters most. AI makes it effortless to produce work you don’t actually understand. Flagging that is a strength here, not an admission.

Our interview process includes a take-home project and a working review session that covers system design, coding, product thinking, and how you use AI. We’d rather see how you actually work than quiz you on algorithms — there’s no LeetCode round.

Even Better if You Have

  • Experience building or contributing to an MCP server or similar agent-tooling layer.
  • Background with Airflow, Airbyte, or similar data-pipeline infrastructure, especially rebuilding integrations off a legacy iPaaS.
  • Experience with NetSuite and/or HighJump integrations specifically.
  • Experience setting up auth, access control, or auditing for AI agents operating on production systems.
  • Experience at a fast-growing ecommerce company.

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU

  • This full-time, exempt position is remote for candidates based in the following states: California, Maine, Pennsylvania, Nevada, North Carolina, Texas, Colorado, Washington, Illinois, New York, Missouri, and Massachusetts.
  • Competitive benefits - medical, vision, dental
  • Equity - shared success is core to our mission
  • Flexible Paid Time Off - we care most about results
  • Free VIP membership and 50% employee discount
  • Working for a company that believes that a small group of people can change the world for the better by creating products and funding initiatives that help the planet!

COMPENSATION

The salary range for this role is $144,000-185,000. Our compensation bands are determined based on market-specific cost of living data, meaning that the top of our salary range is reserved for the most experienced candidates in the highest cost of living areas across the country. In addition to the base salary, this role is eligible for an annual incentive target and equity.

MORE ABOUT GROVE

Grove Collaborative Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: GROV) is the one-stop online destination for everyday essentials that create a healthier home and planet. Explore thousands of thoughtfully vetted products for every room and everyone in your home, including household cleaning, personal care, health and wellness, laundry, clean beauty, kitchen, pantry, kids, baby, pet care, and beyond. Everything Grove sells meets a higher standard — from health to sustainability and performance — so you get a great value without compromising your values. As a B Corp and Public Benefit Corporation, Grove goes beyond selling products: every order is carbon neutral, supports plastic waste cleanup initiatives, and lets you see and track the positive impact of your choices.
