Title: Databricks Engineer

Location: Remote in USA

Working hours in EST

Required certification: Active Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate certification.

Role Summary

The Data Engineer is responsible for building, maintaining, and supporting data solutions on the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform running on Microsoft Azure, AWS or GCP. The role leverages Databricks, Python, PySpark, and SQL to deliver data ingestion, transformation, modeling, and pipeline orchestration.

Working within the standards and designs set with the Senior Data Engineer, this role independently owns the delivery of assigned pipelines from development through production support.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain batch and streaming data pipelines for extracting, transforming, and loading (ETL/ELT) data from multiple sources into the Databricks lakehouse on Azure.
  • Implement data ingestion using Auto Loader, Lakeflow Connect, and Azure Data Factory.
  • Develop pipelines with Lakeflow Spark Declarative Pipelines (formerly Delta Live Tables), including data quality expectations.
  • Perform data manipulation and transformation using PySpark and Spark SQL, ensuring data is prepared for analytics and reporting.
  • Configure, schedule, and monitor data workflows with Lakeflow Jobs (formerly Databricks Workflows).
  • Implement data models within the lakehouse following medallion architecture (bronze/silver/gold) and team modeling standards.
  • Apply Unity Catalog permissions and governance standards to the data assets you build.
  • Write unit and data quality tests and deploy pipelines through CI/CD using Git folders and Declarative Automation Bundles (formerly Databricks Asset Bundles).
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve pipeline failures and data quality issues in production.
  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to team documentation and engineering standards.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including business stakeholders and IT, to ensure data solutions meet business and performance requirements aligned to project goals.

Required Qualifications

Experience

  • 6+ years of professional experience in data engineering, data & analytics or data warehousing.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience working with Databricks in a data engineering capacity.
  • 3+ years of experience with Python, including manipulating large datasets using PySpark DataFrames, Spark SQL, and/or the pandas API on Spark.
  • 2+ years of data engineering experience on Microsoft Azure (e.g., ADLS Gen2, Azure Data Factory, Key Vault).

Skills and Knowledge

  • Proficiency in Python programming for data engineering tasks.
  • Strong knowledge of SQL for data modeling, transformation, and querying.
  • Working knowledge of Delta Lake fundamentals (e.g., MERGE, schema evolution, time travel).
  • Working knowledge of Unity Catalog concepts, including catalogs, schemas, and permissions.
  • Experience with Git-based version control and familiarity with CI/CD practices for data pipelines.
  • Understanding of testing and deployment strategies for data pipelines, including productionizing ETL pipelines and Databricks SQL queries.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or a closely related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience implementing streaming data ingestion in Databricks (Structured Streaming, Auto Loader, Event Hubs).
  • Experience with healthcare data (e.g., claims, EHR/clinical data, HL7/FHIR) and HIPAA/PHI handling.
  • Exposure to Spark and Delta Lake performance tuning and compute cost optimization.
  • Familiarity with dimensional modeling and SCD Type 1 and Type 2 patterns.
  • Experience enabling BI consumption through Databricks SQL warehouses and tools such as Power BI.

Head of Estimating

Location: Homebased – Remote, with UK travel

Mears Group is seeking an exceptional Head of Estimating to lead our commercial estimating and tendering function at a strategic level. This is a pivotal senior leadership role, shaping how we price, win and mobilise major contracts across the organisation. If you are commercially astute, influential at senior levels, and passionate about driving excellence in tendering, this is an opportunity to make a significant impact on the future growth of our business.

About the Role

As Head of Estimating, you will take ownership of developing robust, compliant and commercially competitive bids across a wide range of workstreams, including Repairs & Maintenance (such as M&E and Planned Works), Central Government housing and support services, Decarbonisation and Net Zero programmes, and DLO support. You will shape the commercial strategy behind each opportunity, building cost models from first principles, driving value engineering, and ensuring risks and assumptions are clearly understood. Working closely with Business Development, Operations and Legal teams, you will influence strategic bid decisions and ensure our proposals support sustainable growth and margin protection. Your leadership will set the standard for commercial governance, pricing excellence and the continuous improvement of our estimating function.

Key Responsibilities

Commercial Leadership

  • Lead the creation of high‑quality commercial proposals tailored to individual opportunities
  • Develop cost models from first principles and drive pricing strategy and value engineering
  • Provide senior leadership with clear commercial analysis, risk positions and recommendations
  • Partner with internal teams to shape strategic bid decisions and contract risk assessments

Tender Governance & Risk Management

  • Ensure all submissions are compliant, well‑documented and commercially sound
  • Lead competitive dialogue, clarifications, RFIs and post‑tender negotiations
  • Oversee commercial review of contracts and legal documentation
  • Enhance estimating methodologies, tools, templates and documentation standards

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Present commercial proposals to Directors and the Senior Management Team
  • Embed tender assumptions and methodologies into mobilisation and operational teams
  • Engage with supply chain partners to secure competitive and deliverable pricing

Mobilisation & Continuous Improvement

  • Play a key role in mobilisation of successful tenders, challenging assumptions to drive profitability
  • Translate estimating assumptions into operational cost monitoring
  • Analyse outturn performance to inform future bids and build a commercial knowledge base

People Leadership

  • Lead, mentor and develop the Estimating Team, fostering technical excellence and collaboration.
  • Identify capability gaps and champion learning, systems improvement and performance management

Essential Experience

  • Extensive experience in social housing estimating, including expert knowledge of NHF Schedule of Rates.
  • Proven ability to develop pricing strategies and deliver value engineering solutions.
  • Strong track record in post‑tender negotiations and contract award processes.
  • End‑to‑end tender lifecycle experience, from pricing to mobilisation.
  • Strong working knowledge of standard forms of contract
  • Experience presenting commercial proposals at senior leadership level.
  • Ability to manage multiple bids under demanding deadlines.
  • Demonstrable leadership experience in building high‑performing teams.

Desirable

  • Experience at Head of / Senior Manager level within a large contracting or housing services organisation
  • Familiarity with sector‑standard estimating systems and analytical tools
  • Professional qualification in Quantity Surveying or Construction Management

Key Skills & Attributes

  • Strategic commercial thinker with strong influencing capability
  • Excellent communicator, able to simplify complex commercial reasoning
  • High numerical accuracy and attention to detail
  • Proactive problem solver committed to continuous improvement
  • Collaborative leader with a passion for developing people

Benefits:

  • Family friendly policies, including enhanced maternity/paternity leave and much more
  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays
  • 3 x Life assurance
  • Family private medical
  • £6,900 car allowance
  • Generous Pension Scheme and sick pay
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Mears Rewards – discount voucher scheme for a host of household name retailers, including supermarkets, offering savings on purchases
  • Excellent training and development opportunities
  • Mears Fun Day - Our annual Fun Day is organised as a massive thank you from the Executive team for all the hard work! Previous years include, Alton Towers, Drayton Manor etc
  • Volunteering Leave - Mears supports employees to undertake volunteering in the community for two days per year, in support of our social value commitment

If you’re ready to shape the future of estimating at Mears Group and lead a high‑performing team in a role with real strategic influence, we’d love to hear from you.

All our roles require candidates to have the entitlement to work within the UK, Mears does not currently offer visa sponsorship.

To drive a Mears vehicle, you must be aged over 21 have held your licence over 3 months and have less than 9 points.

Candidates should be aware that all our roles are subject to relevant Background, Identity & Security checks before commencement of employment.

Joe Monger ()

Sophos goes to market with a global partner ecosystem, including Managed Service Providers (MSPs), Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs), resellers and distributors, marketplace integrations, and cyber risk partners, giving organizations the flexibility to choose trusted relationships when securing their business. Sophos is headquartered in Oxford, U.K. More information is available at .

Role Summary

The Senior Director, Pricing Operations will lead the transformation of Sophos's SecOps pricing function: building a centralized team, a disciplined operating cadence, and an AI-assisted governance model that let pricing move at the pace of the market. This is a build role. The Director will design the target operating model, stand up the team and the cadence behind it, and give senior leadership a clear, early view of competitive and market shifts, with a strong dotted line into the Network Security group to keep pricing decisions connected across both businesses.

What You Will Do

    • Design and build a centralized Pricing Operations function, bringing pricing work that sits across multiple teams today into one function with clear ownership of strategy, analytics, and deal support.

    • Define and implement a segment-aware pricing cadence, replacing episodic reviews with a disciplined, regular cycle, tuned to how fast each part of the business needs to move.

    • Stand up a pricing council and governance model so every approved change carries clear rationale, ownership, and advance communication to sales, finance, and customer-facing teams.

    • Direct the build-out of AI-assisted digital worker capabilities for competitor pricing analysis, discount analysis, discount depth analysis, and market alerts, so the function operates at pace without growing headcount.

    • Give senior leadership early visibility into market-moving events, including competitor pricing moves and market disruption, ahead of the standard review cycle.

    • Build a strong dotted-line partnership with the Network Security group to keep pricing decisions aligned across SecOps and Network Security.

    • Define and report the metrics that prove the new model is working: cadence adherence, time from decision to communication, and discount discipline.

What You Will Bring

    • Track record of building or transforming a pricing, revenue operations, or deal desk function at a B2B SaaS or technology company, ideally in cybersecurity or another subscription-driven business.

    • Experience leading organizational change: centralizing a distributed function, standing up new governance, and bringing a business along through the transition.

    • Familiarity with discount governance and competitive pricing intelligence, including using data and AI-assisted tools to monitor competitor pricing and discounting patterns.

    • Strong people leadership experience, with the ability to build a new team and establish its operating rhythm from the ground up.

    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build conviction for a new way of working across sales, finance, and executive stakeholders.

    • Comfortable designing pricing approaches that flex by customer segment and channel, balancing speed and stability where each is needed.

    • Bachelor's degree in business, finance, economics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Productsup is looking for a Head of Professional Services (f/m/d) to lead our global team of Implementation Consultants and Managed Services specialists.
Reporting directly to the COO, you will manage a newly established team of approximately 15 people in a flat structure with no middle management layers. In this role, you will be fully responsible for the unit’s daily operations, team structure, and overall delivery margins.
A key part of this position is managing team capacity thoughtfully. Instead of just pushing for high billable hours, you will strategically use available team time to support customer retention, safeguard Net Retention Rate (NRR), and solve complex client issues.

What you'll do
  • Lead the unit: Directly manage a flat, global team distributed across three timezones (EMEA, India, and North America), fostering a unified culture with shared standards and equal growth opportunities.
  • Define the operating model: Design and own intake, scheduling, delivery standards, tooling, and performance tracking for the unit.
  • Drive retention and NRR: Partner closely with Revenue and Customer Experience leadership to deploy reserved capacity into key accounts to protect and grow NRR.
  • Manage commercial performance: Own delivery margin, capacity planning, and the unit P&L, balancing profitable execution with strategic customer value.
  • Develop people: Coach every team member, supporting their growth across implementation projects and recurring services.
  • Handle escalations: Act as a senior point of contact for complex enterprise deliveries and high-stakes technical escalations.

What you'll bring to the team
  • Direct leadership experience: Proven track record of leading a technical or services delivery team of a similar size directly, without relying on team leads.
  • Focus on customer value & NRR: Demonstrated success viewing team capacity through the lens of customer retention and value creation, not purely billable utilization.
  • Alignment and change skills: Success shaping operational structures, bringing global groups together, and navigating organizational change directly.
  • Domain fluency: Strong services delivery experience in data-heavy, integration-heavy, or technical environments (e.g., e-commerce, retail, martech/adtech).
  • Commercial and process acumen: Clear understanding of project management, delivery margins, estimation risks, and P&L accountability.
  • Cross-functional influence: Ability to proactively collaborate with Sales and CX stakeholders without relying on formal mandates.
  • Based in Berlin and comfortable operating in a truly global environment.
  • Professional fluency in English and flexibility to collaborate across global time zones (EMEA, India, North America).

What we offer you:
  • A permanent position with an attractive salary at our growing company
  • The option to work remotely and flexibly, because we know outstanding talent knows best how and where to work
  • Ongoing internal and external training, plus a yearly learning budget to help you continuously grow professionally and further your career with Productsup
  • Opportunities for engaging in our Corporate Social Responsibility initiatives, plus one paid Impact Day per year dedicated to voluntary work
  • Employee referral bonuses: we know that talent attracts talent, and we encourage you to refer people you know to join our team
  • The opportunity to take ownership and responsibility, impacting the company’s growth in an international environment with 40+ nationalities
  • Discounted Urban Sports membership
  • Employee Assistance Program

Productsup values diversity. We celebrate our differences and strive to learn from each other with the firm conviction that diversity drives innovation. Our commitment to equal opportunities applies across our hiring processes and culture.

This role's compensation corresponds to our M3 level within our organisation structure.

jobs.description:
Role Title: Physics Expert (PhD / Postdoc)

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote (Worldwide)

Schedule: 10-15+ hours a week, Fully Flexible (Can accommodate working after hours/weekends)

We are engaging Physics Experts (PhD / Postdoc) to contribute deep scientific knowledge and problem-solving skills to a high-impact customer project. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems.

Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

Required Skills

  • Physics Mastery

  • Written Technical Communication

  • Technical Problem-Solving Depth

  • Mathematical & Computational Fluency

Scope of Work

  • Solve advanced physics problems from your specialization, delivering rigorous, well-documented derivations and analyses.

  • Produce technically precise, clearly written solutions, detailing all assumptions, approximations, and final results using LaTeX mathematical notation.

  • Utilize SymPy, Python, and Jupyter for symbolic or numerical verification and clear computational workflows where relevant.

  • Identify and articulate subtleties in problem statements, including special cases, boundary conditions, and dimensional consistency.

  • Flag ambiguities in project materials, proposing well-reasoned interpretations and clarifications as needed.

  • Iterate on submitted solutions in response to feedback from project reviewers, ensuring corrections are cleanly integrated.

  • Uphold rigorous standards in documentation and reproducibility consistent with professional research practice.

Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in physics or advanced-stage PhD candidacy, with active research experience in a relevant subfield.

  • Research expertise in one or more of: High Energy Physics, Mathematical Physics, Biophysics, Statistical Physics, Condensed Matter (including moiré systems, magnetism, PXP/Rydberg), AMO/Quantum Optics, Gravitation, Cosmology, Astrophysics, Quantum Information, or Optical Properties of Materials.

  • 2–5 recent representative publications (past ~5 years) in your field, with accessible arXiv or DOI records.

  • Proficiency with LaTeX for presenting mathematics, and with SymPy, Python, and Jupyter for computational work; willingness to indicate areas for further support if needed.

  • Demonstrated excellence in written technical communication, with a track record of producing clear, precise, and well-argued scientific outputs.

  • Strong analytical skills, able to isolate key physical principles and provide nuanced solutions to complex problems.

  • Availability to engage with the project consistently over an 8–10 week period (approx. 10 hours/week).

jobs.description:
Productsup is a Berlin-based company with a strong international customer base, and we’re looking to rapidly scale our reach within the digital commerce landscape. We are seeking a high-performing Full-Stack Website Developer to join our dynamic Marketing team. In this pivotal role, you will own our website strategy end-to-end, ensuring our site is continuously optimized for conversion and driving performance from foundational back-end architecture to high-impact front-end user experiences.

Key Responsibilities
Technical Engineering & Architecture
  • Back-End (Headless CMS): Design, scale, and maintain Contentful content models, fields, spaces, and environments. Oversee structured content delivery using GraphQL/REST API queries, webhooks, and modern data-handling protocols.
  • Front-End (Presentation Layer): Build and maintain responsive, accessible, secure, and performant web experiences using modern JavaScript frameworks (Nuxt.js, Vue.js, Node.js) alongside semantic HTML5 and advanced CSS3.
  • Integrations & DevOps: Connect Contentful seamlessly with critical third-party tools, including CRM platforms (HubSpot), web analytics solutions, and cloud infrastructure/hosting environments (AWS, Amazon CloudFront, S3, Heroku).
  • AI & Workflow Automation: Enhance, scale, and maintain internal AI-powered automation tools, leveraging platforms such as OpenAI to streamline recurring web workflows, reduce manual operational overhead, and boost overall team efficiency.
Analytics, Tracking & Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)
  • Performance Monitoring: Evaluate end-to-end site health, user engagement, and marketing funnel performance using GA4, Hotjar, and advanced data visualization tools.
  • CRO Pipeline Ownership: Own the testing pipeline by designing (with copy and design support) and executing rigorous A/B and multivariate tests across copy, interactive layouts, and visual CTAs to maximize lead conversion rates.
  • Funnel Optimization: Proactively monitor critical site metrics—including Conversion Rate (CVR), bounce rates, and form drop-off trends—to identify conversion friction and engineer immediate solutions.
  • Data Integrity & Tagging: Deploy and manage precise event tracking arrays using Google Tag Manager (GTM) and GA4. Conduct thorough QA on all new pages to guarantee exact tag firing, conversion pixel accuracy, and clean UTM parameters.
  • Data Flow Architecture: Partner closely with Marketing Operations to secure seamless data flows from web touchpoints into CRMs, data platforms, and executive reporting dashboards.
CMS Enablement, SEO & Support
  • CMS Training & Enablement: Design and deliver comprehensive CMS onboarding and training sessions for new and existing internal website users.
  • Contributor Guidance: Act as the primary technical point of contact for website-related issues, providing continuous documentation, troubleshooting support, and governance for content contributors.
  • Publishing Best Practices: Champion best-in-class workflows for web publishing, ensuring content layout consistency, cross-browser compatibility, and digital asset efficiency.
  • Technical SEO: Implement foundational and advanced technical SEO requirements in collaboration with the SEO Manager to preserve and improve organic search visibility, site indexation, and page speed performance.

What You Bring to the Team
  • Technical Background: Proven experience building performant, robust, responsive, and cross-browser compatible Server-Side Rendering (SSR) websites.
  • Framework Mastery: Hands-on experience with JavaScript frameworks (specifically Nuxt.js, Vue.js, and Node.js) alongside core HTML5 and CSS3.
  • Headless CMS & APIs: Direct experience configuring, managing, and querying headless CMS environments (Contentful strongly preferred), with a fluent understanding of HTTP, JSON, REST, and GraphQL.
  • Cloud & DevOps: Competency in managing deployments and environments within cloud services (AWS, S3, Amazon CloudFront), Heroku, and modern version control/project tracking tools (Git, Jira).
  • Work Experience: 5+ years of digital operations experience, with at least 1–2 years specifically managing content inside a headless CMS environment.
  • Professional Competencies: Strong data-driven mindset, excellent relationship-building skills across design and marketing teams, and the ability to troubleshoot critical bugs under pressure with high autonomy.

What We Offer You
  • A permanent position with an attractive salary at our growing company
  • The option to work remotely and flexibly, because we know outstanding talent knows best how and where to work
  • A unique and thorough onboarding program where you’ll learn the ins-and-outs of our company and product
  • Ongoing internal and external training, plus a yearly learning budget to help you continuously grow professionally and further your career with Productsup
  • Opportunities for engaging in our Corporate Social Responsibility initiatives, plus one paid Impact Day per year dedicated to voluntary work
  • Employee referral bonuses: we know that talent attracts talent, and we encourage you to refer people you know to join our team
  • The opportunity to take ownership and responsibility, impacting the company’s growth in an international environment with 40+ nationalities
  • Employee Assistance Program

Productsup values diversity. We celebrate our differences and strive to learn from each other with the firm conviction that diversity drives innovation. Our commitment to equal opportunities begins at the hiring process and extends to our whole working culture. Everyone has a unique contribution to make and all are welcome.

jobs.description:
About Us:

The United States has the poorest maternal and birth outcomes of all developed countries with the underserved, Black, Brown, Indigenous communities disproportionately affected. Nadia Care is working to drastically change the experience of affected communities by reimagining how we deliver meaningful and compassionate care to expectant moms.

Nadia Care’s mission is to improve pregnancy, birth and the postpartum journey for women and their families by reimagining how maternity care is delivered. Our team is focused on building trust-based engagement and wrap-around support for expectant moms at home, in person and virtually to ensure they have all the social support they need for a successful and joyful pregnancy journey. We help our members with care navigation, doula support, assistance with lactation, nutrition, housing, transportation and a wide range of other needs. We leverage technology to support our virtual engagement that allows us to meet all our moms where they are.

We ensure that our members have trusted sources for support, resources, and information throughout their pregnancy, delivery and well into postpartum. Nadia Care does not replace the primary obstetrician or doctor’s relationships. Instead, we support expectant mothers with all other health-related social needs not typically available through their doctors’ offices.

Our Values:

  • Empathy is at the heart of everything we do. We must always center the experiences of the mothers and families we serve, as well as support and uplift one another.
  • Collaboration is what makes us stronger. We achieve the greatest impact when we work together, share knowledge, and elevate each other’s strengths.
  • Resilience reflects our ability to push through challenges, adapt in a fast-changing environment, and remain committed to our mission no matter the obstacles.

The Role:

The Credentialing & Payer Operations Manager will own end-to-end provider licensing, payer enrollment, and credentialing operations. This hands-on role requires someone who thrives "in the weeds" building scalable internal processes, maintaining strict regulatory compliance, and driving fast time-to-credentialing metrics. Initially operating as a team of one, this role will establish foundational workflows for our Care Team (including Doulas) while serving as the primary bridge between providers, health plans, billing, and client success teams.

Key Responsibilities

Provider Onboarding, Licensing & Doula Readiness

  • Manage full lifecycle licensing, credentialing, and re-credentialing applications for all Care Team members across multiple states.
  • Build and execute Doula Readiness workflows to onboard non-traditional care providers efficiently into payer networks.
  • Collect, audit, and verify primary source documentation required for payor and state credentialing packages.
  • Directly communicate with providers to gather missing documentation, guide them through state renewal procedures, and clear onboarding bottlenecks.

Licensure Maintenance, Certifications & CEU Tracking

  • Proactively monitor and track all clinical and non-clinical staff credentials, state license expiration dates, BLS/CPR certifications, and mandatory Continuing Education Units (CEUs).
  • Build structured automated workflow reminders in Medallion to advise care team members on upcoming renewal deadlines and mandatory continuing education requirements.
  • Audit and record completion certificates for required clinical trainings, state-mandated CEUs, and specialty accreditations prior to credential expiration.

Process Operations, Systems & Performance

  • Establish, standardize, and optimize internal credentialing and payer enrollment processes from scratch.
  • Own and maintain the credentialing management platform (Medallion) for automated tracking, expiration alerts, and primary source verification reporting.
  • Track and optimize key operational KPIs, specifically driving down Time-to-Credentialing to accelerate provider deployment and revenue generation.
  • Generate regular performance analytics and status reports for leadership regarding provider readiness and enrollment pipelines.

Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) & Payer Relations

  • Oversee the credentialing-to-claims bridge, ensuring providers are properly linked to billing systems prior to service delivery to prevent claim denials.
  • Submit credentialing packages directly to commercial insurance plans, Medicaid entities, and managed care organizations.
  • Partner closely with Revenue Cycle Management (RCM), billing, and coding teams to troubleshoot credentialing-related claims issues or enrollment delays.

Regulatory Compliance & Risk Management

  • Monitor state licensure bodies, OIG exclusions, Medicaid/Medicare sanction reports, and the National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) to ensure clean provider rosters.
  • Stay up to date on evolving healthcare regulations, state licensing requirements, HIPAA guidelines, and payer-specific enrollment rules.
  • Manage client-facing compliance reporting, delivering accurate documentation to meet health plan and enterprise client audit standards.

Client Communication & Stakeholder Alignment

  • Serve as the functional point of contact for enterprise clients regarding provider panel status and credentialing timelines.
  • Collaborate internally with Implementation and Client Success teams to align provider availability with client go-live targets.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of healthcare credentialing, provider operations, and payer enrollment experience.
  • Proven experience submitting initial state licensure applications across multiple states simultaneously and tracking recurring certification/CEU requirements.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare Administration, Business, or related field (Associates degree accepted with equivalent hands-on experience).
  • Hands-on experience with Medallion (or similar credentialing tracking platforms) is strongly preferred.

Key Skill Sets

  • Strong project management skills to track dozens of active licenses, BLS certifications, CEU deadlines, and payer files simultaneously.
  • Comfortable operating independently, solving complex payer delays, and building processes without a pre-existing playbook.
  • Excellent verbal and written skills for interfacing with providers, health plan representatives, internal billing teams, and enterprise clients.
  • Practical understanding of how credentialing linkages directly impact billing cycles and claims reimbursement.

Compensation range for this position is between $80K-$90K. The exact amount will depend on direct, relevant experience.

Our Interview Process

At Nadia Care, we value transparency and want you to feel prepared at every stage of your candidate journey. Below is our standard interview process for this role:

  1. Recruiter Interview | 30 minutes
  2. Hiring Manager Interview | 45 minutes
  3. Written Assessment | 2 days to complete
  4. Team Interview | 1 hour

Please note that this process is subject to change, but we will always keep you informed along the way.

For full-time employees, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support you both professionally and personally:

Time Off That Works for You

  • Recharge with annual paid holidays off.
  • Full-Time Salaried Employees (Exempt): Enjoy unlimited time off after the 90-day introductory period.
  • Full-Time Hourly Employees (Non-Exempt): Receive three weeks of paid time off after the 90-day introductory period.

Comprehensive Health & Wellness Coverage

  • Medical Insurance: Access top-tier healthcare, covering hospital, surgical, and prescription drug benefits. Coverage begins the first of the following month.
  • Dental Insurance: Coverage for preventive care, as well as basic and major procedures.
  • Vision Insurance: Coverage for routine eye exams and eyeglasses.

Security & Future Planning Options

  • Stock Option Grant: We believe in shared success.
  • Life Insurance: Financial protection for your beneficiaries.
  • Disability Insurance: Short-term and long-term coverage in case of illness or injury.
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan: Opportunity to save for the future.

We’re building something great and want you to be part of it. If you're looking for a fast-paced, dynamic environment where your contributions make an impact, apply today!

Remote positions are open to candidates in the contiguous US only. Due to operational and compliance requirements, we are unable to hire candidates residing in ND, AL, HI, PR or outside the contiguous US.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review and validate documentation for LLCs, Corporations, Partnerships, and Trusts, including but not limited to: Articles of Organization/Incorporation, Operating Agreements, Partnership Agreements, Trust Agreements, Corporate Resolutions, EIN documentation, and Certificates of Good Standing.

  • Collaborate closely with underwriters, processors, and closers to ensure entity and trust documentation is complete prior to loan decision or funding.
  • Maintain accurate documentation logs and support QC and post-close audit efforts related to entity and trust eligibility.
  • Stay informed of updates to agency and investor guidelines, compliance standards, and internal procedures impacting entity and trust borrowers.
  • Support internal team training and act as a subject matter resource for trust and entity documentation-related questions.

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Business, Legal Studies, Finance, or related field preferred.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in mortgage operations or underwriting, with Non-QM or Non-Agency product experience strongly preferred.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

Environmental Solutions

jobs.excerpt: About Rhythm EnergyRhythm is a renewable energy and technology company redefining how people interact with energy.
jobs.description:
About Rhythm Energy

Rhythm is a renewable energy and technology company redefining how people interact with energy. We combine energy market expertise with technology, design, and data science to deliver simple, transparent, and customer-centric energy solutions.

We’re a mission-driven team focused on building scalable systems, solving complex problems, and making a meaningful impact on the future of energy.

About the Role

We’re hiring a Product Manager – Growth & Lifecycle to own the customer-facing products and experiences that bring customers to Rhythm and keep them here.

You’ll own the customer journey from enrollment through renewal, building products that make energy simpler and give customers the information they need to make confident decisions. We'll measure your success primarily by two outcomes: conversion and retention.

You’ll work closely with Marketing and our Head of Growth to identify opportunities and run experiments across the funnel, and with Product Design to create simple, intuitive customer experiences. You’ll own product requirements and final sign-off on customer-facing experiences before they move into development.

Churn reduction and retention are among Rhythm’s top product priorities, giving this role direct and visible impact on company results from day one.

We’re looking for an independent, decisive Product Manager who can lead the room, align stakeholders, make recommendations, and move decisions forward in a fast-paced environment.

What You’ll Do

Growth & Lifecycle Product Ownership

  • Own the roadmap for Rhythm’s customer-facing products across the lifecycle, including the enrollment journey, customer portal, retention, and renewal experiences.
  • Drive measurable improvements in conversion and retention, establishing clear success metrics for initiatives and reporting on outcomes.
  • Lead retention and churn reduction initiatives, identifying where customers drop off or disengage and building experiences designed to keep them with Rhythm.
  • Use customer data, funnel analytics, segmentation, and user feedback to understand customer behavior and identify the highest-impact opportunities.
  • Monitor product performance after launch and continuously iterate based on customer behavior and results.

Experimentation & Conversion

  • Partner closely with Marketing and the Head of Growth to turn growth opportunities into clear hypotheses and product experiments.
  • Design, prioritize, and run A/B tests across the customer journey, from acquisition and enrollment through engagement and renewal.
  • Use experimentation to evaluate messaging, workflows, offers, experiences, and other opportunities to improve conversion and retention.
  • Translate experiment results into clear product decisions and use learnings to inform what we build next.
  • Build a consistent experimentation practice where hypotheses, success metrics, results, and next steps are clearly defined.

Customer Experience & Product Design

  • Partner closely with Product Design to simplify customer experiences across Rhythm’s digital products.
  • Own final sign-off on customer-facing designs from a product workflow and requirements perspective before implementation.
  • Ensure customer experiences balance customer needs, business objectives, technical considerations, and measurable product outcomes.
  • Use qualitative and quantitative customer insights to identify friction and make experiences simpler, clearer, and easier to act on.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Delivery

  • Align stakeholders across Marketing, Sales, Operations, Customer Care, Analytics, Design, and Engineering around product priorities and decisions.
  • Bring clear recommendations to cross-functional conversations and drive decisions forward rather than waiting for consensus.
  • Translate business objectives and customer problems into clear product requirements, user stories, workflows, and success metrics.
  • Partner with Engineering throughout the software development lifecycle to manage delivery through our Agile process.
  • Communicate product strategy, priorities, tradeoffs, performance, and recommendations clearly to stakeholders and Executive Leadership.
  • Independently own your product area while maintaining strong alignment across the teams that contribute to the customer experience.

What You’ll Bring

  • 3+ years of Product Management experience, with a focus on growth, lifecycle, retention, or other B2C customer-facing products.
  • A track record of building and shipping customer-facing experiences that measurably improved conversion, retention, or engagement.
  • Hands-on experience designing, running, and interpreting A/B tests.
  • Strong understanding of conversion funnels and the customer behaviors that influence acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, and renewal.
  • Experience working closely with UI/UX designers to create simple, intuitive customer experiences.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to align multiple teams, make recommendations, navigate competing priorities, and move decisions forward.
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort using customer and product data to validate ideas, prioritize opportunities, and measure results.
  • Solid understanding of the software development lifecycle, including roadmap planning, PRDs, user stories, and Agile delivery.
  • Clear, direct, and concise communication skills, from day-to-day working sessions through Executive Leadership.
  • Ability to work independently and take full ownership of your product area in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in retail energy, utilities, or another subscription or recurring-billing business where you manage the customer relationship over time, such as SaaS, telecom, insurance, or FinTech.
  • Background in Product Marketing or Go-to-Market before moving into Product Management.
  • Exposure to customer lifecycle analytics, including churn, customer lifetime value (CLV), segmentation, and retention cohorts.
  • Experience using SQL and data tools such as Databricks, Tableau, Google Analytics, or FullStory.
  • Familiarity with experimentation platforms and Figma.
  • Experience conducting user interviews and combining qualitative customer feedback with quantitative data to inform product decisions.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 12 months, success in this role will look like:

  • Enrollment conversion improves through product improvements, experimentation, and a better understanding of where customers experience friction.
  • Customer retention improves, and churn decreases across key customer segments.
  • Rhythm has a consistent, well-run experimentation practice with Marketing, where hypotheses and success metrics are clearly defined, and test results directly influence what we build next.
  • Customer-facing experiences become simpler, clearer, and easier for customers to understand and act on.
  • Product decisions are grounded in customer behavior, funnel analytics, experimentation, and measurable business outcomes.
  • Cross-functional meetings consistently end with clear decisions, owners, and next steps, with Product trusted to drive the process forward.
  • You independently own the Growth & Lifecycle roadmap and are trusted to identify opportunities, make recommendations, and move priorities forward.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Meaningful ownership. Own customer-facing products across the lifecycle, from enrollment through renewal.
  • Direct business impact. Conversion, retention, and churn are critical business priorities, and your work will directly influence each of them.
  • Experimentation at the core. Work closely with Marketing and Growth to test ideas, learn quickly, and use results to determine what we build next.
  • Customer-focused product development. Partner closely with Product Design to make complex energy experiences simpler and more intuitive.
  • Cross-functional exposure. Work across Marketing, Growth, Design, Engineering, Analytics, Sales, Operations, and Customer Care.
  • Our culture. We’re friendly, transparent, collaborative, and love to innovate together.
  • Professional development. We support continued learning and provide opportunities to grow alongside the business.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits. We offer competitive compensation, performance-based rewards, paid vacation, and comprehensive benefits.

Hiring Process

We aim to keep our interview process thoughtful, transparent, and respectful of your time.

  1. People Screen (30 minutes) – Meet with a Talent Acquisition Partner to learn more about Rhythm, the opportunity, and your background.
  2. Hiring Manager Interview (30 minutes) – Dive deeper into your Product Management experience, growth and lifecycle ownership, experimentation approach, and experience building customer-facing products.
  3. Case Study Presentation (60 minutes) – Work through and present a role-relevant product challenge, giving us an opportunity to understand how you structure problems, use data, make tradeoffs, and communicate product recommendations.
  4. Stakeholder Interview (30 minutes) – Meet with a key cross-functional partner to explore how you collaborate, influence decisions, navigate competing priorities, and operate across teams.
  5. C-Level Conversation with our CPO – Meet with Rhythm’s Chief Product Officer for a final conversation about your experience, product philosophy, and potential impact at Rhythm.
  6. Offer – If it’s a mutual fit, we’ll move forward with an offer and discuss next steps.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

The Ads DSE team builds the core capabilities that power Instacart's off-platform advertising, secure data collaboration (cleanrooms), automated taxonomy management, and their associated platform foundations. We are hiring a Senior Engineer II (L6) to co-own the technical roadmap, modernize our data solutions infrastructure, scale off-platform integrations and measurement capabilities, extend our cleanroom collaboration capabilities, and automate taxonomy change management workflows. This role is pivotal for cross-team collaboration, developer productivity, and AI-driven development initiatives.

You are a senior technical leader who designs and ships scalable, data‑intensive systems; drives cross‑team execution; and raises engineering standards. You’ll partner closely with Product, Data Science, Data Platform, and Governance teams to build reusable abstractions and deliver high‑impact features across our pillars: Off‑platform, Data collaboration (cleanrooms), Ads Taxonomy, Platform, and New Initiatives (AI). You will mentor L4/L5 engineers, act as an IC tech lead (no direct reports), and help define a future on‑call model and SLOs.

About the Job

  • Technical leadership and roadmap
    • Lead architecture for reusable, scalable systems across off‑platform workflows, cleanrooms, taxonomy automation, and the Ads Data Solutions Platform.
    • Evolve core abstractions, testing, CI/CD, observability, and cost efficiency; proactively drive modernization.
    • Propose and drive initiatives on behalf of engineering management; align stakeholders and manage dependencies.
  • Pillar execution
    • Off‑platform: expand and harden integrations with external advertising platforms; design privacy-forward activation and identity workflows; reduce reliance on third-party intermediaries; and build measurement ingestion pipelines for performance signals such as reach, frequency, and conversions.
    • Data collaboration (cleanrooms): extend our cleanroom orchestration and governance tooling (multi-cleanroom support, policy enforcement), develop reusable query templates and partner configurations, optimize pipelines for cost and performance, and scale secure data collaboration deployment and management.
    • Ads Taxonomy: lead intake automation (UI + backend) and release workflow improvements to reduce manual effort and cycle time.
    • Platform: assist with platform modernization and developer tooling improvements; contribute to an on‑call/SLO strategy as we mature operations.
  • AI‑first engineering
    • Use AI‑assisted tools daily for design, coding, tests, and docs; define team prompt patterns and workflows; identify AI opportunities in internal tools and ops.
  • Product quality, privacy, and security
    • Translate ambiguous requirements into pragmatic phases (POC, pilot, production) with clear SLAs/SLOs.
    • Champion security‑by‑design, data governance, and privacy compliance (e.g., GDPR/CCPA) across pipelines.
  • Mentorship and collaboration
    • Mentor engineers up to L5; set code quality and review standards.
    • Build cross‑team partnerships (Ads Manager, Measurement Science, Data Platform, Privacy/Legal, and external platforms).

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • Proven senior‑level impact
    • 8+ years of software engineering experience (typically 10+ for this level) delivering and operating large‑scale backend/data systems; led cross‑team projects and architectural decisions.
  • Backend and data engineering
    • Strong in Python and one of Ruby or Go; services/APIs (REST/gRPC); integrations with third‑party APIs (e.g., Meta, Google, The Trade Desk).
    • Data pipelines with DBT and Airflow; Spark/Databricks; advanced SQL and performance tuning.
    • Snowflake and AWS experience; cost‑aware design; workflow orchestration (e.g., Temporal) and event‑driven patterns.
  • Ads/cleanrooms/privacy
    • Experience with ad‑tech/programmatic and measurement integrations; cleanrooms (Snowflake DCR, shares/listings); identity/matching (UID2, RampID) and deconfliction.
    • Working knowledge of privacy and compliance practices (GDPR/CCPA) in data workflows.
  • Platform excellence
    • CI/CD, containers, test strategy; observability (metrics/logs/tracing) with tools like Datadog; incident readiness and SLO thinking.
  • AI fluency (must‑have)
    • Demonstrated, recent hands-on use of AI‑assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, OpenAI‑based assistants) to improve speed and quality.
    • Experience defining reusable prompts/workflows for team use and contributing to AI‑enabled internal tools or automation.
    • Ability to evaluate when to apply AI vs. deterministic systems; familiarity with evaluation, guardrails, and security/privacy implications in AI usage.
  • Collaboration and communication
    • Clear technical writing; stakeholder management; ability to drive consensus and unblock execution.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct experience with UID2/TTD integrations, Roku/Pubmatic/NBCU, or Meta Advanced Analytics/Google ADH pipelines.
  • Catalog/taxonomy, entity lineage, or custom hierarchy systems.
  • Snowflake governance patterns, partner data collaboration at scale.

Why this role is a great opportunity....

  • Collaborate with strong cross‑functional partners and enjoy occasional trips to our Toronto office to connect with the broader engineering community.

Location: can be remote,within +/-3 hours CET

Contract: Consultancy contract, one year, 120 days (with possible extension)

Starting date: asap

Deadline to apply: 22nd of October 2026

I. MSF INTERNATIONAL

Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international, independent, medical humanitarian organisation that delivers emergency aid to people affected by armed conflict, epidemics, healthcare exclusion and natural disasters. MSF offers assistance to people based only on need and irrespective of race, religion, gender or political affiliation.

MSF International is the legal entity that binds MSF’s 24 sections, 27 associations and 18 branch offices together. Registered in Switzerland, MSF International provides coordination, information and support to the MSF Movement, as well as implements international projects and initiatives as requested.

II. POSITION BACKGROUND

MSF develops medical-operational guidelines to support staff in providing quality health care and rapid emergency response in humanitarian contexts. MSF international guidelines are regularly updated and published in digital and print. They are based on extensive practical experience from MSF programs, recommendations published by the World Health Organization and other leading medical institutions, and evidence based on research and scientific literature. The International Guideline Publications (IGP) team was established to ensure the quality production of MSF guidelines. There are currently around 30 international guidelines in the MSF guidelines library, accessible at medicalguidelines.msf.org, some produced in multiple languages (English, French, Spanish, Arabic) and a selection with open access to the public.

This consultancy is focused on the edition of the revision of MSF’s HIV guidelines, with a maximum of two guidelines being edited at the same time within this consultancy assignment.

III. PLACE IN THE ORGANISATION

This consultancy is part of the International Guidelines Publication (IGP) team of MSF International. The consultant reports directly to the IGP Manager and works in close collaboration with guidelines team members, particularly the other medical editors in the team, as well as the HIV medical platform and other internal stakeholders.

IV. OBJECTIVES OF THE POSITION

  1. Editorial oversight and quality assurance: ensure MSF's international HIV guidelines are high-quality, scientifically sound, and consistent with existing guidelines. Confirm they comply with MSF International guideline standards and respond to the specific needs of health care professionals working in resources limited settings.

  2. Quality improvement: Apply quality standards set when editing the guidelines.

  3. Stakeholder collaboration and engagement: collaborate effectively with author-coordinator, IGP team members as well as internal experts throughout the editing process.

  4. Validation and approval: verify all validation process steps to secure approvals from relevant experts and MSF’s Medical Directors.

  5. Development process oversight: oversee the entire development process of the revisions from project planning, to content review to final publication.

V. MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Preparation and planning

  • Participation in the selection of author coordinator(s) for new guidelines, upon request;

  • In collaboration with the author coordinator(s), outline the division of tasks and responsibilities of the author coordinator(s), editor and other key collaborators as well as their functional links, following the standards set;

  • Contribute to an arbitration processes where necessary;

  • Brief and support author coordinators on editorial processes, authorship policy, and production workflows, supported by the IGP editors and manager;

  • Share the Authorship policy with author coordinator(s), and key collaborators;  

  • Provide input on and validate structure of the guideline, following the concept note approved by MSF’s Medical directors;   

  • Provide input on and validate draft table of content, and timeline documents, based on the concept note approved by MSF’s Medical directors;   

  • Ensure timely involvement of and input from MSF and external experts in the planning document.

2. Medical content editing

  • Provide input throughout the writing process and review draft chapters for completeness, coherence, practical use, and adherence to guidelines;

  • Ensure the content is evidence-based with accurate references, and the quality of it, and ensure coherence of data, figures, and protocols.

  • Check if the text is complete, concise and coherent and in line with the agreed table of content and Guide for producing guidelines and suggest improvements for clarity and readability.

  • Evaluate the presentation of content and ensure it aligns with the Guide for Producing Guidelines and Style guide and, in collaboration with the Designer, if it is suitable for both print and digital formats.

  • Verify drug dosages, treatment protocols, and medical terminology for accuracy and consistency.

  • Ensure a consistent tone, terminology, structure, and formatting throughout the document.

  • Validate references, footnotes, glossary, and illustrations for accuracy and compliance.

  • Ensure contributors are correctly listed according to the authorship policy.

3. Coordination

  • Confirm that all assigned experts have contributed their input and participate in arbitration processes when necessary.

  • Coordinate with the Translation coordinator for copy editing and process feedback effectively.

  • Submit the final version to Medical Directors for review and support the presentation of the guideline.

  • Assist in incorporating feedback from Medical Directors and provide a list of changes.

  • Submit guidelines to the Designer for publication in both print and digital formats.

  • Check the final text to be sent to the Translator coordinator and send it over;

  • Liaise with the Translation coordinator and assist in resolving language or terminology issues.

4. Reporting

  • Provide regular information on the progress of activities to IGP manager;

  • Actively participate in monthly update meetings.

Requirements

Required qualifications and experience

  • Medical diploma as doctor

  • Background or experience in HIV is considered an asset

  • Minimum 5 years' proven experience in medical content editing, ideally within public health, HIV content, humanitarian, or clinical settings. Equivalent skills must be clearly demonstrated through relevant professional experience;

  • Minimum of 5 years field experience with MSF or other international organizations working in similar contexts, ideally in HIV programmes;

  • Familiarity with medical guideline development, systematic reviews, and evidence-based publishing.

Proficient in editing scientific and medical content, with demonstrated ability to apply consistent referencing, citation formatting, and adherence to rigorous scientific writing standards;

  • Experience working with multidisciplinary teams and coordinating complex editorial processes.

Key skills and competencies

  • Strong command of written English

  • Advanced skills in medical writing, editing, and fact-checking.

  • Ability to synthesize complex scientific information into clear, structured, and practical applicable content.

  • Excellent organizational skills, project management an asset.

  • Attention to detail and commitment to editorial quality.

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills.

  • Collaborative mindset and ability to support others.

  • Ability to work and report independently

  • IT literacy

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

At MSF, we are committed to an inclusive culture that encourages and supports the diverse voices of our employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, nationalities, races, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics.

MSF is committed to preventing abuse, inappropriate behaviour, lack of integrity and financial misconduct in its work and care spaces. MSF expects all staff to share this commitment and promote an environment where abuse and misconduct is not tolerated.

We are committed to removing barriers for people with specific accessibility needs. If you need an adjustment to the recruitment process to be considered for the role, please let us know from the beginning of the selection process.

Note: All offers of employment will be subject to reference checks and to appropriate screening checks. By submitting an application, the job applicant confirms his/her/their understanding of these recruitment procedures.

jobs.description:
Tiugo is the company behind CKEditor, TinyMCE, and Uploadcare: developer tools that power rich content creation inside thousands of applications worldwide.

Our primary audience is the builder, the developer architecting an application that needs an embedded, enterprise-grade content and AI layer, where governance, compliance, and control are not nice-to-haves but hard requirements.

Behind every one of our products is a genuinely good story about solving exactly that problem well. Most of the world hasn't heard it yet.

The storyteller we're looking for

Great product marketing for developer tools lives in two worlds at once, and most people are only comfortable in one. You're very comfortable in both.

  • With builders, you go deep: Our primary audience is the developer designing an application where an embedded content and AI layer has to hold up to enterprise governance, compliance, and control. You want to understand their architecture, their constraints, the trade-offs they're weighing. You ask good technical questions, you respect their time, and you earn trust by getting the details right. Hand-wavy marketing makes you wince.

  • With decision-makers, you zoom out: You can take that same product and tell a crisp business story to a CTO, a VP of Engineering, or a product leader, people who care less about the internals and more about velocity, risk, cost, and staying compliant and in control as they ship AI into production. You make the value obvious without dumbing it down.

Where you sit

You report to your brand's Head of Product Marketing and work inside a tight pod built around a single brand: product marketing, developer relations, and the product team. Each function keeps its own reporting line, DevRel within a central DevRel team, product managers within Product. But the three move in lockstep on one mission: make the brand impossible to ignore. You'll be in the room with the people building the product and the people talking to developers every day. The raw material for great stories is right there; your job is to shape it.

What you will do

  • Tell the technical story: Turn real product capability into messaging that's accurate, vivid, and credible to the builders staking an enterprise application on it, developers who need governance, compliance, and control baked in, not bolted on. Honesty and precision are how trust gets earned here.

  • Tell the business story: Translate that same product into the language of the people who sign off, the outcomes, the risk reduction, the AI-era advantage. Build the narratives, decks, and proof points that help close enterprise deals.

  • Drive launches that land: Plan and run product and feature launches end to end, in concert with DevRel, product, and Growth Marketing, so releases hit with real impact instead of a quiet blog post.

  • Create content across the spectrum: From deeply technical deep-dives and comparison pieces to executive one-pagers and build-versus-buy narratives, you choose the right depth for the right reader every time.

  • Go to the source: Talk to developers and buyers, sit close to product usage and win/loss patterns, and bring real voices, not assumptions, into everything the team ships.

  • Win the AI discovery layer: Help the brand show up sharply when developers and buyers research through AI tools and search. How we get cited and surfaced is part of the modern storyteller's job.

  • Sharpen the edge: Know the competitors and alternatives cold, and arm the team with positioning that makes clear where this brand wins and why.

Requirements

What we are looking ror

  • +5 years in product marketing, technical content, DevRel-adjacent, or product roles, in B2B software, developer tools, or technical products.

  • A genuinely great writer and storyteller who can flex from deeply technical to plainly strategic, and knows which one a given audience needs.

  • Real curiosity about how things work. You enjoy going deep with engineers and you don't fake technical understanding, you build it.

  • The business instinct to see past features to outcomes, and to frame technology, especially AI, as the answer to a buyer's actual problem.

  • AI-fluent in how you work: you use AI tools to research, draft, and ship faster, and you're energized by how AI is reshaping both our products and how buyers discover them.

  • Rigor and care: you check your facts, sweat the details, and take pride in getting it right.

  • A fast, collaborative operator who thrives in a cross-functional team and doesn't wait to be told exactly what to do.

  • Bonus: experience with PLG / self-serve products, developer marketing, or a multi-brand portfolio.

Why this might be the role for you

  • Stories worth telling: real products developers genuinely love, with substance behind every claim. You'll never have to manufacture hype for something hollow.

  • A front-row seat to the craft: work shoulder to shoulder with the people building the product and learn directly from an experienced product marketing leader.

  • Work that ships and shows: your messaging, content, and launches reach the market fast and visibly. You'll see your impact, not just report on it.

  • Room to grow: this is a function we're investing in. Do great work and there's real room to rise.

If you love going deep with the builders shipping AI into enterprise applications and love making that technology make sense to the people who buy it, you'll feel at home here.

Why join us

  • Annual financial bonus depending on the company’s performance.

  • Flexible schedule and fully remote work.

  • Professional development resources.

  • LinkedIn Learning access.

  • Extra leave for Tiugo Day - our company’s foundation day and your birthday.

  • English lessons with a native speaker and an online language platform where you can learn English, Spanish, German, Italian and French.

  • Access to a mental health and well-being platform with 24/7 dedicated psychological support.

  • 2 weeks of paid parental leave for our contractors.

Overview

Bruker is one of the world’s leading analytical instrumentation companies enabling scientists to make breakthrough discoveries and develop new applications that improve the quality of human life. Our high-performance products and high-value life science and diagnostic solutions are trusted by leading businesses, institutes, and scientists worldwide. Today, more than 8,500 employees at over 90 locations are working on this permanent challenge to make the world a better place.

The Staff Scientific Product Marketing Manager for the spatial proteomics portfolio shapes market strategy and drives commercial success for Bruker’s spatial proteomics platforms by bridging science, product strategy, and go‑to‑market execution. With deep understanding of spatial proteomics, multiplex immunofluorescence, multiomics workflows, and translational research use cases, the Sr. Scientific Product Marketing Manager translates complex technical capabilities into clear, differentiated value propositions for pharma, biotech, and academic researchers, defining positioning, crafting the narrative, and equipping commercial teams with scientifically credible messaging, as well as developing and executing content pieces to communicate the product stories. The role works cross‑functionally with R&D, product management, commercial teams, and leadership to champion customer needs and advance adoption of the CellScape and GeoMx platforms. Ideal candidates thrive at the intersection of science, strategy, and storytelling, shaping market understanding of Bruker’s instruments to support spatial proteomics platforms across the full product lifecycle.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities:

  • Product Positioning & Messaging: Partner with Product Management and cross-functional teams to develop compelling positioning and messaging for the CellScape and GeoMx platforms. Clearly articulate each product’s value proposition and ensure consistent, accurate, and up-to-date messaging across all marketing channels. Maintain message integrity and alignment over time, minimizing inconsistencies across regions, campaigns, and content types.
  • Campaign & Content Execution: Execute integrated campaigns that support global marketing programs. Coordinate the development of content and creative assets, including social and digital materials, and manage release timing across channels. Monitor campaign performance and optimize based on engagement metrics and channel insights. Collaborate with marketing programs to deploy content through an omnichannel approach.
  • Go-to-Market & Lead Activation: Translate go-to-market strategies into actionable marketing plans that drive qualified leads and support sales pipeline growth. Manage lead generation efforts across campaigns, webinars, and events, including audience targeting and list sourcing from associations, conferences, and external partners.
  • Sales Enablement: Equip the commercial team with the tools, training and resources needed to effectively communicate the value of Bruker Spatial Biology products. Support the sales process by tailoring content to specific buyer personas and stages of the customer journey, helping to accelerate deal velocity and improve win rates.
  • Competitive Analysis and Market Research: Evaluate competitors' products, messaging, customers, publications, market share, features, and customer perceptions to gain actionable insights that inform strategic decisions and shape the messaging and positioning of Bruker Spatial Biology products. Provide periodic updates to the commercial team on recent developments from the competitors.
  • Performance Tracking & Reporting: Track and report on the performance of marketing initiatives. Analyze key metrics such as lead volume, conversion rates, and return on investment (ROI) to guide future program improvements.

Qualifications

Qualifications:

  • Education: Advanced degree (MS or PhD) in life sciences, molecular biology, immunology, oncology, or a related field required.
  • Scientific Expertise: Strong working knowledge of molecular biology, sequencing, proteomics and multiomics approaches (RNA/protein), and spatial biology. Familiarity with spatial proteomics and high-plex proteomics technologies is highly desirable.
  • Marketing & Commercial Experience: 3-7+ years of experience in product marketing, product management, applications, or related commercial roles in the life sciences/tools industry. Experience developing product positioning, messaging, and go‑to‑market strategies for scientific instruments, assays, or software. Proven ability to partner with sales and applications teams to support field enablement and customer engagement.
  • Strategic & Analytical Skills: Ability to translate complex scientific concepts into clear, differentiated value propositions for multiple audience types. Strong market and competitive analysis skills and experience identifying customer needs and emerging trends. Demonstrated success in driving cross‑functional alignment and influencing without authority.
  • Communication & Content Development: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with ability to craft scientific yet commercially relevant materials. Experience developing marketing collateral, campaigns, presentations, and digital content is a plus.
  • Collaboration & Leadership: Effective at working across R&D, product management, sales, applications, and leadership teams. Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize effectively, and drive initiatives from concept to execution.
  • Other Preferred Experience: Background working with biopharma, biotech startups, CROs, or translational research groups. Willingness to travel for customer visits, conferences, and internal company events, up to 15%.

At Bruker, base salary is part of our total compensation. The estimated base salary range for this full-time position is between $108,000 and $173,000 provides an opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base salary for the role will depend on a several job-related factors, including, but not limited to education, training, experience, the geographic location of the successful candidate, skills, competencies, job-related knowledge and travel requirements for this position. Full-time employees may also be eligible for a performance-related incentive in addition to a full range of benefits including 401(k) with company match, an employee stock purchase plan, medical and dental plans, life insurance, short-term and long-term disability insurance, employee assistance program and paid time off including vacation, sick time and holidays, and more.

Warum sich uns 2026 anschließen?

Für unser wachsendes E-Commerce‑Geschäft suchen wir eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit für die Rolle Regional Sales Manager Hunting – E-Commerce (m/w/d), die den Auf- und Ausbau neuer Kundenbeziehungen im Deutschen Mittelstand verantwortet.

Deine Mission

Du baust aktiv eine Neukunden‑Pipeline im E‑Commerce auf und gewinnst skalierbare Händler und digitale Geschäftsmodelle für Nexi. Als echter Hunter identifizierst du Potenziale, steuerst den kompletten Sales‑Funnel bis zum Abschluss und übergibst gewonnene aktive Kunden strukturiert in die Bestandsbetreuung.
