jobs.excerpt: SummaryAre you a frontend engineer who treats rendering pipelines, frame budgets, and library API design as a craft?
jobs.description:
Summary

Are you a frontend engineer who treats rendering pipelines, frame budgets, and library API design as a craft? Topstep is looking for a Staff Software Engineer to help build a custom charting engine for the TopstepX trading platform — a framework-agnostic library that renders the real-time charts thousands of active traders rely on every day.

The library is organized as overlapping rendering layers — candles, grid, indicators, positions, drawings — most rendered on Canvas 2D. Your work spans the layer system, real-time data plumbing, indicator math, drawing tools, and the public API the rest of the platform builds against. You'll also build and maintain the React binding that adapts the core for the TopstepX web app; a React Native binding will follow as the mobile app matures. A WebGL layer may be added later for higher-density visualizations. The core has no framework dependencies; the bindings are thin wrappers above it.

This role is ideal for someone who has shipped a production charting or visualization library before, understands what it takes to keep an interactive UI smooth while data flows in the background, and has strong opinions on what makes a good API. You'll set the bar for performance, write the abstractions other engineers will consume, and help define what engineering excellence means for this initiative.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and build core systems of the charting engine — rendering primitives (layer system, hit testing, dirty-region rendering, text measurement) and domain features (drawing tools, indicator math).
  • Own the framework-agnostic core library architecture, including the public API that React, React Native, and direct consumers integrate against.
  • Build and maintain the React binding — the thin wrapper layer that adapts the core's public API into framework-native components, hooks, and lifecycle integration. The React Native binding follows as the mobile app matures.
  • Drive architectural decisions on canvas compositing, layer strategy, and main-thread vs. worker-thread boundaries.
  • Define and uphold rendering performance standards across the engine — 60fps frame-budget discipline and pointer-interaction responsiveness under continuous data flow.
  • Build the data integration layer that bridges the existing real-time data pipeline into the charting engine.
  • Ensure charting engine is consistent and performant across a wide range of devices, from desktop to tablets to mobile.
  • Establish visual testing standards including pixel diffing, deterministic replay-based tests, and golden-image regression discipline.
  • Lead architectural reviews and RFCs for the charting library, driving consensus on library architecture across the trading platform without direct authority.
  • Mentor engineers on the charting team through code reviews, design reviews, pairing, and technical coaching.
  • Balance technical debt with feature delivery based on long-term library health and consumer needs.
  • Communicate technical direction, trade-offs, and risk clearly to engineering peers and platform leadership.

Required Qualifications and Key Competencies

  • 8 + years of frontend engineering experience building and shipping production systems.
  • Prior experience building or contributing to a production charting library, data visualization framework, or comparable interactive rendering system.
  • Working knowledge of financial markets — OHLCV, tick data, and futures conventions — sufficient to make informed product and architectural trade-offs.
  • Deep proficiency in TypeScript including strict mode, advanced generics, and designing public APIs that other engineers consume.
  • Deep proficiency in React, including production experience designing component libraries, hooks APIs, or framework binding layers.
  • Production experience with frontend graphics rendering, particularly Canvas 2D — multi-layer compositing, dirty-region rendering, and text metrics.
  • Demonstrated performance discipline for 60fps real-time rendering — Chrome profiler fluency, frame-budget analysis, and the ability to keep pointer-driven interactions smooth while data flows continuously in the background.
  • Production experience with Web Workers and SharedArrayBuffer — zero-copy data pipelines, typed-array views over shared memory, Atomics for generation counters, and off-main-thread compute architecture.
  • 2D math fluency — coordinate transforms, viewport projection, and hit testing.
  • Track record of architecting libraries with public APIs that consumers integrate against without leaking implementation details.
  • Discipline around visual testing — pixel diffing, deterministic replay-based tests, and willingness to write and maintain them.
  • Proven ability to influence technical direction across teams without direct authority.

Nice to Have

  • Production experience with real-time streaming systems — WebSocket lifecycle, backpressure, reconnection, and replay.
  • React Native, react-native-skia, expo-gl, or JSI experience.
  • Order flow and market microstructure knowledge — footprint charts, volume profile, DOM, cumulative delta.
  • MessagePack or protobuf experience for binary serialization on the data pipeline.
  • WebGL2 experience — for a possible future high-density rendering layer.
  • WebGPU / WGSL experience (long-term migration target).
  • Rust + WASM experience (the indicator compute layer is the most likely candidate for a Rust rewrite).
  • PineScript or other charting DSL familiarity (for transpiler/runtime work in a later phase).
  • Open source contributions to graphics, charting, or financial libraries.

Company Culture & Perks

  • Topstep is an engaging working environment which ranges from fully remote to hybrid. We foster a culture of collaboration with cameras on during meetings and a robust Slack environment for communication.
  • Seven Company-paid Holidays and generous Family Leave. Paid time off is front-loaded.
  • Competitive 401(k) matching, health, dental, and vision insurance is offered for full time employees.
  • Vacations are encouraged with a bonus for taking 5 consecutive days. Employee referrals are bonused. Topstep offers a food and groceries budget and contributes towards health and wellness.

New Hire Base Salary Range

  • $200,000 – $250,000.
  • Bonus: This position is eligible for a performance-based bonus as provided by the plan terms and governing documents.
  • The compensation offered will take into account internal compensation structure and may vary depending on the candidate's geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Topstep is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where all employees and applicants are valued. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status, in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Senior Associate, Neurology Medical Marketing - Operations & Programs


What you will do


The Senior Associate, Neurology Medical Marketing - Operations & Programs will provide operational coordination and executional support across the U.S. Neurology Medical Marketing organization, including the Opinion Leader Engagement & Peer-to-Peer and Insights & Congress Strategy sleeves. Reporting to the Neuro Medical Marketing Lead, this individual will convert strategic priorities into clear project plans, reliable operating rhythms, accurate trackers, and well-prepared teams across gMG and NMOSD.

This role is designed to build a strong foundation in Medical Marketing while ensuring priority medical marketing workstreams are executed flawlessly. The Senior Associate will work closely with Senior Manager and Manager leaders, HCP Operations, agencies, and cross-functional partners to support congresses, Speaker Bureau and P2P programs, advisory boards, field insights, budgets, and team operations. The role will own defined operational workstreams and receive structured stretch opportunities to build broader marketing judgment, customer understanding, and strategic capability.

Key Responsibilities


Strengthen Medical Marketing Operations

  • Maintain the integrated Medical Marketing calendar, workback plans, action logs, status trackers, and core documentation across P2P, opinion leader engagement, insights, advisory boards, and congress workstreams.
  • Coordinate recurring planning, status, preparation, and debrief meetings; prepare agendas and materials, capture decisions and actions, and follow through with accountable owners.
  • Support budget tracking, purchase-order and invoice coordination, forecast inputs, and reconciliation activities in partnership with workstream owners, Finance, Procurement, HCP Operations, and agency partners.
  • Build consistent operating tools, templates, and file-management practices that improve visibility, reduce duplication, and enable the team to deliver work on time and with appropriate controls.

Support Congress Planning and Execution

  • Support the Insights & Congress Strategy and Opinion Leader Engagement & P2P leads with congress kickoffs, project plans, internal readiness meetings, deliverable tracking, and pre-congress/post-congress closeout activities.
  • Coordinate (internal/external) congress communications and operational documentation, including sponsorship tracking, required submissions, stakeholder updates, vendor coordination, and deadline management under workstream-lead direction.

  • Partner with Professional Marketing on handoffs and interdependencies while respecting its ownership of booth-related and sales-driven assets, including Tier 3 local conference kits.

Enable Speaker Bureau and P2P Program Readiness

  • Coordinate speaker training operations, including training calendars, invitations, attendance, completion records, materials readiness, follow-up actions, and appropriate documentation.
  • Partner with HCP Operations and the P2P lead to help ensure trained speakers have timely access to approved materials and that program requirements, system updates, and readiness steps are completed.
  • Support marketing-led HCP education and engagement programs with project plans, materials routing, stakeholder communications, vendor logistics, budget tracking, and program closeout; escalate risks or delays early.

Support Advisory Boards and Insight Operations

Build Commercial and Medical Marketing Capability

Collaborate and Deliver with Excellence

  • Build strong working relationships across HCP Operations, HCP Marketing, Medical Affairs, Field Medical, TLLs, Sales, Training, Regulatory, Legal, Finance, Procurement, Global, Professional Marketing, and external agencies.
  • Manage sensitive information, budgets, deadlines, and partner interactions with professionalism, accuracy, sound judgment, and a strong commitment to compliance.

  • Drive operational excellence by maintaining marketing systems, identifying process improvements, and fostering a collaborative, high-performing team culture while living Amgen Values.

What We Expect of You

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree and 2 years of marketing and/or business experience in a role aligned with a Marketing/Sales commercial organization; OR
  • Associate's degree and 6 years of marketing and/or business experience in a role aligned with a Marketing/Sales commercial organization; OR

Do you care about keeping developer tools running reliably, enjoy digging into the systems and infrastructure behind them, and know that reliable tools make all the difference for development teams? If you are calm under pressure, enjoy diagnosing complex systems, want to help developers overcome technical hurdles, and thrive on deep problem-solving across diverse tech stacks, this role is for you.

About JetBrains

We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

About TeamCity

TeamCity is a highly scalable CI/CD server that integrates across the modern software ecosystem. Because it supports complex server-side setups and SaaS deployments, issues can stem from the product itself or the surrounding infrastructure.

What you’ll do

As part of our Support Engineering team, you will act as a crucial link between global engineering teams and our internal product developers. You will take ownership of incoming technical issues, pinpoint root causes, and provide working resolutions or clear escalations. You'll work American-timezone hours to give our global community timely, effective support.

Day to day, you will:

  • Identify whether an issue stems from the product, infrastructure, or third-party integrations.
  • Provide workarounds, submit bug reports, or escalate issues directly to development.
  • Capture insights and publish solutions following KCS (Knowledge-Centered Service) principles.
  • Share user feedback with internal product teams to shape future tool improvements.

What you’ll bring

  • A systematic and structured, but flexible approach to troubleshooting complex software and infrastructure issues.
  • A clear, direct communication style that explains technical details in ways others can understand.
  • Comfort working independently across distributed teams and time zones.
  • Curiosity about how different build systems, VCS providers, and clouds operate together.
  • An inclination to leave documentation and systems better than you found them.

What you’ll need

  • Fluency in English, with strong written communication skills.
  • The ability to work aligned with American time zones.
  • Practical experience troubleshooting web servers and applications (such as Tomcat and Java-based environments).
  • A working knowledge of relational databases (such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, or MSSQL).
  • Hands-on experience with version control tools and hosting platforms (such as Git or Perforce, GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket).
  • Familiarity with build automation tools (such as Gradle, Maven, or .NET build systems).
  • An understanding of containerized environments or cloud infrastructure (such as Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, or Azure).

What success looks like

Success in this role means resolving complex support cases efficiently while maintaining clear communication with developers. You build trust by accurately diagnosing underlying infrastructure or application bugs rather than addressing symptoms alone. Over time, your contributions to the knowledge base reduce repeat issues, and your feedback helps product teams make TeamCity more resilient.

Managing Director, Account Management

Location: Remote, USA

Department: GTM — Account Management

About Syllo

Syllo is defining the Litigation AI category. We are the first unified platform designed to autonomously manage the entire litigation lifecycle end-to-end. Founded in 2019 by a team of litigators and engineers, Syllo enables legal teams to securely harness the power of AI across any matter, regardless of complexity or scale. Our technology supports Fortune 500 companies and AmLaw 200 firms managing their most complex litigation portfolios. Awarded ILTA Transformative Project of the Year and ALM eDiscovery Technology of the Year for 2026, we are the market leader in enterprise-grade litigation AI. Backed by top-tier VCs, we are at a clear inflection point — the team has doubled in the last six months and growth is accelerating.

About the role

Own the expansion motion and protect the revenue base that funds our growth.

This role leads Syllo's account management function — responsible for net revenue retention, expansion ARR, and the health of relationships with our most strategic customers. You will build and lead the AM team, establish the playbooks for expansion selling and executive relationship management, and own the number that measures whether our customers stay and grow.

Syllo's growth equation depends on compounding expansion ACV as much as new logo acquisition. The Managing Director of Account Management is the owner of that equation — accountable for identifying expansion opportunities, building champions, navigating renewal risk, and ensuring that every customer is positioned to grow into the full platform.

We are looking for a leader who treats account management as a revenue discipline, not a service function. Someone who has built expansion playbooks, hired and developed AM talent, and held a team accountable to a net revenue retention number with the same rigor as a sales target.

What you will do

  • Own net revenue retention and expansion ARR: Set the target, build the forecast, and deliver the number. Expansion is a sales motion — run it like one.
  • Build and lead the AM team: Hire and develop Account Managers with the commercial instincts and legal domain knowledge to operate at AmLaw 200 and Fortune 500 accounts.
  • Define the expansion playbook: Establish the framework for identifying expansion signals, advancing champion relationships, navigating multi-stakeholder renewals, and closing upsell.
  • Manage strategic accounts directly: Maintain executive relationships at the most complex accounts. Sponsor critical renewal and expansion conversations.
  • Partner with CS and Sales: Align with Customer Success on health signals and adoption data, and with Sales on cross-sell motion into new practice groups or business units.
  • Surface market intelligence: Your accounts are Syllo's closest signal on product gaps, competitive exposure, and category evolution. Bring that intelligence to the leadership team.

What you bring

  • Expansion revenue ownership: You have owned a net revenue retention or expansion ARR target — not managed accounts as a support function. You know the difference.
  • Account management leadership: You have built and managed AM teams with clear quota structures, pipeline discipline, and coaching cadences.
  • Executive relationship depth: You build relationships with General Counsel, CLO, and litigation leadership — not just operational contacts — and you sustain them through contract cycles.
  • Renewal risk management: You identify at-risk accounts early, diagnose the root cause, and build a recovery plan before the conversation becomes a negotiation.
  • Legal domain fluency: You understand how law firms and in-house legal departments evaluate, renew, and expand technology relationships — the internal politics, the budget cycle, and the procurement process.
  • Commercial rigor: You apply the same qualification and inspection discipline to expansion opportunities that a strong AE applies to new logo deals.

Experience and qualifications

  • 8+ years of enterprise SaaS account management or customer success experience, including 3+ years in a leadership role.
  • Demonstrated ownership of net revenue retention or expansion ARR targets at a high-growth B2B SaaS company.
  • Track record of building expansion playbooks and managing AM teams with commercial accountability.
  • Experience managing enterprise accounts at law firms or Fortune 500 legal departments is a strong advantage.
  • Bachelor's degree required. MBA is a plus.

Total rewards and benefits

At Syllo, we believe in taking care of our team so they can focus on building the future of legal tech.

Compensation: $225,000 + equity options.

Benefits: Medical, dental, vision, and voluntary insurance options. Vacation, sick leave, and paid holidays. Access to benefit counselors and fitness class reimbursements.

Growth: Annual learning and development budget and real career growth in a fast-scaling organization.

Equal opportunity employer

We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We provide a fair and accessible hiring process. If you require accommodations during the application or interview stage, please let us know.

Job Purpose

To manage and oversee regulatory reporting activities for the bank for UAE / overseas branch jurisdictions, ensuring accuracy, completeness, timeliness, and compliance with applicable regulatory standards. The role is responsible for maintaining a strong control environment around regulatory submissions, driving issue resolution, coordinating with internal and external stakeholders, and supporting strategic regulatory and reporting initiatives. The role also supports automation, digitization, data transformation, and AI-enabled initiatives aimed at enhancing reporting efficiency, scalability, data quality, and governance across the regulatory reporting function.

Key Result Areas

Manage preparation, review, and submission of regulatory reports for UAE / overseas branches / SCA / DFSA / Subsidiaries / Islamic banking within prescribed timelines, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and compliance with applicable regulatory requirements.

Manage reporting related to Basel regulatory requirements including Capital Adequacy Ratio (CAR), Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR), Net Stable Funding Ratio (NSFR), Leverage Ratio, large exposure reporting, and other prudential and statistical returns.

Ensure compliance with Central Bank regulations, regulatory requirements, and internal governance standards.

Maintain a strong control environment around regulatory reporting processes, including reconciliations, validations, data quality checks, governance controls, and supporting documentation.

Coordinate with Finance, Risk, Treasury, Operations, Compliance, Technology, and overseas branch teams to ensure integrity and consistency of regulatory reporting data.

Monitor and assess impact of new regulatory requirements, business changes, and financial transactions on regulatory reporting obligations.

Drive timely resolution of reporting issues, reconciliation breaks, data inconsistencies, regulatory queries, and audit observations.

Support Central Bank examinations, regulatory reviews, internal audits, and external audits by coordinating responses, providing reporting analysis, and ensuring timely closure of observations and action items.

Review and enhance reporting methodologies, assumptions, mapping logic, and reporting processes to ensure alignment with regulatory expectations and best practices.

Lead and support automation, digitization, and AI-enabled initiatives aimed at improving reporting efficiency, scalability, controls, and data quality.

Support implementation and enhancement of regulatory reporting systems, dashboards, reconciliation tools, and data governance frameworks.

Identify opportunities for process optimization, standardization, and strengthening of reporting governance across UAE and overseas reporting environments.

Provide reporting analysis, insights, and updates to senior management and relevant governance forums.

Contribute to regulatory reporting transformation initiatives and continuous improvement programs across the bank.

Operating Environment, Framework and Boundaries, Working Relationships

Operates within a highly regulated banking environment with responsibility for ensuring timely, accurate, and compliant regulatory reporting across UAE and overseas jurisdictions. The role functions within established regulatory frameworks, governance standards, delegated authorities, internal control requirements, and bank policies while supporting a strong control environment around regulatory submissions, reconciliations, issue resolution, and data governance.

The role requires close coordination with Finance, Risk, Treasury, Operations, Compliance, Technology, Data Governance, Internal Audit, overseas branches, regulators, and external auditors to manage reporting obligations, regulatory queries, system enhancements, automation, digitization, and AI-enabled reporting initiatives. The position is expected to exercise sound professional judgment, manage competing priorities under tight timelines, identify process improvement opportunities, and contribute to strengthening reporting governance, operational efficiency, and regulatory compliance across the bank.

Problem Solving

Investigate and resolve complex reporting issues, reconciliation breaks, data inconsistencies, and regulatory interpretation matters.

Analyze root causes of reporting variances and implement sustainable corrective actions.

Assess impact of new products, transactions, regulatory updates, and organizational changes on reporting obligations.

Evaluate process inefficiencies and recommend control enhancements and technology-driven solutions.

Escalate material reporting issues and regulatory risks appropriately while proposing practical remediation plans.

Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance reporting accuracy, controls, operational resilience, and process efficiency.

Decision Making Authority & Responsibility

Review and approve regulatory reporting outputs prior to submission in line with delegated authority.

Exercise judgment on reporting interpretations, materiality assessments, control exceptions, and issue escalation.

Recommend enhancements to reporting frameworks, governance standards, controls, automation opportunities, and reporting processes.

Coordinate prioritization of reporting deliverables, issue resolution, regulatory commitments, and transformation initiatives.

Support senior management in managing regulatory reporting risk, governance, and compliance obligations.

Act as a key point of contact for regulatory reporting matters across relevant jurisdictions.

Contribute to strategic decisions relating to reporting transformation, automation, digitization, AI adoption, and process optimization initiatives.

Knowledge, Skills and Experience

Chartered Accountant with 13 -15 years of relevant banking experience, preferably within regulatory reporting, finance control, financial reporting, or banking finance functions.

Experience dealing with regulators, auditors, and cross-functional stakeholders.

Experience in large banking environments with complex reporting structures and regulatory requirements.

Knowledge of prudential regulations, capital adequacy, liquidity reporting, and regulatory governance.

Understanding of banking products, treasury activities, risk concepts, and financial control processes.

Exposure to reporting automation, data transformation, analytics, or AI-enabled reporting environments is preferred.

Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.

Ability to interpret regulations and translate requirements into reporting processes and system requirements.

Strong attention to detail with a control-oriented mindset.

Ability to manage multiple priorities and work under tight regulatory timelines.

jobs.description:
Senior Staff Full-stack Engineer (Remote-Eligible) - Global Payment Network

As a Senior Staff Engineer at Capital One, you will be part of a community of technical experts working to define the future of banking in the cloud. You will work alongside our talented team of developers, machine learning experts, product managers and people leaders. Our Senior Staff Engineers are leading experts in their domains, helping devise practical and reusable solutions to complex problems. You will drive innovation at multiple levels, helping optimize business outcomes while delivering strong technology solutions.


At Capital One, we believe diversity of thought strengthens our ability to influence, collaborate and provide the most innovative solutions across organizational boundaries. You will promote a culture of engineering excellence and strike the right balance between lending expertise and providing an inclusive environment where the ideas of others can be heard and championed. You will lead the way in creating next-generation talent for Capital One Tech, mentoring engineers and actively recruiting to keep building our community.


Senior Staff Engineers are expected to lead through technical contribution. You will operate as a trusted advisor for our key technologies, platforms and capability domains, creating clear and concise communications, code samples, blog posts and other materials to share knowledge both inside and outside the organization. You will specialize in a particular subject area, but your input and impact will be sought and expected throughout the organization.


About the Team: The Global Payment Network (GPN) Technology organization designs, builds, and operates the mission-critical systems and infrastructure that seamlessly power complex money movement across domestic and international rails. We build and operate a high-volume, low-latency, and highly resilient distributed ecosystem that is simultaneously secure, performant, accurate, and nimble.

As an engineer in the Global Payment Network, you will apply your technical acumen to shape and deliver solutions to complex problems at massive scale. You will engineer solutions across core network products, simplify global participant integration, and rapidly deliver new features. Leveraging automation and AI-native engineering, you will unlock real-time insights and advance our capabilities in domains ranging from high-throughput transaction processing to advanced fraud and risk mitigation.


What You’ll Do:

  • Articulate and evangelize a bold technical vision for your domain
  • Decompose complex problems into practical and operational solutions
  • Ensure the quality of technical design and implementation
  • Serve as an authoritative expert on non-functional system characteristics, such as performance, scalability and operability
  • Continue learning and injecting advanced technical knowledge into our community
  • Handle several projects simultaneously, balancing your time to maximize impact
  • Act as a role model and mentor within the tech community, helping to coach and strengthen the technical expertise and know-how of our engineering and product community
  • Drive modernization of monolithic systems into microservice architectures and event-driven platforms
  • Collaborate with senior engineering and architecture leaders to define long-term platform strategy and API standards
  • Serve as a force-multiplier for the team, balancing deep, hands-on technical contribution and innovation with mentoring and elevating the skills of peers and junior engineers.
  • Lead cross-divisional projects and impacts that promote technological best practices and enhancements

Capital One is open to hiring a Remote Employee for this opportunity.


Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree or higher in Computer Science or a related quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Engineering)
  • At least 9 years of experience in all of the following:
    • Software engineering and solution architecture
    • Enterprise architecture and design patterns
    • Cloud computing (AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud)
    • Data architecture

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master’s Degree in Computer Science or Software Engineering
  • 12+ years of experience in all of the following:
    • Software engineering and solution architecture
    • Enterprise architecture and design patterns
    • Web technologies (JavaScript, TypeScript and SPA frameworks)
    • Designing and building distributed HPC and ML systems
    • Cloud computing (AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud)
    • Data architecture
  • 12+ years of professional experience coding in commonly used languages like Go, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Rust, C#, Scala
  • 10+ years of experience with database and database management systems
  • 12+ years of professional experience in the full lifecycle of system development, from conception through architecture, implementation, testing, deployment and production support
  • 10+ years of experience with public cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), cloud-based productivity tools, or virtualization technologies
  • 12+ years of experience with Networking protocols and integration with third party distributed systems
  • 7+ years of experience mentoring senior engineers and driving professional development within technical teams
  • 3+ years of experience leading cross-domain architectural reviews or establishing coding and design standards
  • Expertise in the strategic application of agentic AI coding tools to solve systemic development challenges
  • Demonstrated experience as an active technical practitioner using AI-driven tools, frameworks, or modern software development practices
  • Experience working within the fintech industry, specifically in payment processing, merchant services, or digital payment architectures
  • Demonstrated ability to build and ship enterprise software iteratively, enterprise-scale data migrations and platform transformations in FinTech or large-scale enterprise organizations
  • Experience architecting, testing, and operating real-time, distributed data systems and high-volume pipelines
  • Strong ownership mindset with a destination-backwards approach to navigating ambiguity
  • Strategic thought partner and effective challenger across Product, Design, Risk, and Enterprise Tech leadership

jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.excerpt: ABOUT SINCH Sinch is pioneering the way the world communicates.
jobs.description:
ABOUT SINCH

Sinch is pioneering the way the world communicates. More than 200,000 businesses - including Google, Uber, Paypal, Visa, Tinder, and many others - rely on Sinch’s Customer Communications Cloud to power engaging customer experiences through mobile messaging, voice, and email.

Whether you need to verify users or craft omnichannel campaigns, Sinch makes it easy. Our AI-infused Super Network, APIs, and applications ensure you can connect with your customers reliably and securely, at every step of their journey.

At Sinch we “Dream Big”, “Win Together”, “Keep it simple”, and “Make it Happen”. These values are our foundation!

DESCRIPTION

Sinch provides API-based messaging, voice, and email capabilities that customers integrate into applications, workflows, data platforms, contact centers, and AI systems.

We are hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer to make those integrations work in the real world. You will embed with customer engineering and operations teams, use modern AI development tools to build production software rapidly, integrate it into existing technology stacks, and lead complex technical deployments to measurable outcomes. You are a production software engineer, customer solution architect, and technical delivery lead, accountable for making the customer solution work in production.

During product ramp-up and early customer engagements, you will work closely with named Voice, Messaging, and Email subject-matter experts. These SMEs provide deep guidance on product capabilities, solution fit, provisioning, country requirements, configuration, best practices, limitations, and complex product-level troubleshooting. Over time, you are expected to become self-sufficient in routine delivery across the supported Sinch CPaaS scope. Ongoing SME involvement focuses on keeping FDEs current with changes in products, technologies, markets, and use cases, and on exceptional deep-domain issues.

Engagements favor supported, generally available Sinch APIs and repeatable implementation patterns. The goal is to accelerate the customer into production and leave its engineering team able to operate and extend the implementation, not to create a permanent dependency on the FDE team.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

  • Help qualify the engagement. Evaluate technical readiness, feasibility, customer ownership, likely adoption, product gaps, and repeatability. Provide evidence and recommendations to the FDE lead and commercial owner, who make engagement and continued-investment decisions.

  • Lead technical delivery end to end. Run discovery, map workflows and dependencies, define measurable success and sign-off criteria, create the delivery plan, and own execution from prototype through production stabilization and handoff.

  • Design the solution. Translate business workflows into architectures that combine Sinch messaging, voice, or email APIs with customer applications, identity, data, events, AI systems, cloud platforms, and third-party services.

  • Build with AI and remain accountable. Use coding agents and AI-enabled development tools for codebase discovery, implementation, refactoring, tests, troubleshooting, and documentation. Validate generated output for correctness, security, performance, maintainability, and customer fit.

  • Integrate into the customer stack. Write production-grade services, webhook handlers, adapters, data mappings, deployment automation, tests, and operational tooling in the customer's preferred environment.

  • Prove quality. Create unit, integration, contract, end-to-end, load, resilience, and failover tests. Validate business workflows, API and event behavior, recovery, migration, and rollback.

  • Make the system observable. Instrument structured logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, alerts, and cross-system correlation using Sinch identifiers, callbacks, delivery events, product telemetry, and protocol evidence where relevant.

  • Navigate security and compliance. Partner with customer security, privacy, legal, and communications teams on authentication, data handling, consent, regional requirements, channel regulations, and architecture review.

  • Drive adoption and handoff. Train customer engineers, document architecture and runbooks, establish ownership, and leave the customer able to operate and extend its implementation.

Become self-sufficient in routine delivery, using SMEs thereafter to stay current with product, technology, market, and use-case changes and for exceptional deep-domain issues.

  • Turn field evidence into product improvement. Provide Product and Engineering with reproducible findings, customer impact, recommended changes, and reusable implementation patterns that improve APIs, documentation, tooling, and defaults.

THE TECHNICAL SURFACE

Your primary depth should be in production software delivery, enterprise integration, and operations. You are not expected to arrive as a deep expert in Voice, Messaging, and Email. You must bring meaningful exposure to at least one communications domain, learn adjacent products rapidly with named SME support during ramp-up, become self-sufficient in routine delivery, and know when material changes or unusual complexity require specialist input.

  • AI-assisted software delivery: coding agents and AI-enabled development environments used for discovery, implementation, refactoring, testing, debugging, review, and documentation, with human verification and engineering accountability throughout

  • Enterprise integration: REST APIs, webhooks, asynchronous events, identity and access, data mapping, queues, event buses, CRMs, contact centers, data stores, legacy services, and customer-specific operating standards

  • Production engineering: automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, containers or serverless, scalability, resilience, performance, secrets, logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, alerts, incident response, and operational handoff

  • Voice: Voice APIs and callbacks, call flows, PSTN, SIP and WebRTC concepts, numbers, routing, recording, streaming, and common signaling, media, or network dependencies

  • Messaging: SMS, MMS, RCS, WhatsApp and Conversation API patterns; senders, templates, provisioning, delivery events, opt-in, country requirements, routing, and channel limitations

  • Email: API and SMTP sending, domains and DNS authentication, templates, webhooks, deliverability, bounces, complaints, suppressions, reputation, and regional processing

  • Customer deployment platforms: AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, containers, serverless, or on-premises environments, including regional placement, data residency, secrets, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code

REQUIREMENTS

  • Typically 7+ years of professional experience across software engineering, enterprise integration, solution delivery, or technical consulting, including substantial direct work with enterprise customers. Equivalent depth matters more than a specific degree or title.

  • A record of personally architecting, building, deploying, operating, and supporting API-driven production systems, not only presenting demos or handing designs to another team.

  • Strong production software skills in at least one relevant stack such as TypeScript/Node.js, Python, Java, or C#/.NET, with sound API, event-driven, authentication, security, testing, code-review, and maintainability practices.

  • Demonstrated ability to use coding agents or other AI development tools to accelerate working software, tests, troubleshooting, and documentation while independently validating the results.

  • Experience integrating new software into existing enterprise technology stacks, including APIs, webhooks, data stores, identity systems, cloud services, events, and operational processes.

  • Strong command of testing, scalability, and observability, including automated test strategy, capacity and failure-mode design, structured logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, alerting, and cross-system correlation.

  • Experience deploying services on at least one major cloud platform using modern delivery practices such as Git, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, containers or serverless, secrets management, and regional design.

  • Meaningful exposure to at least one communications domain such as programmable voice, messaging, or email. Experience across multiple domains is valuable but is not required.

  • Ability to learn adjacent CPaaS products rapidly with heavy initial support from named SMEs, then apply that guidance independently in normal delivery work.

  • Clear written and verbal communication across engineers, product specialists, security reviewers, business owners, and executives, including the ability to teach and create shared clarity under pressure.

  • Delivery judgment under ambiguity: scope an MVP, make tradeoffs, surface risks early, protect the critical path, and remain calm during planned cutovers and production stabilization.

  • Willingness to travel approximately 10-15% and support planned customer workshops and cutovers. This is not a standing customer-support or on-call assignment.

Preferred

  • Hands-on production experience with a CPaaS provider or comparable communications API platform.

  • Depth in one or more of programmable Voice, SMS, RCS, WhatsApp, Email, Numbers, Verification, SIP trunking, or related communications technologies.

  • Experience with AI-native companies, conversational AI, agentic systems, speech technologies, or real-time AI integrations.

  • Deep Voice and SIP troubleshooting, messaging-channel provisioning, or email-deliverability expertise.

  • Experience connecting communications APIs with CRMs, contact centers, data platforms, decision engines, or AI systems.

  • Experience creating reusable implementation assets, mentoring engineers, or influencing a product roadmap from field evidence.

OUR HIRING PROCESS

We are committed to ensuring a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and inclusive. Our approach includes structured, competency-based interviews designed to evaluate your skills, experience, and qualifications relevant to the role. At times, we may include a data-driven assessment to enhance our hiring success and identify candidates likely to excel.

We believe in a two-way process and encourage you to ask questions throughout the journey. If this role isn't what you're looking for, please explore the other opportunities listed on our career page: No matter who you are, we hope you find an exciting path forward - hopefully with us!

Benefits

  • TAKE A BREAK: Enjoy a generous paid time off program. We value balance and understand that performance at work requires time to rest at home and/or rejuvenate on vacation.

  • PUT FAMILY FIRST: We know that families can be built in a variety of ways; therefore, we offer paid parental leave and family planning support.

  • WORK WHEREVER: Our flexible remote work offerings allow you to work wherever you are the most productive and successful. It is what you do, not where you work, that matters.

  • MAKE AN IMPACT: Support betterment in your community and beyond by taking paid time off to support a volunteer program of your choice.

jobs.description:
About the role:
We are building a greenfield, document-driven lending platform that automates the full lifecycle of a loan application — from document intake and OCR-based extraction, through human-in-the-loop review, to final approval and downstream submission. The system is a modular monolith with a clear separation between backend services and multiple trust-boundaried web front ends, deployed natively on Azure.
We're looking for a senior full-stack engineer who is equally comfortable designing clean, testable back-end architecture in C#/.NET and building modern, production-grade UI in React/Next.js. You'll work across the stack: domain modeling, API design, background/async processing, and customer- and operations-facing web applications.

Responsibilities

  • Design and build business logic and domain modules in an ASP.NET Core API following Clean Architecture principles (Domain, Application, Infrastructure, API layers).
  • Build and maintain asynchronous background processing services (a .NET worker) for document-heavy workflows, coordinated through message queues.
  • Develop and maintain multiple Next.js/React applications serving different user populations (internal operations/back-office tooling and external/customer-facing portals), sharing a common package layer.
  • Design relational data models and write efficient data access code (EF Core / PostgreSQL).
  • Integrate with cloud-native infrastructure: message queues, blob storage, secrets management, and managed identity providers.
  • Implement authentication and authorization across multiple identity boundaries (workforce vs. external/customer identity).
  • Collaborate on API contracts and shared TypeScript types consumed by front-end applications.
  • Participate in architectural decisions that keep a growing monolith modular, maintainable, and well-tested (unit, integration, contract, and architecture tests).
  • Work within a human-in-the-loop product model: build tooling that lets operators review, correct, and approve AI-assisted extraction results, with full traceability of how each data point changed from raw intake to final approval.
  • Write and maintain automated tests across the stack and participate in CI/CD pipeline health.
  • Participate in code review, technical design discussions, and mentor less experienced engineers.

Requirements

  • 8+ years of professional software development experience, with deep expertise in C# / .NET (ASP.NET Core).
  • 4+ years building production front-end applications with React, including Next.js (App Router, server components/actions, route handlers).
  • Strong understanding of Clean/Layered Architecture, domain modeling, and separation of concerns in non-trivial back-end systems.
  • Experience with relational databases and ORMs (EF Core or equivalent), including migrations and query performance.
  • Solid TypeScript skills and comfort working in a monorepo with shared, versioned internal packages.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (Azure preferred; AWS/GCP equivalents considered) — messaging/queues, object storage, secrets management.
  • Experience implementing or integrating OAuth2/OIDC-based authentication, ideally with enterprise identity providers (e.g., Microsoft Entra ID or similar).
  • Strong automated testing discipline: unit, integration, and contract testing on both back end and front end.
  • Comfortable working across the full stack without hand-offs — from database schema to API to UI.
  • Excellent communication skills and experience working in a small, senior, high-autonomy engineering team.

jobs.description:
We're currently hiring for remote team members in the following states: DC, DE, GA, MA, MD, NC, NH, NJ, OH, PA, SC, UT, and VA.

We're AWeber, a remote‑first company that helps small businesses around the world form meaningful connections with their customers and grow their businesses using our marketing communication software. We are fanatical about small businesses and we hope you are too!

At AWeber, agentic development is core to how we build. Our engineers spend most of their time designing agents and agentic engineering systems, reviewing agent‑generated work for quality and correctness, and coordinating that work across the codebase. As an Engineering Team Lead, you build a small team of engineers who do exactly that into a high‑performing, healthy, well‑functioning group, and you lead them from inside the work.

This is a player‑coach role. You run 1:1s, grow careers, own hiring and reviews for your team, and own its delivery and quality bar. You also stay hands‑on: designing solutions, reviewing agent output on the risky paths, and shipping the hard parts yourself. We are not looking for someone who leaves the code behind. We are looking for the senior engineer other people already rely on, who leads and grows a team without losing their own hands on the keyboard. Your mission is to help a capable, curious group ship work the org can trust, move quickly without cutting corners, and consistently finish what they start.

On any given day, you could be found reviewing an agent‑generated pull request on a risky path and coaching the engineer on how they verified it, running a 1:1 that turns someone's recurring frustration into an owned initiative, interviewing a candidate and sharpening how your team evaluates new hires, pairing for an hour to unblock a stalled migration, deciding what comes off the plate so your team is not underwater, or carrying your team's priorities into a cross‑team engineering forum.

You'll thrive as an Engineering Team Lead if you

  • Lead from inside the work, stay hands‑on in the code, and measure success by your team's output and growth rather than your own.
  • Have a bias to action, turning recurring problems into owned, dated, shipped solutions instead of letting good ideas recirculate.
  • Treat verification and trust as the real throughput limit in an AI‑first org, and hold the line on quality without stalling momentum.
  • Make people decisions and difficult trade‑offs with care, and own the outcomes.
  • Establish standards and inspire others, not just through your own expertise but through mentorship and advocacy.
  • Default to open, transparent communication, and adapt your message to engineers, peers, product partners, and leadership.
  • Stay calm and steady when priorities compete, and keep your team oriented on what matters most.
  • Stay a forever learner, and grow the people around you.

Required skills and qualifications

  • 7+ years in hands‑on software engineering roles, with real depth on the backend (Python) or the front end (React, TypeScript, or modern JavaScript frameworks), and the judgment to review and improve both engineers' and agent‑generated code.
  • 1+ year in a technical lead, team lead, or hands‑on project management role, with a track record of mentoring and growing engineers. We are open to a strong first‑time people manager who has been a de facto lead.
  • Experience owning a team's delivery: setting direction, breaking down ambiguous work, holding people accountable to commitments, and driving projects to done.
  • Demonstrated ability to design solutions with AI development tools and coding assistants, and to raise a team's standard for reviewing agent‑generated work.
  • Strong experience across our stack: Python, React, and TypeScript, plus databases, caching strategies, UNIX development tools, and deploying to AWS or other cloud infrastructure.
  • Readiness to own the people work of a lead: performing reviews, interviewing and evaluating candidates, and developing careers.
  • A track record of turning recurring problems into owned, shared solutions, and of managing projects cross‑functionally to deadline in a fast‑paced environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with a proven ability to inspire and mentor engineers across experience levels.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience leading delivery in a high‑volume agentic or AI‑assisted codebase, including the verification, trust, and code‑review challenges that come with it.
  • Experience in a remote‑first, asynchronous engineering culture.
  • Background in one of our domains: email or marketing SaaS, web platforms, backend services, or front‑end at scale.
  • Familiarity with application monitoring, metrics, performance tuning, and scaling web applications, plus Test Driven Development, release management, and QA practices you can champion across a team.
  • Experience with vendor relationship management for software, services, or external consultants.
  • A record of developing others' AI and agentic capability through working sessions, documentation, or reusable patterns.
  • Experience running a team through a migration or platform shift without stalling delivery, and an understanding of open source contribution and licensing.

AWeber Benefits

  • 100% Remote - we're not going back to the office and here's why.
  • Strong culture that supports flexibility, entrepreneurialism, and collaboration. Think we should be doing something different? Share your feedback! We’re looking for you to add your AWesomeness to our culture.
  • We have some other pretty cool benefits to make your life easier:
    • 100% Company Paid PPO medical, dental, vision insurance (spousal and domestic partner benefits available).
    • 4-7 weeks of paid time off and holidays (based on tenure).
    • 4 week paid sabbatical (based on tenure).
    • 401K retirement plan with 4% company match.
    • Company Profit Share.
    • Home office equipment and internet stipend.
    • Tuition reimbursement, conferences, and learning opportunities.
    • Gym Memberships Reimbursement.
    • Company Paid Short Term Disability Insurance.
    • Company Paid Life Insurance.
    • Additional Supplemental Benefits (Long Term Disability, Critical Illness, and Additional Life Insurance).

jobs.description:
Senior Enterprise Architect

Wilmington, DE or London, UK

Monday – Friday 8:00 – 5:00

Remote

CSC is seeking a Senior Enterprise Architect to help shape and evolve a coherent enterprise and hybrid cloud architecture that supports the strategic goals of Enterprise Technology (ET).

ET provides global platforms and infrastructure to business-unit–oriented digital product teams and is undergoing a significant transformation toward a full self-service, hybrid, multi-cloud ecosystem. This transformation includes infrastructure-as-code platforms, self-service IaaS- and PaaS-like products, and modern cloud-ready, container-based applications. The goal is to organize, optimize, and productize ET services to better serve CSC’s business partners.

As a Senior Enterprise Architect, you will work within an integrated Architecture, Engineering, and Product team that directly supports the CIO and ET’s executive leadership. You will play a leading role in defining enterprise and hybrid cloud architecture, guiding its evolution, and ensuring that platforms, standards, and guardrails enable teams to deliver securely, reliably, and at scale.

This role is enterprise- and platform-focused. Success is achieved through architecture, governance, mentorship, and influence rather than direct ownership of day-to-day delivery execution.

Some of the things that you’ll be doing:

Leadership & Strategy

  • Define, guide, and evolve ET’s enterprise and hybrid cloud architecture, including reference architectures and target-state roadmaps
  • Architect and guide the development, implementation, and ongoing improvement of private, hybrid, and multi-cloud platforms
  • Develop and implement hybrid cloud strategies that enable ET’s transformation and support CSC’s long-term business objectives
  • Establish architectural guardrails, standards, and governance that enable teams to move faster while remaining secure and compliant
  • Mentor architects, cloud engineers, and technologists, helping build future-ready skills and roles

Collaboration & Enablement

  • Partner closely with Enterprise Architecture, Cloud, Data, and Solution Architects, as well as ET Engineering Leads and BU Application Development Leads
  • Lead cross-functional collaboration in the design and evolution of enterprise platforms, systems, products, and services
  • Support executive and senior leadership decision-making through architectural insight, trade-off analysis, and recommendations
  • Build trusted relationships across ET leadership, CSC, and its business units

Hybrid Cloud Architecture & Governance

  • Perform a key leadership role in hybrid cloud architecture, including private and public cloud design, workload assessments, and platform evolution
  • Identify, evaluate, and select cloud services and technologies based on business requirements, constraints, and architectural fit
  • Define and enforce best practices for hybrid cloud deployments, including security, resiliency, performance optimization, and cost management
  • Ensure compliance with security, risk, and governance standards across private and public cloud environments
  • Lead the design and integration of Nutanix-based private cloud environments with public cloud platforms
  • Evaluate and recommend cloud-native services from Azure, AWS, and GCP to complement private cloud capabilities

Architecture Practice & Delivery Support

  • Develop and maintain enterprise and hybrid cloud roadmaps aligned with ET and CSC strategy
  • Provide architectural consulting, guidance, and direction to executives, systems analysts, cloud engineers, and delivery teams
  • Document and maintain in-depth knowledge of ET’s existing private, hybrid, and public cloud architectures
  • Set architectural vision, gather requirements, evaluate vendors and technologies, gain business consensus, and contribute to delivery of scalable solutions
  • Communicate architectural vision, decisions, and findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Develop and communicate investment plans for private and hybrid cloud infrastructure, including capacity planning and cost optimization opportunities

What Technical skills, experience, and qualifications do you need?

  • Proven experience as a Senior or Enterprise Architect in complex organizations
  • Deep experience with hybrid and multi-cloud architectures, preferably Azure-centric
  • Strong knowledge of hybrid cloud architecture and design principles
  • Hands-on experience with Nutanix private cloud platforms, including design, deployment, and integration
  • Experience with public cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud Platform, including hybrid connectivity and workload migration
  • Strong understanding of non-functional requirements including security, resiliency, availability, observability, performance, and FinOps
  • Experience enabling self-service platforms and internal developer experiences
  • Ability to translate business strategy into architectural direction, roadmaps, team objectives, and actionable outcomes
  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to influence across organizational boundaries without direct authority
  • Experience designing and evolving complex, distributed systems
  • Excellent analytical, creative problem-solving, and decision-making skills
  • Ability to coach and mentor on technical skills, architectural thinking, and critical reasoning
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills
  • Principle-based and value-driven approach to architecture and technology decisions
  • Practical experience applying enterprise architecture frameworks such as TOGAF, SABSA, or similar
  • Experience with enterprise architecture tools; ABACUS preferred
  • Familiarity with design thinking, cloud-oriented architecture, infrastructure architecture, resilience and scale-out patterns, data management, and product development

jobs.title: Senior Supply Chain Analyst (Exol)
jobs.excerpt: Who we areWith its A. I. -powered robotic technology platform, Symbotic is changing the way consumer goods move through the supply chain.
jobs.description:
Who we are

With its A.I.-powered robotic technology platform, Symbotic is changing the way consumer goods move through the supply chain. Intelligent software orchestrates advanced robots in a high-density, end-to-end system – reinventing warehouse automation for increased efficiency, speed and flexibility.

What we need

As a Senior Supply Chain Analyst, you will execute data-driven projects and support both internal operations and commercial growth initiatives. In this role, you will transform raw customer data into actionable insights, support network optimization engagements, and help develop the analytics tools used to win bids and improve supply chain performance. This position reports to the Senior Manager, Supply Chain Design & Analytics.

Exol* is pioneering warehousing-as-a-service, offering outsourced warehousing operations and specializing in automated warehousing solutions. Our focus is on the efficient movement of goods in cases and pallets across all sectors, such as wholesale, retail, and general merchandising.

*Exol is an independently managed joint venture between Symbotic and Softbank.

What we do

The Customer Solutions organization at Exol is a critical part of the sales engine designed to provide end-to-end support for bid development for new business acquisitions. Integrating the functions of supply chain analytics, pricing, solutions engineering and customer communications the team creates cohesive, data-driven bidding approaches to ensure consistency and maximize success in winning new contracts

What you’ll do

  • Process raw customer data to support cost and pricing analytics, network optimization solutions, and other analytics that support the sales team in competitive bids.

  • Manage end-to-end network optimization projects — including facility location analysis, capacity planning, transportation flow optimization, and cost-to-serve modeling — to support strategic decisions such as where to open new sites, expand existing warehouse capacity, or invest in additional network infrastructure.

  • Contribute to the transition of Excel-based analytics and workflows into scalable applications within our software platform, guiding requirements, prioritizing features, and ensuring successful delivery.

  • Lead the development, deployment, and ongoing improvement of AI agents across a wide range of use cases to automate analytics, streamline processes, enhance decision-making, streamline processes and improve operational efficiency.

  • Build and maintain customer-facing analytics dashboards to deliver supply chain insights, such as inventory optimization and demand forecasting.

What you’ll need

  • Bachelor's degree in supply chain management, Industrial and Operations Engineering, Mathematics, or related field.

  • Minimum 5 years of experience executing supply chain analytics projects (e.g., network optimization, inventory optimization, and demand forecasting).

  • Expert-level proficiency in Excel and Microsoft Office tools.

  • Experience with network optimization platforms such as Supply Chain Guru.

  • Hands-on experience with Python.

  • Adaptability to thrive in a dynamic startup environment with shifting priorities.

  • Strong problem-solving abilities and a proactive approach to task ownership.

Preferred Skills & Qualifications

  • Exposure to AI agent development, deployment, and evaluation.

  • Experience working within Agile/Sprint methodologies for project or product development.

  • Experience using agile sprint methodologies to manage product development.

  • Exposure to warehouse automation and its impact on end-to-end supply chains.

  • Strong Python coding skills and experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).

  • Effective data storytelling skills, with the ability to translate analytical findings into clear insights for the team and stakeholders.

Our Environment

  • Up to 10% of travel may be required. Employees must have a valid driver’s license and the ability to drive and/or fly to client and other customer locations. 

  • The employee is responsible for owning a credit card and managing expenses personally to be reimbursed on a bi-weekly basis.

About Symbotic

Symbotic is an automation technology leader reimagining the supply chain with its end-to-end, AI-powered robotic and software platform. Symbotic reinvents the warehouse as a strategic asset for the world’s largest retail, wholesale, and food & beverage companies. Applying next-gen technology, high-density storage and machine learning to solve today's complex distribution challenges, Symbotic enables companies to move goods with unmatched speed, agility, accuracy and efficiency. As the backbone of commerce the Symbotic platform transforms the flow of goods and the economics of supply chain for its customers. For more information, visit .
